5ca5de6b-bc71-46c4-a8f7-7f30d7040acb.name: Gate Nand
5ca5de6b-bc71-46c4-a8f7-7f30d7040acb.quick: NAND gate: outputs False only when both A and B are True; otherwise True | inverse of Gate And

contexts.logic_control: Wire boolean conditions from filters or comparisons into A and B; use R to drive visibility, culling, or branching — outputs True unless both inputs are True simultaneously
contexts.combining_with_other_gates: Chain with Gate Not, Gate And, Gate Or, Gate Nor, Gate Xor to build complex boolean logic; NAND is functionally complete — any logic circuit can be built from it alone

5ca5de6b-bc71-46c4-a8f7-7f30d7040acb.errors: Non-boolean inputs require explicit conversion; mismatched list lengths between A and B may cause null outputs or unintended shortest-list matching

548177c2-d1db-4172-b667-bec979e2d38b.name: Gate Nor
548177c2-d1db-4172-b667-bec979e2d38b.quick: NOR gate: true only when both A and B are false | equivalent to NOT(A OR B)

contexts.logic_filtering: Wire two boolean conditions to A and B; R is true only if neither condition is met. Combine with Gate And/Or for complex logic trees.
contexts.negation_of_or: Use as shorthand for Gate Or followed by Gate Not; reduces component count when checking that no condition is active.

548177c2-d1db-4172-b667-bec979e2d38b.errors: Non-boolean inputs require upstream conversion; if A or B is null/unset, output may default false or error — ensure both inputs are explicitly wired.

00027467-0d24-4fa7-b178-8dc0ac5f42ec.name: Value List
00027467-0d24-4fa7-b178-8dc0ac5f42ec.quick: Dropdown/radio UI letting user pick from named preset values | values and their data must be manually configured in component properties
00027467-0d24-4fa7-b178-8dc0ac5f42ec.description: Provides a list of preset values to choose from

contexts.option_selection: Right-click component to add named items with associated values; output feeds downstream params like toggles or number inputs; acts as labeled enum selector
contexts.workflow_control: Used to switch between modes or options; pair with logic components to branch workflows based on selected value; cleaner than slider for discrete choices

00027467-0d24-4fa7-b178-8dc0ac5f42ec.errors: No output if no items configured; value type mismatch if downstream expects number but string is stored; forgetting to set display mode (dropdown vs radio) causes UI confusion

3ede854e-c753-40eb-84cb-b48008f14fd4.name: Text
3ede854e-c753-40eb-84cb-b48008f14fd4.quick: Stores/passes text string values; no inputs, outputs text collection | right-click to set values directly
3ede854e-c753-40eb-84cb-b48008f14fd4.description: Contains a collection of text fragments

contexts.hardcoded_string: Used as a parameter container to hold literal text values; right-click > Set one/multiple Text to enter strings; wire output to any text-accepting input
contexts.pipeline_relay: Acts as a named text relay in a definition; receives external text via internalized data or wired upstream string sources; useful for labeling, file names, or identifiers
contexts.file_path_alternative: Similar to File Path param but without path-specific validation; use when passing generic strings like layer names, keys, or tags to downstream components

3ede854e-c753-40eb-84cb-b48008f14fd4.errors: No inputs means data must be internalized or wired in; if output shows null/empty, no text has been set. Mismatched type when downstream expects number or geometry.

16ef3e75-e315-4899-b531-d3166b42dac9.name: Vector
16ef3e75-e315-4899-b531-d3166b42dac9.quick: Stores/passes 3D vector data between components | parameter container, no computation
16ef3e75-e315-4899-b531-d3166b42dac9.description: Contains a collection of three-dimensional vectors

contexts.data_pipeline: Used as a Vector parameter to hold or relay vector collections; connect to Move, Orient, or transform components expecting vector inputs; right-click to set persistent vectors
contexts.inter_component_wiring: Acts as a typed conduit between geometry operations needing direction/offset vectors; neighbors include Plane and Transform, suggesting use in spatial transformation workflows

16ef3e75-e315-4899-b531-d3166b42dac9.errors: Type mismatch if non-vector data is wired in; empty output if no vectors are internalized or connected upstream

8529dbdf-9b6f-42e9-8e1f-c7a2bde56a70.name: Line
8529dbdf-9b6f-42e9-8e1f-c7a2bde56a70.quick: Parameter container holding line segment data; acts as a persistent or referenced line collection in the canvas
8529dbdf-9b6f-42e9-8e1f-c7a2bde56a70.description: Contains a collection of line segments

contexts.storing_lines: Used to internalize or reference line geometry; right-click to set/bake lines; connects to downstream curve or geometry operations expecting line input
contexts.pipeline_relay: Placed between a line-generating component and consumers (e.g., Mesh, Transform) to organize or cache line data mid-graph

8529dbdf-9b6f-42e9-8e1f-c7a2bde56a70.errors: No inputs — fails silently if no geometry is internalized or wired in; outputs nothing if container is empty; type mismatch if non-line curves are force-cast

1e936df3-0eea-4246-8549-514cb8862b7a.name: Mesh
1e936df3-0eea-4246-8549-514cb8862b7a.quick: Parameter container holding referenced or internalized mesh geometry | no inputs, pass-through for mesh data
1e936df3-0eea-4246-8549-514cb8862b7a.description: Contains a collection of polygon meshes

contexts.referencing_rhino_mesh: Right-click > Set one/multiple Mesh to reference Rhino mesh objects; output feeds mesh analysis, display, or processing components
contexts.internalizing_mesh: Right-click > Internalize data to bake mesh into definition; useful for portability without Rhino geometry dependency
contexts.pipeline_relay: Used as a named mesh relay between clusters or groups; connect output to Mesh Edit, Mesh Join, or transform components

1e936df3-0eea-4246-8549-514cb8862b7a.errors: No geometry if Rhino reference is deleted or layer hidden; null mesh if internalized data is corrupted or source mesh is invalid

28f40e48-e739-4211-91bd-f4aefa5965f8.name: Transform
28f40e48-e739-4211-91bd-f4aefa5965f8.quick: Stores/passes Transform data (matrices, xforms) between components | acts as a parameter container, no inputs
28f40e48-e739-4211-91bd-f4aefa5965f8.description: Contains a collection of three-dimensional transformations

contexts.passing_transforms: Wire Transform output into geometry transformation components (e.g., Transform geometry). Holds xform data from Move, Rotate, Orient, or other transform-generating components.
contexts.collecting_transforms: Used to collect and store multiple transformation matrices in one place, then feed downstream to apply to geometry or planes.

28f40e48-e739-4211-91bd-f4aefa5965f8.errors: No inputs — fails if nothing is wired in externally. Expects Transform/xform type data; incompatible geometry types will cause type conversion errors.

3e8ca6be-fda8-4aaf-b5c0-3c54c8bb7312.name: Number
3e8ca6be-fda8-4aaf-b5c0-3c54c8bb7312.quick: Stores a collection of floating-point numbers as a parameter container | acts as a constant number source, not interactive like Number Slider

contexts.constant_values: Used to hardcode one or more float values into a definition; right-click to set values manually; wire output to any numeric input downstream
contexts.multi_value_list: Can hold multiple numbers at once, outputting a list; useful when feeding fixed numeric sets to components expecting lists rather than single slider values

3e8ca6be-fda8-4aaf-b5c0-3c54c8bb7312.errors: No output if no values have been entered; unlike Number Slider, provides no UI handle — values must be set via right-click menu or external data connection

2e3ab970-8545-46bb-836c-1c11e5610bce.name: Integer
2e3ab970-8545-46bb-836c-1c11e5610bce.quick: Stores/passes integer numbers as a parameter; truncates decimals if floats are connected
2e3ab970-8545-46bb-836c-1c11e5610bce.description: Contains a collection of integer numbers

contexts.hardcoded_value: Right-click > Set Integer to bake a fixed whole number; useful for counts, indices, or iteration steps without a slider
contexts.type_enforcement: Wire between float-outputting components and integer-expecting inputs; acts as a type converter, truncating decimal values to whole numbers
contexts.list_of_integers: Can hold multiple integers via right-click > Manage Integer Collection; useful for fixed index lists or discrete option sets

2e3ab970-8545-46bb-836c-1c11e5610bce.errors: Floats passed in are silently truncated, not rounded. No inputs means value must be set manually; unset parameter outputs null and causes downstream failures.

15b7afe5-d0d0-43e1-b894-34fcfe3be384.name: Domain
15b7afe5-d0d0-43e1-b894-34fcfe3be384.quick: Parameter container holding numeric domain values (intervals); used to store/pass Domain data between components
15b7afe5-d0d0-43e1-b894-34fcfe3be384.description: Contains a collection of numeric domains

contexts.storing_domains: Acts as a persistent parameter holding one or more numeric domains (e.g., {0 to 1}); wire into components expecting Domain input like Remap, Evaluate, or surface UV operations
contexts.data_passing: Used as a typed parameter node to explicitly hold domain collections in a definition; right-click to set domain values manually or receive from upstream interval-generating components

15b7afe5-d0d0-43e1-b894-34fcfe3be384.errors: No inputs defined — cannot compute; must be set manually or wired from a domain-producing component. Type mismatch if non-domain data is connected.

203a91c3-287a-43b6-a9c5-ebb96240a650.name: Colour
203a91c3-287a-43b6-a9c5-ebb96240a650.quick: Stores a collection of RGB colour values as a parameter; no inputs, outputs colour data directly.
203a91c3-287a-43b6-a9c5-ebb96240a650.description: Contains a collection of RGB colours

contexts.colour_input: Used as a standalone colour parameter container; right-click to set colour values manually; wire output to components expecting colour/RGB input like Shader or mesh display.
contexts.multiple_colours: Can hold multiple colours in a list; useful for mapping colours to geometry or driving gradient/display components downstream.

203a91c3-287a-43b6-a9c5-ebb96240a650.errors: No inputs to wire incorrectly; errors arise if downstream components expect a different type (e.g., integer or material) instead of colour.

10487e4e-a405-48b5-b188-5a8a6328418b.name: SubD Box
10487e4e-a405-48b5-b188-5a8a6328418b.quick: Creates a SubD box from a Box primitive | D controls subdivision density, C likely toggles corner/crease behavior

contexts.basic_subd_modeling: Wire a Box component into B, set D (integer) for subdivision level (higher = smoother), toggle C (boolean) for corner treatment; outputs SubD ready for further SubD ops like Edge Tags or Fuse
contexts.subd_pipeline_start: Use as starting primitive before SubD Edges/Faces extraction or SubD Fuse; pairs naturally with SubD Edge Tags to sharpen creases on resulting shape

10487e4e-a405-48b5-b188-5a8a6328418b.errors: Null output if B is not a valid Box; D=0 or negative may produce degenerate SubD; C must be boolean — unconnected defaults apply but behavior may differ from intent

855a2c73-31c0-41d2-b061-57d54229d11b.name: SubD from Mesh
855a2c73-31c0-41d2-b061-57d54229d11b.quick: Converts a mesh into a SubD surface | Mesh must be valid; Cr=corner rounding, Co=crease count, I=interpolate toggle
855a2c73-31c0-41d2-b061-57d54229d11b.description: Create a SubD from a control mesh

contexts.mesh_to_subd_conversion: Wire a Mesh into M; set Cr (integer) for corner smoothing, Co (integer) for crease sharpness, I (boolean) to interpolate vertices. Output S feeds SubD Edge Tags or SubD Faces for further editing.
contexts.subd_editing_pipeline: Use after mesh modeling to get SubD S, then connect to SubD Edge Tags to control sharp/smooth edges, or SubD Fuse to combine multiple SubD objects.

855a2c73-31c0-41d2-b061-57d54229d11b.errors: Fails if M is null or non-manifold mesh; invalid Cr/Co integers may produce unexpected smoothing; non-closed meshes may yield open SubD with unintended boundary behavior.

4bfe1bf6-fbc9-4ad2-bf28-a7402e1392ee.name: MultiPipe
4bfe1bf6-fbc9-4ad2-bf28-a7402e1392ee.quick: Creates branching SubD pipe network around curves/lines | Curves input must form connected network for proper branching nodes
4bfe1bf6-fbc9-4ad2-bf28-a7402e1392ee.description: Create a branching pipe around a network of lines/curves

contexts.pipe_network: Feed connected lines/curves into Curves; NodeSize controls junction sphere size; StrutSize sets pipe radius; Segment controls mesh resolution; outputs SubD geometry directly
contexts.variable_radius: Use SizePoints (Point) to define per-location size overrides along the network; pair with NodeSize and StrutSize for tapered or varied pipe profiles
contexts.capping_ends: Caps (Integer) controls open/closed end behavior; EndOffset adjusts how far pipe ends are offset from curve endpoints; useful for clean terminations

4bfe1bf6-fbc9-4ad2-bf28-a7402e1392ee.errors: Disconnected or non-networked curves may produce missing nodes or broken branching; KinkAngle too low may over-segment smooth curves; Caps integer out of valid range silently defaults

00c2fe26-2082-44e4-a4ff-9460e8cecbd2.name: Query Model Environments
00c2fe26-2082-44e4-a4ff-9460e8cecbd2.quick: Retrieves all render environments from the Rhino document; filter by name pattern N
00c2fe26-2082-44e4-a4ff-9460e8cecbd2.description: Query a Rhino document for all available render environments

contexts.listing_environments: Connect optional text pattern to N to filter results; outputs Model Environment objects usable in material/render setup pipelines alongside Query Model Textures and Model Material components
contexts.render_setup: Use to fetch existing environments defined in Rhino scene; pipe E output into render environment assignment components or inspect available options before rendering

00c2fe26-2082-44e4-a4ff-9460e8cecbd2.errors: No environments returned if none defined in Rhino document; text pattern N mismatch silently returns empty list; component reads live document state so results change if environments are added/removed in Rhino

01640871-69ea-40ac-9380-4660d6d28bd2.name: Char Sequence
01640871-69ea-40ac-9380-4660d6d28bd2.quick: Char Sequence | Inputs: C, P, F → S
01640871-69ea-40ac-9380-4660d6d28bd2.description: Create a sequence of textual characters.

01e3991d-18bd-474f-9fbd-076a8700159f.name: Mesh Inclusion
01e3991d-18bd-474f-9fbd-076a8700159f.quick: Tests if a point is inside a mesh volume | S (strict) toggles boundary inclusion behavior
01e3991d-18bd-474f-9fbd-076a8700159f.description: Test a point for Mesh inclusion

contexts.point_in_mesh_test: Wire a closed Mesh to M, Point3d to P, Boolean to S (True=strict boundary). Outputs True/False per point. Works per-item; use list matching for multiple points against one mesh.
contexts.filtering_geometry: Use output I as a filter mask with Dispatch or Cull Pattern to separate points inside vs outside a mesh volume. Mesh must be closed/solid for reliable results.

01e3991d-18bd-474f-9fbd-076a8700159f.errors: Returns False for all points if mesh is open/non-manifold. Null mesh or mismatched point types cause null output. S input defaults if unconnected; boundary-edge points may return inconsistent results.

0233a5e5-91d3-4cd6-be0f-6d7ce5de3202.name: Query Annotation Styles
0233a5e5-91d3-4cd6-be0f-6d7ce5de3202.quick: Returns all annotation styles in the Rhino document; filter by name pattern via N input
0233a5e5-91d3-4cd6-be0f-6d7ce5de3202.description: Query a Rhino document for all available annotation styles

contexts.style_lookup: Connect text pattern to N to filter styles by name; output As feeds into annotation settings components (Arrow, Dimension, Units) or text override workflows
contexts.list_all_styles: Leave N empty or use wildcard to retrieve all available annotation styles; use As to drive downstream annotation components

0233a5e5-91d3-4cd6-be0f-6d7ce5de3202.errors: No styles returned if document has none defined; pattern mismatch returns empty list; N expects text/string pattern — wrong type causes null output

03b3db66-d7e8-4d2d-bc0c-122913317254.name: Sanity XForm
03b3db66-d7e8-4d2d-bc0c-122913317254.quick: Rescales/repositions far-away, tiny, or huge geometry to a workable origin/scale | outputs transformed G and original-space W (world reference)
03b3db66-d7e8-4d2d-bc0c-122913317254.description: Apply a sanity transformation to f a r - a w a y, tiny or HUGE geometry

contexts.fixing_far_from_origin: Plug problematic geometry into G; get back G (normalized) and W (world transform reference) to reverse or track the transformation later
contexts.preprocessing_for_other_transforms: Use before Mirror, Orient, or Rotate Axis when geometry is at extreme coordinates or scale, ensuring downstream transforms behave predictably

03b3db66-d7e8-4d2d-bc0c-122913317254.errors: No inputs produce null output. If geometry is already near origin at normal scale, transformation may be identity with no visible effect. W output purpose unclear without observations — treat as reference geometry.

03b801eb-87cd-476a-a591-257fe5d5bf0f.name: Pick'n'Choose
03b801eb-87cd-476a-a591-257fe5d5bf0f.quick: Selects from two data inputs (0 or 1) based on integer pattern P; P controls which source each item comes from
03b801eb-87cd-476a-a591-257fe5d5bf0f.description: Pick and choose from a set of input data.

contexts.conditional_selection: Wire two data lists to inputs 0 and 1; feed integer list (0s and 1s) to P to pick per-item from either source. Output R returns selected items matching P pattern length.
contexts.branching_data: Use with boolean-to-integer conversion upstream; P drives selection between two geometry or value streams, acting as a per-item switch/mux across parallel lists.

03b801eb-87cd-476a-a591-257fe5d5bf0f.errors: P values outside 0-1 range likely cause null or error outputs. Mismatched list lengths between P, 0, and 1 may produce unexpected results without explicit data matching.

03f22640-ff80-484e-bb53-a4025c5faa07.name: Split Brep Multiple
03f22640-ff80-484e-bb53-a4025c5faa07.quick: Splits one Brep (B) using multiple cutting Breps (C) simultaneously | all cutters applied at once
03f22640-ff80-484e-bb53-a4025c5faa07.description: Split one brep with a bunch of others.

contexts.mass_cutting: Feed a single solid Brep into B; supply a list of cutting Breps into C. Returns all resulting pieces as R. More efficient than chaining multiple Split Brep nodes.
contexts.floor_plate_splitting: Use a building mass as B and a list of floor planes/slabs as C to generate individual floor pieces in one operation.
contexts.boolean_prep: Use before Solid Union or Solid Difference when a Brep must be subdivided by several cutters before further boolean operations.

03f22640-ff80-484e-bb53-a4025c5faa07.errors: Fails or returns null if B or C are open/invalid Breps; cutters that don't fully intersect B produce no split. Non-manifold or self-intersecting geometry in C commonly causes failures.

047097d1-83bd-4f76-9994-dff721c24047.name: CreatePlankton
047097d1-83bd-4f76-9994-dff721c24047.quick: Converts GH Mesh to Plankton halfedge mesh structure | Input must be a valid GH Mesh; outputs Generic Data for Plankton-based operations
047097d1-83bd-4f76-9994-dff721c24047.description: Create a new Plankton halfedge mesh from a Grasshopper Mesh

contexts.halfedge_processing: Wire a GH Mesh (from Delaunay, Quad Remesh, or any mesh source) into M; output P feeds downstream Plankton components for topology queries, subdivision, or mesh editing
contexts.topology_analysis: Use after Quad Remesh or Delaunay Mesh to get halfedge topology access; P output connects to Plankton face/vertex/edge traversal components

047097d1-83bd-4f76-9994-dff721c24047.errors: Null or invalid mesh input causes failed conversion; non-manifold or open meshes may produce unexpected halfedge topology; output is Generic Data — cannot be used directly with standard GH mesh components

04887d01-504c-480e-b2a2-01ea19cc5922.name: Text Split
04887d01-504c-480e-b2a2-01ea19cc5922.quick: Splits text T into fragments using separator string(s) C | C must be text, not a character object
04887d01-504c-480e-b2a2-01ea19cc5922.description: Split some text into fragments using separators

contexts.csv_parsing: Feed CSV row as T, use ',' as C to split into cell values; outputs list of text fragments R, wire to Text Fragment or List Item for extraction
contexts.multi_separator: Provide multiple separator strings as a list to C to split on several delimiters at once; R returns all resulting fragments
contexts.pipeline_with_join: Pair with Replace Text to clean text first, then split; use Text Join to reassemble selected fragments after filtering

contexts.render_setup: Connect S output to scene render settings; toggle E (Boolean) to enable/disable sun. Pairs with Directional Light and Query Model Environments for full lighting setup.
contexts.time_animation: Animate Dt input across a day range to simulate sun path; La/Lo stay fixed for location-specific studies.

2a0a5db2-f3e4-4680-9f7a-87cabcc0b165.errors: Invalid latitude/longitude ranges (La outside ±90, Lo outside ±180) likely cause silent failures; null or unconnected Dt may default to system time or produce no output.

2a27f87c-61c5-47c2-a0b7-7863f31a3594.name: Stretch
2a27f87c-61c5-47c2-a0b7-7863f31a3594.quick: Stretches geometry along a finite line axis by a factor; R toggles relative vs. absolute scaling
2a27f87c-61c5-47c2-a0b7-7863f31a3594.description: Deforms objects by stretching them along a finite axis.

contexts.scaling_along_axis: Use a constructed Line component to define direction and length of stretch axis; L controls magnitude of deformation along that axis

2a27f87c-61c5-47c2-a0b7-7863f31a3594.errors: Fails if X (Line) is null or zero-length; geometry outside axis bounds may not deform as expected; L=0 produces no deformation

2a3f7078-2e25-4dd4-96f7-0efb491bd61c.name: Vector Display
2a3f7078-2e25-4dd4-96f7-0efb491bd61c.quick: Draws vectors as arrows in viewport from anchor point A along vector V | display only, no outputs

2a3f7078-2e25-4dd4-96f7-0efb491bd61c.errors: No visual output if A or V are null/empty. Mismatched list lengths between A and V may cause incomplete display. Component produces no geometry outputs — cannot feed downstream components.

2aab104a-5b20-4d8f-a918-fda5f016c828.name: Model Viewport

2aab104a-5b20-4d8f-a918-fda5f016c828.errors: No inputs means no configuration errors; downstream failures likely if consumer expects a specific viewport name/type and collection contains mismatched or empty viewport list

2b69bf71-4e69-43aa-b7be-4f6ce7e45bef.name: Quick Graph
2b69bf71-4e69-43aa-b7be-4f6ce7e45bef.quick: Displays a set of y-values as a simple graph in the viewport | No explicit inputs/outputs shown — likely accepts values via direct connection or component UI
2b69bf71-4e69-43aa-b7be-4f6ce7e45bef.description: Display a set of y-values as a graph

contexts.data_visualization: Connect a list of numbers to visualize trends as a graph; useful for quickly inspecting series data like distances, heights, or parameter values without external tools
contexts.debugging: Drop alongside data-generating components to spot-check numeric output shapes and distributions during model development

2b69bf71-4e69-43aa-b7be-4f6ce7e45bef.errors: No inputs/outputs exposed in schema — may require right-click or UI interaction to set values; non-numeric data likely causes silent failure or no display

2ba64356-be21-4c12-bbd4-ced54f04c8ef.name: Shape In Brep
2ba64356-be21-4c12-bbd4-ced54f04c8ef.quick: Tests if geometry (S) is inside a closed Brep (B) | Returns integer: 1=inside, 0=on surface, -1=outside
2ba64356-be21-4c12-bbd4-ced54f04c8ef.description: Tests whether a shape is inside a brep

contexts.containment_check: Wire a closed solid Brep to B, any geometry (point, curve, surface) to S; output R integer indicates spatial relationship. Often paired with Brep Closest Point for proximity workflows.
contexts.filtering_geometry: Use R output with conditional logic to filter geometry sets — e.g., keep only shapes where R=1 (inside). Combine with Point In Breps for multi-brep containment tests.
contexts.solid_boolean_prep: Check if shapes are already inside a brep before performing boolean operations to avoid redundant or failed operations.

2ba64356-be21-4c12-bbd4-ced54f04c8ef.errors: Brep must be closed/solid — open surfaces return unreliable results. Non-manifold or self-intersecting breps may produce incorrect R values. Complex geometry in S may slow computation.

2bcd153c-c964-4199-b8e4-4a19dfd34967.name: Symbol Display
2bcd153c-c964-4199-b8e4-4a19dfd34967.quick: Stores/displays symbol display properties | No inputs or outputs; acts as a parameter container for symbol styling

contexts.symbol_styling: Used standalone or alongside Text, Colour, and Integer params to define symbol display properties; typically wired into display-aware components needing symbol formatting
contexts.annotation_workflows: Paired with Text and Colour primitives to configure how symbols appear in Grasshopper annotations or custom display pipelines

2bcd153c-c964-4199-b8e4-4a19dfd34967.errors: No inputs/outputs means it cannot be wired directly; likely fails silently if expected to pass data — use as a parameter holder only

2d3b6ef3-5c26-4e2f-bcb3-8ffb9fb0f7c3.name: Box Slits
2d3b6ef3-5c26-4e2f-bcb3-8ffb9fb0f7c3.quick: Adds interlocking slits to intersecting boxes for slot-joint assembly | G controls gap/slit width
2d3b6ef3-5c26-4e2f-bcb3-8ffb9fb0f7c3.description: Add slits to a collection of intersecting boxes

contexts.slot_joint_fabrication: Feed a list of intersecting Box geometry into B; G sets slit gap number. Outputs modified Breps (B) ready for Solid Union/Difference and an integer type index (T) per box.
contexts.intersecting_box_assembly: Typically paired with Region Slits for 2D equivalent. Use Solid Union or Solid Difference downstream to finalize geometry after slits are cut into intersecting box volumes.

2d3b6ef3-5c26-4e2f-bcb3-8ffb9fb0f7c3.errors: <~30 tokens: Non-intersecting boxes produce no slits; G=0 or negative gap likely causes failed Brep output. Boxes must overlap for slit geometry to generate.

2d61f4e0-47c5-41d6-a41d-6afa96ee63af.name: Shift Paths
2d61f4e0-47c5-41d6-a41d-6afa96ee63af.quick: Shifts all path indices by offset O; positive shifts add depth, negative removes leading indices
2d61f4e0-47c5-41d6-a41d-6afa96ee63af.description: Shift the indices in all data tree paths

contexts.align_tree_depths: Use O=-1 to remove a leading branch level, matching a grafted tree back to a flat structure. Wire tree into D, integer offset into O.
contexts.add_path_prefix: Use O=1 to push all indices one level deeper, creating a new leading zero index. Useful before merging trees with different depths.
contexts.relative_items_prep: Pair with Relative Items to align path structures between two trees before cross-referencing items.

2d61f4e0-47c5-41d6-a41d-6afa96ee63af.errors: <~30 tokens: Negative O larger than path depth collapses paths to empty/invalid; non-integer O input causes type mismatch on O param.

2da6cc22-3b17-40ff-909a-162f77a7d532.name: Annotation Dot
2da6cc22-3b17-40ff-909a-162f77a7d532.quick: Creates/deconstructs annotation dot (labeled point) in Rhino viewport | Requires Point (L) and Text (T) at minimum

contexts.labeling_points: Wire a Point to L and a string/number to T to place a visible dot label in the viewport; H controls font size as integer; outputs pass-through the same values for downstream use
contexts.deconstruct_existing: Feed an existing Text Dot object into Ad input to extract its location (L), text (T), and height (H) for inspection or modification

2da6cc22-3b17-40ff-909a-162f77a7d532.errors: <~30 tokens: Null point on L causes no dot; H must be positive integer; Text Dot input (Ad) and Point (L) may conflict if both wired simultaneously

2e685fd9-7b8f-461b-b330-44857b099937.name: Volume Moments
2e685fd9-7b8f-461b-b330-44857b099937.quick: Computes volume, centroid, inertia, and gyration vectors for closed breps/meshes | geometry must be closed/watertight
2e685fd9-7b8f-461b-b330-44857b099937.description: Solve volume properties for closed breps and meshes.

contexts.mass_properties: Connect closed Brep or Mesh to G; outputs V (volume number), C (centroid point), I (inertia vector), S (second moments), G (gyration radii). Use alongside Volume component for simpler volume-only needs.
contexts.structural_analysis: Feed closed solid breps from boolean or loft operations into G to get centroid C and inertia I for structural or balance calculations. Pair with Area Moments for surface-based comparisons.
contexts.mesh_analysis: Works directly on meshes; ensure mesh is closed (no naked edges) before connecting, otherwise volume results will be incorrect or zero.

2e685fd9-7b8f-461b-b330-44857b099937.errors: Open breps or meshes with naked edges produce invalid/zero volume and unreliable centroid. Non-solid geometry (surfaces, curves) will fail — geometry must fully enclose a volume.

2ebb82ef-1f90-4ac9-9a71-1fe0f4ef7044.name: Power of 10
2ebb82ef-1f90-4ac9-9a71-1fe0f4ef7044.quick: Computes 10^x | input x is numeric exponent; outputs 10 raised to that power
2ebb82ef-1f90-4ac9-9a71-1fe0f4ef7044.description: Raise 10 to the power of N.

contexts.logarithmic_scaling: Wire numeric values into x to get 10^x; pairs naturally with Logarithm (Base-10) as inverse — useful for converting log-scale values back to linear scale
contexts.magnitude_conversion: Use to shift values by orders of magnitude; chain with Power of 2 or Power of E for comparing exponential bases in the same definition

2ebb82ef-1f90-4ac9-9a71-1fe0f4ef7044.errors: Non-numeric input to x will fail silently or return null; very large exponents may produce overflow; no domain restriction but negative x yields fractional results (e.g., 10^-3 = 0.001)

2ec65d2f-c274-4ea9-a2a3-cb20e77b533f.name: Equality Filter
2ec65d2f-c274-4ea9-a2a3-cb20e77b533f.quick: Creates equality/inequality predicates comparing a key K (Text) to value V | outputs = and ≠ predicates for filtering
2ec65d2f-c274-4ea9-a2a3-cb20e77b533f.description: Create a filter that determines if a value is equal to another

contexts.content_filtering: Wire K (attribute key as Text) and V (target value) to get = predicate; chain into Intersection Filter or Logical Or Filter to build compound queries against Rhino content via Content Cache
contexts.inequality_filtering: Use ≠ output to exclude items matching a specific value; combine with Greater Than / Less Than filters for range-based exclusions

2ec65d2f-c274-4ea9-a2a3-cb20e77b533f.errors: Type mismatch between V and actual attribute type may cause no matches; K must exactly match attribute key name (Text, case-sensitive likely); empty results if key K not found in content

2eccca8b-b190-4eef-9ead-0659ac1ef900.name: Annotation Units Settings
2eccca8b-b190-4eef-9ead-0659ac1ef900.quick: Gets/sets units settings for an annotation style | Pass existing Units Settings object into U to modify; all params mirror each other as inputs and outputs

contexts.modifying_annotation_style_units: Wire a Units Settings object from Query Annotation Styles into U input, then adjust Lu (length units integer), Lf (length factor), Lr (length rounding), Au (angle units), Ar (angle rounding), Ao (angle offset) — outputs the modified Units Settings for use in annotation style components
contexts.building_units_from_scratch: Leave U unconnected and drive individual integer/number/text inputs (P for prefix, S for suffix, Zs/Ff/Fs for zero-suppression and fraction format) to construct a Units Settings object to feed into Annotation Dimension or Tolerance Settings

2eccca8b-b190-4eef-9ead-0659ac1ef900.errors: <~30 tokens: Wrong integer enum values for Lu/Au/Zs/Ff cause silent failures; mismatched types (text vs integer) on integer inputs will error

310e1065-d03a-4858-bcd1-809d39c042af.name: Divide
310e1065-d03a-4858-bcd1-809d39c042af.quick: Divides vector V by scalar F; outputs scaled vector and its length L.

contexts.normalize_to_custom_length: Wire Vector 2Pt output into V, supply target divisor as F to scale direction; L gives resulting magnitude for validation.
contexts.length_extraction: Connect any vector to V with F=1 to pass vector unchanged while reading its length from L output.
contexts.inverse_scaling: Use after Cross Product or Dot Product workflows to normalize resultant vectors by a computed scalar factor.

310e1065-d03a-4858-bcd1-809d39c042af.errors: F=0 causes division by zero, likely null or infinite vector output. Non-vector input to V will fail; ensure upstream components output Vector type not Point.

31534405-6573-4be6-8bf8-262e55847a3a.name: Combine Date & Time
31534405-6573-4be6-8bf8-262e55847a3a.quick: Merges a date-only Time value (D) with a time-of-day Time value (T) into one combined datetime | both inputs must be Time type
31534405-6573-4be6-8bf8-262e55847a3a.description: Combine a pure date and a pure time into a single date

contexts.combining_construct_outputs: Wire Construct Date output into D and Construct Time output into T; result R is a full datetime usable in Date Range or Interpolate Date
contexts.scheduling_workflows: Use when date and time are built separately (e.g., date from slider, time from Construct Time) and need merging before formatting with Date Time Format

31534405-6573-4be6-8bf8-262e55847a3a.errors: Passing a full datetime (with time component) into D or a date-only value into T may produce unexpected results; both inputs expect pure date and pure time respectively

3175e3eb-1ae0-4d0b-9395-53fd3e8f8a28.name: Field
3175e3eb-1ae0-4d0b-9395-53fd3e8f8a28.quick: Parameter container for vector field data; stores/passes field collections between components
3175e3eb-1ae0-4d0b-9395-53fd3e8f8a28.description: Contains a collection of vector fields

contexts.data_passing: Used as a parameter to hold and relay vector field collections; wire into field-consuming components; no inputs, outputs the stored field data directly
contexts.field_pipeline: Acts as a persistent container for vector fields alongside Vector/Plane params; useful for organizing field data in complex definitions

3175e3eb-1ae0-4d0b-9395-53fd3e8f8a28.errors: No inputs defined — cannot be driven by upstream data directly; must be set via right-click or internalized data. Empty output if no field data is stored.

317f1cb2-820d-4a8f-b5c8-5de3594ddfba.name: Import 3DM
317f1cb2-820d-4a8f-b5c8-5de3594ddfba.quick: Imports geometry from a .3dm file into Rhino | F=filepath (Text), L=layer filter (Text), N=name filter (Text)

contexts.load_geometry_from_file: Wire a file path string to F; optionally filter by layer name (L) or object name (N) to extract specific geometry. Outputs Geometry objects for downstream processing.
contexts.layer_or_name_filtering: Use Value List or text panel for L (layer) and N (name) inputs to selectively import subsets of geometry from large 3DM files rather than importing everything.

317f1cb2-820d-4a8f-b5c8-5de3594ddfba.errors: Fails if F path is invalid, file doesn't exist, or is not a valid .3dm file. Empty output if L/N filters match no objects. Relative paths may fail depending on working directory.

318dacd7-9073-4ede-b043-a0c132eb77e0.name: MD Slider
318dacd7-9073-4ede-b043-a0c132eb77e0.quick: Multidimensional slider input; outputs multiple numeric values simultaneously from a single draggable 2D/ND control

contexts.2d_parameter_control: Use as a 2D point input controller; outputs X and Y values together, useful for driving surface UV parameters or 2D offsets without separate sliders
contexts.multi_value_input: Replace multiple independent Number Sliders when parameters are spatially related; drag in 2D space to adjust coupled values simultaneously

318dacd7-9073-4ede-b043-a0c132eb77e0.errors: No inputs — misconfiguration unlikely; output count depends on slider dimensions set in component properties; connecting to single-value inputs may require list item extraction

323f3245-af49-4489-8677-7a2c73664077.name: Closed
323f3245-af49-4489-8677-7a2c73664077.quick: Tests if a curve is closed (endpoints meet) or periodic (mathematically smooth loop) | outputs two separate booleans
323f3245-af49-4489-8677-7a2c73664077.description: Test if a curve is closed or periodic.

contexts.filtering_closed_curves: Wire curve list into C; use output C (closed boolean) with Dispatch or Cull Pattern to separate open from closed curves before further operations
contexts.checking_periodicity: Output P is true for periodic curves (e.g., circles, ellipses) vs. merely closed polylines; useful when downstream ops require smooth loops
contexts.containment_testing: Pair with Point in Curves — confirm curves are closed before testing point containment, since open curves produce unreliable containment results

323f3245-af49-4489-8677-7a2c73664077.errors: Null or invalid curve input causes component to error; open curves return False/False on both outputs — not an error but a common misread; periodic curves return True on both C and P

3249222f-f536-467a-89f4-f0353fba455a.name: Sift Pattern
3249222f-f536-467a-89f4-f0353fba455a.quick: Splits list L into multiple outputs using repeating integer pattern P | P defines which output index each element routes to
3249222f-f536-467a-89f4-f0353fba455a.description: Sift elements in a list using a repeating index pattern.

contexts.alternating_split: Wire a list to L and integers like {0,1} to P to alternate elements between output 0 and output 1; pattern repeats across full list length
contexts.multi_way_split: Use pattern {0,1,2} to distribute every 3 elements across 3 outputs; outputs are numbered 0,1,2 matching pattern values
contexts.geometry_sorting: Combine with Sort List or Partition List to pre-order geometry before sifting into separate branches for different operations

3249222f-f536-467a-89f4-f0353fba455a.errors: P must contain valid zero-based integers matching output count; mismatched or out-of-range pattern values produce empty outputs. Non-integer P input causes type error.

330eb9c9-0098-4375-9078-e00a419d49fb.name: Mesh Split Plane
330eb9c9-0098-4375-9078-e00a419d49fb.quick: Splits a mesh with an infinite plane into two meshes (A = above, B = below) | plane orientation determines which side is A vs B
330eb9c9-0098-4375-9078-e00a419d49fb.description: Split a mesh with an infinite plane.

contexts.bisecting_geometry: Connect a Mesh to M and a Plane (e.g., XY, custom origin+normal) to P; outputs A and B are the two halves — use Mesh Join to recombine selectively
contexts.sectioning_workflow: Feed output A or B into Mesh Join or Unweld Mesh for further processing; plane can be constructed with Plane Origin or Plane Normal components to control cut position
contexts.trimming_to_boundary: Use with a plane derived from a reference surface or Brep face to clip mesh geometry; infinite plane cuts entire mesh regardless of mesh bounds

330eb9c9-0098-4375-9078-e00a419d49fb.errors: Null output if mesh is entirely on one side of the plane (one output empty); degenerate mesh if plane is nearly tangent to mesh surface; non-manifold or open meshes may produce unexpected split topology

331b74f1-1f1f-4f37-b253-24fcdada29e3.name: Spatial Deform (custom)
331b74f1-1f1f-4f37-b253-24fcdada29e3.quick: Spatial deformation using custom space syntax; requires source points (S), vectors (F), and a syntax string (f) defining deformation rules.
331b74f1-1f1f-4f37-b253-24fcdada29e3.description: Perform spatial deformation based on custom space syntax.

contexts.custom_field_deformation: Wire geometry to G, control points to S, displacement vectors to F, and a custom syntax expression string to f. Allows user-defined spatial mapping beyond standard Spatial Deform.
contexts.comparison_with_spatial_deform: Similar to standard Spatial Deform but adds f (Text) input for custom space syntax, giving explicit control over how influence fields are computed around source points.

331b74f1-1f1f-4f37-b253-24fcdada29e3.errors: Missing or malformed syntax string in f causes deformation failure. Mismatched counts between S (points) and F (vectors) likely produces incorrect or no deformation. Non-geometry input to G will fail.

332378f4-acb2-43fe-8593-ed22bfeb2721.name: Surface Frames
332378f4-acb2-43fe-8593-ed22bfeb2721.quick: Generates a UxV grid of planes (frames) on a surface | U and V are integer count inputs controlling grid density
332378f4-acb2-43fe-8593-ed22bfeb2721.description: Generate a grid of {uv} frames on a surface

contexts.orienting_geometry_on_surface: Connect a surface to S, set U/V integers for grid resolution; output F gives planes for placing/orienting objects; uv gives corresponding parameter points
contexts.comparing_with_divide_surface: Similar to Divide Surface but outputs planes (F) with surface normal orientation, not just points; use when local surface frame/normal is needed
contexts.paneling_or_tiling: Wire F planes into Orient or other transform components to tile geometry across surface; U and V control panel count in each direction

332378f4-acb2-43fe-8593-ed22bfeb2721.errors: Non-surface geometry on S will fail; U or V of 0 or negative produces no output; untrimmed vs trimmed surfaces may shift frame positions near boundaries

33359c6d-984e-42f3-a869-0c3364ab33b6.name: Make2D Perspective View
33359c6d-984e-42f3-a869-0c3364ab33b6.quick: Defines a perspective view for Make2D using a camera point (C) and frame rectangle (F) | Both inputs required to produce valid View output
33359c6d-984e-42f3-a869-0c3364ab33b6.description: Define a perspective view for a Make2D solution

contexts.make2d_pipeline: Wire camera Point (C) and a Rectangle (F) as the view frame into this component, then connect the View (V) output to Make2D's view input to generate a perspective hidden-line drawing
contexts.view_selection: Use alongside Make2D Parallel View or Make2D Rhino View to compare projection types; swap view inputs into Make2D to switch between perspective and parallel projections

33359c6d-984e-42f3-a869-0c3364ab33b6.errors: Null or missing Point/Rectangle inputs will produce no valid View output; Rectangle must be planar and properly oriented — mismatched plane orientation may cause unexpected projection results in Make2D

335e597f-cf4e-40f6-8734-17896ea42a9f.name: Less Than Filter
335e597f-cf4e-40f6-8734-17896ea42a9f.quick: Outputs predicate filters (< and ≤) comparing a value V against key K; used with filter combiners like Intersection/Union.
335e597f-cf4e-40f6-8734-17896ea42a9f.description: Create a filter that determines if a value is less than another

contexts.filtering_objects: Wire K (Text key/property name) and V (threshold value) to get < and ≤ predicates; pass predicates to Intersection Filter or Union Filter to build compound queries for Rhino content filtering.
contexts.combining_with_other_filters: Chain output predicates with Greater Than Filter or Equality Filter via Logical Or/Intersection Filter to create range filters (e.g., between two values).

335e597f-cf4e-40f6-8734-17896ea42a9f.errors: Mismatched types between K and V may produce invalid predicates. Predicates alone do nothing — must be connected to a filter combiner or content query component to evaluate.

339c0ee1-cf11-444f-8e10-65c9150ea755.name: Colour Picker
339c0ee1-cf11-444f-8e10-65c9150ea755.quick: Interactive UI widget for selecting a single colour value; outputs a Colour type with no inputs required.

contexts.material_or_display_color: Wire output directly to components expecting a Colour input (e.g., Custom Preview, Swatch). User picks colour interactively in canvas; no wiring needed on input side.
contexts.paired_with_colour_wheel: Use alongside Colour Wheel when you need a base colour chosen manually and then generate a related palette from it.
contexts.replacing_hardcoded_colour: Substitute for hardcoded RGB/hex values; allows live colour adjustment without re-scripting.

339c0ee1-cf11-444f-8e10-65c9150ea755.errors: No inputs means no type-mismatch errors at source; downstream errors occur if connected component expects non-Colour type. No colour selected defaults to black (0,0,0).

33bcf975-a0b2-4b54-99fd-585c893b9e88.name: Digit Scroller
33bcf975-a0b2-4b54-99fd-585c893b9e88.quick: Interactive UI scroller for inputting a single numeric value; no inputs, outputs one number

contexts.numeric_input: Place on canvas, scroll or type to set a number; wire output directly to any numeric parameter needing a single value like radius, count, or distance
contexts.alongside_other_inputs: Used with Boolean Toggle, Value List for building interactive definition controls; provides continuous numeric range vs. discrete Value List presets

33bcf975-a0b2-4b54-99fd-585c893b9e88.errors: No inputs to wire incorrectly; downstream errors occur if connected param expects integer but scroller outputs float, or if value is out expected range for target component

33bfc73c-19b2-480b-81e6-f3523a012ea6.name: Plane Fit
33bfc73c-19b2-480b-81e6-f3523a012ea6.quick: Fits a best-fit plane through a point cloud; outputs plane and deviation (dx) | requires multiple points
33bfc73c-19b2-480b-81e6-f3523a012ea6.description: Fit a plane through a set of points.

contexts.point_cloud_analysis: Feed list of 3D points into P; outputs best-fit Pl (origin+orientation) and dx (RMS deviation). Wire dx to Panel to assess planarity quality.
contexts.surface_normal_estimation: Use with Deconstruct Plane on output Pl to extract normal vector from scattered point data. Useful for aligning geometry to irregular point sets.
contexts.flatness_checking: dx output indicates how far points deviate from fitted plane — larger dx means less planar. Compare dx threshold to validate fabrication tolerances.

33bfc73c-19b2-480b-81e6-f3523a012ea6.errors: Fails or returns null if fewer than 3 non-collinear points provided. Collinear points produce undefined plane orientation. Single point input will not define a plane.

33eb59b9-5f81-4ef5-8c89-46e6e744522b.name: Timeline
33eb59b9-5f81-4ef5-8c89-46e6e744522b.quick: Maps a Domain (time range) to a Number output via a graphical timeline curve | Domain input sets the time range

contexts.animation_driving: Connect a Domain (e.g., {0,1}) to A; timeline's graphical curve maps positions within that domain to Number values, useful for driving animated parameters over time
contexts.value_sequencing: Wire output Number to sliders or transform inputs; pairs with Number Set for defining mutable value sequences across a time range

33eb59b9-5f81-4ef5-8c89-46e6e744522b.errors: Wrong input type: A expects a Domain, not a plain number — passing a Number instead of Domain will fail. Empty or invalid Domain (e.g., reversed bounds) may produce unexpected output values.

342aa574-1327-4bc2-8daf-203da2a45676.name: Fit Loft
342aa574-1327-4bc2-8daf-203da2a45676.quick: Fits a loft surface through curves using degree/count controls | Nu, Du, Dv control surface parameterization
342aa574-1327-4bc2-8daf-203da2a45676.description: Create a loft fitted through a set of curves.

contexts.basic_loft_fitting: Connect list of curves to C; set Nu (point count), Du (degree u), Dv (degree v) as integers. Outputs single fitted Surface S spanning all input curves.
contexts.degree_control: Du and Dv control surface degree in u and v directions; Nu controls number of fit points. Higher values increase smoothness but may deviate from curves.
contexts.comparison_with_loft: Unlike standard Loft (interpolates exactly), Fit Loft approximates through curves — useful when exact interpolation causes kinks or irregularities.

342aa574-1327-4bc2-8daf-203da2a45676.errors: Fails if curves are incompatible types or not sorted spatially; Nu too low may produce poor fit; non-planar or self-intersecting curves likely cause surface errors.

345fd8f8-5fb0-4907-99fd-f21f3963e9b3.name: Tolerance Settings
345fd8f8-5fb0-4907-99fd-f21f3963e9b3.quick: Outputs Rhino document tolerance settings collection; no inputs required | used to pass tolerance data to annotation/dimension components
345fd8f8-5fb0-4907-99fd-f21f3963e9b3.description: Contains a collection of tolerance settings

contexts.annotation_setup: Wire output into Dimension Settings or Leader Settings components to apply document tolerances to annotation styles; no inputs needed, reads from active Rhino document
contexts.tolerance_propagation: Used alongside Arrow Settings, Text Settings, Dimension Settings as part of a full annotation style configuration pipeline

345fd8f8-5fb0-4907-99fd-f21f3963e9b3.errors: No inputs to misconfigure; output may reflect unexpected values if active Rhino document tolerance differs from intended — verify document units and tolerance before use

347f62f4-3c6e-4156-a92e-49cb5ade89dc.name: Model Hatch Pattern
347f62f4-3c6e-4156-a92e-49cb5ade89dc.quick: Stores/references model hatch patterns from Rhino document | no inputs, outputs pattern collection for use in hatching ops
347f62f4-3c6e-4156-a92e-49cb5ade89dc.description: Contains a collection of model hatch patterns

contexts.hatch_application: Connect output to hatch components requiring a pattern definition; pattern must exist in Rhino model document before use; acts as a parameter container like Model Layer or Model Material
contexts.pattern_selection: Right-click component to select specific hatch pattern from model; outputs collection of available patterns defined in the active Rhino file

347f62f4-3c6e-4156-a92e-49cb5ade89dc.errors: Fails or returns null if referenced hatch pattern does not exist in the Rhino model; no inputs means pattern availability depends entirely on Rhino document state

34a22050-8484-44cf-b2ee-974739434b18.name: Integer
34a22050-8484-44cf-b2ee-974739434b18.quick: Stores/passes integer values; truncates decimals if floats are connected
34a22050-8484-44cf-b2ee-974739434b18.description: Contains a collection of integer numbers

contexts.constant_input: Right-click to set value; used to feed fixed whole numbers (counts, indices, iterations) into components expecting integers
contexts.type_conversion: Wire from Number or Slider to coerce float to integer; decimal part is dropped (floor), not rounded
contexts.list_storage: Can hold multiple integers; set via right-click > Manage Integer Collection for batch values

34a22050-8484-44cf-b2ee-974739434b18.errors: Floats silently truncated to int; non-numeric text input causes type mismatch; no inputs means value must be set manually or wired

350f7d03-a48f-4121-bcee-328cfe1ed9ef.name: Split ARGB
350f7d03-a48f-4121-bcee-328cfe1ed9ef.quick: Splits a colour into Alpha, Red, Green, Blue float channels (0.0–1.0 range) | Input must be a Colour type
350f7d03-a48f-4121-bcee-328cfe1ed9ef.description: Split a colour into floating point {ARGB} channels.

contexts.color_analysis: Wire a Colour param into C; outputs A, R, G, B as floats (0–1). Use alongside Colour Swatch or Colour RGB to inspect or remap individual channels.
contexts.channel_manipulation: Extract individual channels to modify (e.g., boost R, reduce B), then recombine with Colour ARGB or similar to reconstruct a modified colour.
contexts.comparison_with_split_ahsl: Use Split ARGB for RGB-space operations; use Split AHSL (neighbor) when working in hue/saturation/lightness space for perceptual adjustments.

350f7d03-a48f-4121-bcee-328cfe1ed9ef.errors: No Colour input causes null outputs; non-Colour types (e.g., raw numbers or strings) will fail — ensure upstream component outputs a proper Colour. All outputs are floats 0–1, not 0–255.

3653cf51-4fa3-473b-b742-746c59a33796.name: Object Display Colour
3653cf51-4fa3-473b-b742-746c59a33796.quick: Stores a collection of object display colours; no inputs, outputs colour data for Rhino objects.
3653cf51-4fa3-473b-b742-746c59a33796.description: Contains a collection of object display colours

contexts.querying_object_colors: Use alongside Query Model Objects to retrieve display colours of Rhino geometry; output feeds into Display Colour or other object attribute components for inspection or filtering.
contexts.object_attribute_pipeline: Pairs with Render Material, Object Linetype, Drafting Attributes to build a full object attribute query workflow; output represents per-object display colour collection.

3653cf51-4fa3-473b-b742-746c59a33796.errors: No inputs means no user configuration; errors likely arise if downstream components expect a specific colour type and receive mismatched data, or if no objects exist in the document.

36dd5551-b6bd-4246-bd2f-1fd91eb2f02d.name: Orthocentre
36dd5551-b6bd-4246-bd2f-1fd91eb2f02d.quick: Computes triangle orthocentre (intersection of altitudes) from 3 points; outputs orthocentre point and 3 altitude lines.
36dd5551-b6bd-4246-bd2f-1fd91eb2f02d.description: Generate the triangle orthocentre from altitudes.

contexts.triangle_geometry: Wire three Point params to A, B, C inputs. Output C is the orthocentre point; AB, BC, CA are the altitude lines from each vertex perpendicular to the opposite side.
contexts.geometric_analysis: Use alongside Circumcentre or Centroid components to compare triangle centers. Feed same A/B/C points to multiple triangle-center components for comparison.

36dd5551-b6bd-4246-bd2f-1fd91eb2f02d.errors: Degenerate (collinear) points cause orthocentre to be at infinity or undefined — ensure A, B, C are non-collinear. Output param 'C' shares name with input 'C'; take care when wiring to avoid confusion.

37084b3f-2b66-4f3a-9737-80d0b0b7f0cb.name: Extremes
37084b3f-2b66-4f3a-9737-80d0b0b7f0cb.quick: Finds min and max values from two inputs A and B | outputs V- (minimum) and V+ (maximum)
37084b3f-2b66-4f3a-9737-80d0b0b7f0cb.description: Find the extremes in a list of values

contexts.range_finding: Wire two numeric lists or values to A and B; V- returns the lesser extreme, V+ returns the greater extreme. Useful before Clamp or Remap to establish domain bounds.
contexts.data_analysis: Feed a flattened list split across A and B to extract overall min/max in one step, replacing separate Minimum/Maximum components.

37084b3f-2b66-4f3a-9737-80d0b0b7f0cb.errors: Non-numeric generic data may cause type mismatch; mismatched list lengths between A and B could produce unexpected pairing behavior via Grasshopper's default list matching.

3756c55f-95c3-442c-a027-6b3ab0455a94.name: Match Text
3756c55f-95c3-442c-a027-6b3ab0455a94.quick: Tests if text T matches pattern P; returns Boolean | inputs R and C suggest regex and case-sensitivity options
3756c55f-95c3-442c-a027-6b3ab0455a94.description: Match a text against a pattern

contexts.filter_by_pattern: Wire text strings to T, regex or wildcard pattern to P; toggle C for case-sensitive matching; use M (Boolean) to cull/filter lists via Dispatch or Cull Pattern
contexts.regex_matching: Set R input to enable regex mode; connect pattern string to P; M outputs True/False per item — useful for validating formatted strings like codes or IDs
contexts.case_insensitive_search: Set C to False to ignore case; pair with Text Split or Text Fragment to pre-process text before matching

3756c55f-95c3-442c-a027-6b3ab0455a94.errors: M returns all False if pattern syntax is invalid or R flag mismatches pattern type; null/empty T or P inputs cause matching failures; list length mismatches between T and P may cause unexpected results

383929c0-6515-4899-8b4b-3bd0d0b32471.name: Import PDB
383929c0-6515-4899-8b4b-3bd0d0b32471.quick: Reads .pdb (Protein Data Bank) files; F input must be a valid file path string | outputs Atom data and Bond Lines
383929c0-6515-4899-8b4b-3bd0d0b32471.description: Import data from Protein Data Bank *.pdb files.

contexts.molecular_visualization: Wire a file path string (from Panel or File Path param) into F; outputs A (Atom positions/data) and B (Bond lines) for downstream geometry or analysis components
contexts.file_loading: Pair with a File Path or string Panel pointing to a local .pdb file; B output gives Line geometry usable directly in Rhino viewport

383929c0-6515-4899-8b4b-3bd0d0b32471.errors: Fails if F is not a valid .pdb file path or file is missing/malformed; empty outputs if path resolves to wrong file type; no observations available so infer from Text input constraint

38a4e722-ad5a-4229-a170-e27ae1345538.name: Date Range
38a4e722-ad5a-4229-a170-e27ae1345538.quick: Creates N evenly spaced Time values between start A and end B | N controls count of steps
38a4e722-ad5a-4229-a170-e27ae1345538.description: Create a range of successive dates or times

contexts.time_series_generation: Wire Construct Date or Combine Date & Time into A and B; set N integer for step count; outputs R as list of Time values for scheduling or animation
contexts.interpolated_schedule: Pair with Interpolate Date for non-uniform spacing; Date Range gives uniform steps between two Time inputs across N intervals

38a4e722-ad5a-4229-a170-e27ae1345538.errors: Wrong type on A or B (must be Time, not plain number); N=0 or N=1 may produce empty or single-point output; mismatched date formats from Date Time Format can cause parse failures upstream

38e8f2e0-b77e-4fca-a503-1ca350dd8791.name: Deconstruct Material
38e8f2e0-b77e-4fca-a503-1ca350dd8791.quick: Deconstruct Material | Inputs: M → Kd, Ks, Ke
38e8f2e0-b77e-4fca-a503-1ca350dd8791.description: Deconstruct a display material (ie. shader) into its various attributes

39304976-7d5b-4dbc-b913-147bc3340e32.name: Model Content
39304976-7d5b-4dbc-b913-147bc3340e32.quick: Holds a collection of model content elements (materials, layers, objects, etc.) | No inputs; acts as a container/source parameter
39304976-7d5b-4dbc-b913-147bc3340e32.description: Contains a collection of model content elements

contexts.pipeline_source: Used as a starting point in model content workflows; outputs feed into components expecting model content collections like Model Material, Model Layer, or Model Object downstream
contexts.content_aggregation: Pairs with Model Material, Model Layer, Model Object, Model Action to bundle Rhino model content elements for export or processing pipelines

39304976-7d5b-4dbc-b913-147bc3340e32.errors: No inputs means data must be set via right-click; empty output if no content is assigned or baked into the parameter

3a0c7bda-3d22-4588-8bab-03f57a52a6ea.name: Plane Offset
3a0c7bda-3d22-4588-8bab-03f57a52a6ea.quick: Moves a plane's origin along its Z-axis by offset distance O | O is a number (distance), not a vector

contexts.stack_planes_along_z: Feed World XY Plane into P, drive O with a number slider or series; outputs offset plane for lofts, levels, or repeated geometry along Z
contexts.parametric_levels: Use with Series component to generate multiple evenly-spaced planes; each plane retains original X/Y orientation, only origin shifts along normal
contexts.custom_plane_offset: Wire Construct Plane output into P to offset along a custom normal direction; O controls distance along that plane's Z-axis

3a0c7bda-3d22-4588-8bab-03f57a52a6ea.errors: Wrong offset axis: O moves origin along plane's own Z (normal), not world Z — mismatched results if plane is tilted. Non-numeric O input causes type error. Null plane input produces no output.

3aa2a080-e322-4be3-8c6e-baf6c8000cf1.name: Deconstruct Matrix
3aa2a080-e322-4be3-8c6e-baf6c8000cf1.quick: Breaks a matrix into row count (R), column count (C), and flat list of values (V) | V outputs all values as a flat Number list
3aa2a080-e322-4be3-8c6e-baf6c8000cf1.description: Deconstruct a matrix into its component parts

contexts.inspecting_matrix_dimensions: Wire any Matrix into M; R and C give integer row/column counts. Useful after Construct Matrix or Transpose Matrix to verify dimensions before further operations.
contexts.extracting_values: V outputs all matrix values as a flat Number list (row-major order). Use Partition List with C to reconstruct rows, or feed into math/analysis components.
contexts.round_trip_workflow: Deconstruct Matrix → modify V values → Construct Matrix using same R, C to rebuild. Common pattern for element-wise matrix manipulation.

3aa2a080-e322-4be3-8c6e-baf6c8000cf1.errors: Null or unconnected M input causes no output. V is a flat list — row/column structure is lost; must use R and C to re-partition if needed.

3abbde21-9106-4846-882a-d1f8ca791cc0.name: Object Render
3abbde21-9106-4846-882a-d1f8ca791cc0.quick: Stores/passes object render attributes collection | No inputs; acts as a parameter container for render settings
3abbde21-9106-4846-882a-d1f8ca791cc0.description: Contains a collection of object render attributes

contexts.pipeline_passthrough: Used inline with Model Object, Object Display Colour, Object Print Colour, Object Print Width to bundle render attributes; output feeds downstream display or export components
contexts.attribute_collection: Acts as a typed parameter holding render attribute data; wire into components expecting render attribute inputs to preserve Rhino object render settings

3abbde21-9106-4846-882a-d1f8ca791cc0.errors: No inputs means it only holds/passes existing render attribute data; fails if downstream component expects a different attribute type (e.g., colour or linetype instead of render)

3b1ae469-0e9b-461d-8c30-fa5a7de8b7a9.name: Mesh | Plane
3b1ae469-0e9b-461d-8c30-fa5a7de8b7a9.quick: Intersects a mesh with a plane to produce section curves | mesh must be valid/closed for clean results
3b1ae469-0e9b-461d-8c30-fa5a7de8b7a9.description: Solve intersection events for a Mesh and a Plane (otherwise known as section).

contexts.mesh_sectioning: Wire a Mesh (M) and a Plane (P) to get polyline section curves (C); plane origin and normal define cut position/angle; useful for contour slicing workflows
contexts.contour_generation: Chain multiple planes (e.g., from Series-offset origins) into this component to generate stacked section curves across a mesh for fabrication or analysis
contexts.comparison_with_brep_section: Use when geometry is mesh-based rather than NURBS; output C is polyline curves, not smooth NURBS curves as with Brep | Plane

3b1ae469-0e9b-461d-8c30-fa5a7de8b7a9.errors: Returns null/empty C if plane misses mesh entirely; open or degenerate meshes may produce incomplete or disconnected curve segments; non-manifold mesh topology can cause unexpected gaps

3b6151d3-7907-4d4a-8761-d7d6ea2bf32c.name: Mesh Flip
3b6151d3-7907-4d4a-8761-d7d6ea2bf32c.quick: Reverses mesh face winding order (flips normals) | single Mesh input/output
3b6151d3-7907-4d4a-8761-d7d6ea2bf32c.description: Reverse the direction of the mesh

contexts.fixing_inverted_normals: Wire problematic mesh into M; output mesh has reversed face directions. Often used before Mesh Join or rendering when faces appear inside-out.
contexts.pre_processing: Chain after Mesh Brep or Mesh Surface when generated mesh normals point inward; flip before further mesh operations.

3b6151d3-7907-4d4a-8761-d7d6ea2bf32c.errors: No output if input M is null or invalid mesh. Distinct from 'Flip Mesh' neighbor — confirm correct component is used; both flip normals but may differ in behavior with open/closed meshes.

3bbd57f0-d6d7-4863-ab2b-d094015b286c.name: Model Hatch
3bbd57f0-d6d7-4863-ab2b-d094015b286c.quick: Defines/edits a model hatch with pattern, rotation, scale on a surface or boundary curve | requires valid Hatch Pattern input

contexts.creating_hatch: Wire a closed Curve to B (boundary), a Model Hatch Pattern from Model Hatch Pattern component to Hp, set R (rotation angle) and S (scale) as Numbers; outputs H (Hatch geometry) for display or baking
contexts.editing_existing_hatch: Feed existing H (Hatch) into H input to modify pattern, scale, rotation, or color properties; outputs mirror all inputs for downstream use
contexts.styled_hatch: Connect Bc (Colour) and Fs (Colour Gradient) for fill styling; use Sb Boolean to toggle solid background fill; pair with Model Linetype for boundary line control

3bbd57f0-d6d7-4863-ab2b-d094015b286c.errors: <~30 tokens: Null Hp (no pattern) causes empty hatch; B must be closed planar curve/surface; mismatched plane P causes misaligned pattern origin

3cfd77d3-30d0-45f6-adeb-ea8defed58d3.name: Annotation Tolerance Settings
3cfd77d3-30d0-45f6-adeb-ea8defed58d3.quick: Get/set tolerance sub-settings within an annotation style | pass Tolerance Settings object through To input

contexts.reading_tolerance: Connect annotation style's tolerance settings to To input; outputs Tf (format), Tr (resolution), Ar (angular resolution), Uv/Lv (upper/lower values), Hs (height scale) for inspection
contexts.modifying_tolerance: Wire existing Tolerance Settings to To, override specific integer/number inputs (Tf, Tr, Ar, Uv, Lv, Hs), output modified To back into annotation style pipeline alongside Arrow/Dimension/Units/Text settings

3cfd77d3-30d0-45f6-adeb-ea8defed58d3.errors: Null output if To input is disconnected or invalid type; integer inputs (Tf, Tr, Ar) will fail if floats are wired; mismatched annotation style version may produce empty settings

3da3fd40-b2fb-483c-8d1a-1b557eba66cd.name: User Text
3da3fd40-b2fb-483c-8d1a-1b557eba66cd.quick: Read/write key-value user text on Rhino model elements | V input is Generic Data, output is Text
3da3fd40-b2fb-483c-8d1a-1b557eba66cd.description: Modify the key/value pair text collection of a model element.

contexts.tagging_elements: Wire model content (C) from Content Cache, provide key string (K) and value (V) to attach metadata; outputs modified content back for pushing to model
contexts.filtering_by_user_text: Chain output K/V into Match Text Filter or Equality Filter to query elements by their user text attributes
contexts.reading_existing_text: Connect model element to C input with empty K to retrieve existing key-value pairs; V output returns text representation of stored values

3da3fd40-b2fb-483c-8d1a-1b557eba66cd.errors: <~30 tokens: C must be valid model content or null; V accepts generic data but outputs as Text — non-text values may lose fidelity on conversion>

3de3d3a0-1a1b-488c-b3d9-3fba0fdf07a8.name: Aligned Dimension
3de3d3a0-1a1b-488c-b3d9-3fba0fdf07a8.quick: Creates a distance annotation between two points along their actual alignment | Plane sets annotation orientation; O offsets dimension line
3de3d3a0-1a1b-488c-b3d9-3fba0fdf07a8.description: Create a distance annotation between two points

contexts.basic_annotation: Wire two Points (A, B) and a Plane (P) to display measured distance; O (number) offsets the dimension line away from points; T overrides label text; S sets text size
contexts.custom_label: Set T input to override the auto-calculated distance text with custom string; useful for units or formatted output
contexts.orientation_control: P (Plane) determines the coordinate system for annotation display; align plane to view or geometry face for readable dimensions

3de3d3a0-1a1b-488c-b3d9-3fba0fdf07a8.errors: No outputs — purely visual annotation; nothing to wire downstream. Missing A or B points causes no display. Plane mismatch may render dimension off-axis or invisible in viewport.

3dfb9a77-6e05-4016-9f20-94f78607d672.name: Rotate 3D
3dfb9a77-6e05-4016-9f20-94f78607d672.quick: Rotate 3D | Inputs: Geometry, Angle, Center → Geometry

3e7e4827-6edd-4e10-93ac-cc234414d2b9.name: Contour (ex)
3e7e4827-6edd-4e10-93ac-cc234414d2b9.quick: Creates contour points along a curve at intervals defined by distance D, offset from plane P | outputs Points and parameters, not curves
3e7e4827-6edd-4e10-93ac-cc234414d2b9.description: Create a set of Curve contours

contexts.sampling_curve_at_intervals: Wire a Curve to C, define a base Plane P (e.g., XY plane), set offset O and step Distance D as Numbers; outputs contour intersection Points and t parameters along the curve
contexts.extracting_parameter_values: Use output t (Number) to feed into Evaluate Curve or Shatter to split curve at contour locations; pairs well with Shatter neighbor
contexts.controlling_contour_density: Adjust D (distance between contours) to control point density; smaller D yields more points; O shifts the starting offset from the plane

3e7e4827-6edd-4e10-93ac-cc234414d2b9.errors: No curves output — component outputs Points (C) and parameters (t), not curve segments; wrong plane orientation may miss intersections entirely; D=0 causes infinite loop or no output

3e972aa1-906f-4957-9e1f-956cb1429030.name: Object Print Colour
3e972aa1-906f-4957-9e1f-956cb1429030.quick: Stores/outputs object print colour values for Rhino geometry | parameter container with no inputs
3e972aa1-906f-4957-9e1f-956cb1429030.description: Contains a collection of object print colours

contexts.print_attribute_pipeline: Used alongside Object Print Width, Object Linetype to define print attributes; output feeds into object attribute components or Model Object for print-ready geometry.
contexts.display_override: Paired with Object Display Mode or Object Render to bundle full display/print attribute sets for Rhino model objects.

3e972aa1-906f-4957-9e1f-956cb1429030.errors: No inputs means no wiring errors; downstream failures likely if output colour type mismatches expected colour parameter in receiving component.

3eba04bc-00e8-416d-b58f-a3dc8b3e22e2.name: Trim with Brep
3eba04bc-00e8-416d-b58f-a3dc8b3e22e2.quick: Trims curve with a Brep, returning inside (Ci) and outside (Co) portions | Brep must be closed/valid surface
3eba04bc-00e8-416d-b58f-a3dc8b3e22e2.description: Trim a curve with a Brep.

contexts.clipping_curve_to_surface: Connect a curve to C and a closed Brep to B; Ci returns segments inside the Brep, Co returns segments outside. Useful for masking curves to a solid boundary.
contexts.single_brep_vs_multiple: Use this for one Brep trimmer; for multiple Breps use 'Trim with Breps' neighbor. For 2D region trimming, use 'Trim with Region' instead.
contexts.split_vs_trim: Unlike 'Split with Brep' which only splits, this component explicitly separates inside/outside segments into Ci and Co outputs for direct downstream use.

3eba04bc-00e8-416d-b58f-a3dc8b3e22e2.errors: Null output if Brep is open/invalid or curve doesn't intersect Brep. Co/Ci may be empty lists if curve is entirely inside or outside. Degenerate Brep geometry causes silent failure.

3ec83758-5dcf-4f26-9400-f8232f471b88.name: Drafting Attributes
3ec83758-5dcf-4f26-9400-f8232f471b88.quick: Get/set drafting attributes (linetype, linetype scale) on Rhino objects | inputs/outputs mirror each other for get-or-set pattern

contexts.reading_drafting_attrs: Connect object from Query Model Objects → Dr input to extract current Linetype and Scale (S) values without modifying them
contexts.setting_linetype_scale: Wire desired Linetype (from Object Linetype) and Number for scale into L and S inputs alongside Dr to override drafting attributes on objects
contexts.pipeline_with_render: Used alongside Render Attributes and Object Display Colour to fully configure object appearance before baking into Rhino document

3ec83758-5dcf-4f26-9400-f8232f471b88.errors: <~30 tokens: Null Dr input returns no outputs; mismatched Linetype type (non-linetype data) causes type error on L input>

3ed4d673-02f6-48f7-aa81-69587f83e201.name: Model Hatch Line
3ed4d673-02f6-48f7-aa81-69587f83e201.quick: Defines a hatch line with spacing (S), direction vector (D), and offset (O) | Used as input to Model Hatch Pattern

contexts.building_hatch_pattern: Wire L (Hatch Line) output into Model Hatch Pattern to compose custom hatch definitions; set S for line spacing, D for direction vector, O for offset shift between lines
contexts.decomposing_existing: Pass existing Hatch Line into L input to extract S, D, O parameters for inspection or modification before rebuilding

3ed4d673-02f6-48f7-aa81-69587f83e201.errors: Wrong type on S or O (must be Number, not integer list); D must be a Vector not a line/curve; mismatched data trees between multiple hatch lines may cause pattern misalignment

3ed98048-ed09-41ef-b378-74c60c8d3e9a.name: Query Model Objects
3ed98048-ed09-41ef-b378-74c60c8d3e9a.quick: Queries Rhino doc for model objects; filter by Name (N), Layer (L), Group (G), Locked (Lo), Hidden (Ho) patterns
3ed98048-ed09-41ef-b378-74c60c8d3e9a.description: Query a Rhino document for all available model objects

contexts.filter_by_layer: Set L to a text pattern (e.g., 'Layer 01') to retrieve only objects on matching layers; wire O to Object Display Colour or Render Material for attribute extraction
