47c30f9d-b685-4d4d-9b20-5b60e48d5af8.name: Deconstruct Domain²
47c30f9d-b685-4d4d-9b20-5b60e48d5af8.quick: Extracts U0, U1, V0, V1 bounds from a 2D Domain² | Input must be Domain², not two separate domains
47c30f9d-b685-4d4d-9b20-5b60e48d5af8.description: Deconstruct a two-dimensional domain into four numbers

contexts.surface_domain_analysis: Wire Surface Domain output (Domain²) directly to I; get U0/U1 for U-range and V0/V1 for V-range; use with Divide Domain² or remap operations
contexts.rebuilding_domains: Extract bounds to manipulate individually, then reconstruct with Construct Domain² using modified values
contexts.range_extraction: Feed U0/U1 or V0/V1 into Construct Domain or numeric operations to isolate one axis of a 2D domain

47c30f9d-b685-4d4d-9b20-5b60e48d5af8.errors: Fails if input is not a Domain² type — passing two separate 1D domains or numbers won't work; must use Construct Domain² first to combine them

47fbc929-e88a-4a13-882e-dad84763256d.name: Flip Mesh
47fbc929-e88a-4a13-882e-dad84763256d.quick: Flips mesh normals via vertex (Vn), face (Fn), or face orientation (Fo) booleans | all three booleans default to false — must enable at least one
47fbc929-e88a-4a13-882e-dad84763256d.description: Flip the normal vectors of a mesh

contexts.fixing_inverted_normals: Connect mesh to M, set Fn=True to flip face normals when mesh renders inside-out or lighting appears reversed. Use after Mesh Brep or Mesh Join when normals are inconsistent.
contexts.vertex_normal_correction: Set Vn=True to flip vertex normals independently of face normals — useful for smooth-shaded meshes where shading looks wrong but geometry is correct.
contexts.face_orientation_reversal: Set Fo=True to reverse face winding order (orientation), effectively flipping which side is front-facing. Often combined with Fn for complete normal reversal.

47fbc929-e88a-4a13-882e-dad84763256d.errors: Outputting unchanged mesh if no boolean inputs are set to True. Null output if M is not a valid mesh. Partial flip if only one of Vn/Fn/Fo is toggled when all three are needed.

481f0339-1299-43ba-b15c-c07891a8f822.name: Merge 03
481f0339-1299-43ba-b15c-c07891a8f822.quick: Merges three data streams (A, B, C) into one output S | preserves tree structure of each input

contexts.combining_geometry: Wire three geometry lists/trees into A, B, C; output S contains all items sequentially. Use when you need exactly 3 sources combined before further operations.
contexts.data_aggregation: Collect outputs from three parallel branches into single stream. Pairs naturally with Stream Filter or Stream Gate to split/redirect afterward.
contexts.replacing_multiple_merges: Use instead of chaining two Merge-2 components when combining exactly 3 streams, reducing node count.

481f0339-1299-43ba-b15c-c07891a8f822.errors: Mismatched tree structures across A/B/C may cause unintended data alignment; if more than 3 streams needed, use Merge Multiple instead.

488c5ae8-f802-4994-b1d1-31a467a77399.name: Logical Or Filter
488c5ae8-f802-4994-b1d1-31a467a77399.quick: Combines two Predicate filters with OR logic; outputs true if either A or B evaluates to true.
488c5ae8-f802-4994-b1d1-31a467a77399.description: Combine two filters together using a logical OR operator.

contexts.filter_combination: Wire two Predicate outputs (e.g., Equality Filter, Less Than Filter) into A and B; resulting F predicate passes elements matching either condition. Chain with Logical And Filter for complex logic.
contexts.rhino_object_filtering: Use alongside Equality Filter or Less Than Filter to broaden selection criteria on Rhino model elements; F feeds into downstream filter consumers or Intersection Filter.

488c5ae8-f802-4994-b1d1-31a467a77399.errors: Fails if A or B are not valid Predicate types; incompatible non-predicate inputs will cause type mismatch. Both inputs required — leaving one unwired may produce null predicate.

48a9fa10-8d3c-4767-aca6-81232271f6e0.name: Blur Mesh
48a9fa10-8d3c-4767-aca6-81232271f6e0.quick: Blurs vertex colours on a mesh by averaging neighbours | mesh must have vertex colours assigned; I controls blur iterations
48a9fa10-8d3c-4767-aca6-81232271f6e0.description: Blur the colours on a mesh

contexts.colour_smoothing: Connect a coloured mesh to M input; set I (integer) to number of blur passes (e.g. 1–10). Higher I = smoother colour gradient. Typically used after assigning per-vertex colours via Mesh Colour component.
contexts.analysis_visualization: Used to smooth analysis results mapped as mesh colours. Wire analysis-coloured mesh → Blur Mesh → Custom Preview to produce smooth gradient visualizations from noisy per-vertex data.

48a9fa10-8d3c-4767-aca6-81232271f6e0.errors: If mesh has no vertex colours, output mesh is unchanged or errors silently. I=0 returns unmodified mesh. Non-integer or negative I values will fail type conversion. Mesh must be valid and joined before blurring.

494d3ec5-c6b4-420e-9417-37278cf94ee2.name: Duplicate Content
494d3ec5-c6b4-420e-9417-37278cf94ee2.quick: Duplicates Model Content with a new identity (cleared ID); optionally set new name via N input.
494d3ec5-c6b4-420e-9417-37278cf94ee2.description:
Duplicates input content with a new identity.
Clears the current content Id and optionally lets you set a new parent and name.

contexts.cloning_content: Wire existing Model Content into C, optionally provide a Text name via N. Output is a duplicate with cleared content ID, ready for independent use or pushing to Rhino model via Content Cache.
contexts.renaming_content: Use N input (Text) to assign a new name to the duplicated content, useful before grouping or ordering with Group Content / Order Content components.
contexts.pipeline_isolation: Use before modifying or caching content to avoid mutating the original; ensures downstream changes don't affect source content identity.

494d3ec5-c6b4-420e-9417-37278cf94ee2.errors: Fails if C input is null or not valid Model Content. N is optional; omitting it leaves name unchanged. No output if input content is disconnected.

49d2e200-b34e-4e1c-82a3-07feb4cb9378.name: Colour RGB
49d2e200-b34e-4e1c-82a3-07feb4cb9378.quick: Creates a Colour from integer RGBA channels (0–255 each) | All inputs are integers, not floats

contexts.mesh_coloring: Wire integer sliders (0–255) into R, G, B; feed output C into Mesh Colour or Custom Preview. A controls opacity (255=fully opaque).
contexts.gradient_generation: Use Series or Range to generate integer sequences for R/G/B channels, creating lists of colours for data visualization or gradient effects.
contexts.display_override: Connect C output to Custom Preview component's Shader input to override geometry display colour in viewport.

49d2e200-b34e-4e1c-82a3-07feb4cb9378.errors: <~30 tokens: Values outside 0–255 may clamp or error; float inputs auto-cast but decimals truncate; A defaults to 255 if unset.

4a0180e5-d8f9-46e7-bd34-ced804601462.name: Settings (Custom)
4a0180e5-d8f9-46e7-bd34-ced804601462.quick: Builds custom MeshParameters object | All numeric inputs control mesh density/quality tolerances

contexts.mesh_brep_control: Wire S output into Mesh Brep's Settings input; tune Max Dist, Max Angle, Min/Max Edge for precision vs. speed tradeoff
contexts.mesh_surface_control: Connect to Mesh Surface Settings input; use Min/Max integers to set grid divisions, Aspect to control quad shape
contexts.quality_tuning: Refine (bool) enables refinement pass; Stitch (bool) welds mesh edges; Planes (bool) affects planar face handling

4a0180e5-d8f9-46e7-bd34-ced804601462.errors: Leaving Max Dist/Max Angle at 0 may produce overly coarse or no mesh; Min > Max on edge/grid params causes invalid settings; non-connected to a meshing component produces no visible output

4ac24770-e38b-4363-be38-551a3b134707.name: Make2D Rhino View
4ac24770-e38b-4363-be38-551a3b134707.quick: Imports an existing Rhino named view for use in Make2D | N must match exact Rhino view name
4ac24770-e38b-4363-be38-551a3b134707.description: Import a Rhino view for a Make2D solution

contexts.make2d_workflow: Wire V output into Make2D component's view input; N (Text) is the Rhino viewport/named-view name string; C (Boolean) likely toggles clipping or capture; pairs with Make2D Perspective/Parallel View alternatives
contexts.named_view_reference: Use when geometry must be projected using a saved Rhino named view rather than a custom-defined camera; N must exactly match a view name present in the open Rhino document

4ac24770-e38b-4363-be38-551a3b134707.errors: Fails silently or returns null V if N doesn't match any existing Rhino view name; Boolean C likely has no effect if view name is invalid

4ad6703b-84cd-4957-a1b3-f1c6ec270d9c.name: Constant
4ad6703b-84cd-4957-a1b3-f1c6ec270d9c.quick: Defines a named document-wide constant for use in Expression components; no inputs or outputs — value set internally.
4ad6703b-84cd-4957-a1b3-f1c6ec270d9c.description: Define a document-wide constant for use in Expressions

contexts.expression_variable: Set a named constant (e.g., PI, tolerance) once; reference it by name inside Expression components across the document to avoid hardcoding repeated values.
contexts.global_parameter: Use alongside Integer, Domain, or Text params to centralize a shared value; changing the Constant updates all referencing Expressions simultaneously.

4ad6703b-84cd-4957-a1b3-f1c6ec270d9c.errors: No wired inputs/outputs — constant value must be defined inside the component itself; referencing an undefined or misspelled constant name in an Expression will silently fail or return null.

4b59e893-d4ee-4e31-ae24-a489611d1088.name: Spin Force
4b59e893-d4ee-4e31-ae24-a489611d1088.quick: Creates a rotational spin force field from a plane | Plane sets spin axis/origin; S=strength, R=radius, D=decay
4b59e893-d4ee-4e31-ae24-a489611d1088.description: Create a field due to a spin force

contexts.field_visualization: Wire F output to Direction Display, Scalar Display, or Tensor Display to visualize spin field vectors/scalars over a section plane with a bounding Box (B)
contexts.combining_fields: Output F can be merged with other field components (e.g., Line Charge) using field addition/merge nodes to create composite force fields
contexts.spin_axis_control: Input P (Plane) defines the spin axis orientation and center; adjust S (strength) and R (radius) to control influence zone, D controls falloff decay rate

4b59e893-d4ee-4e31-ae24-a489611d1088.errors: Null output if P is not a valid plane; B (Box) input likely bounds field evaluation — missing or undersized box may yield empty display results; zero or negative R may cause undefined field behavior

4b87eb13-f87c-4ff1-ae0e-6c9f1f2aecbd.name: Fillet Edge
4b87eb13-f87c-4ff1-ae0e-6c9f1f2aecbd.quick: Fillet Edge | Inputs: S, B, M, E → B
4b87eb13-f87c-4ff1-ae0e-6c9f1f2aecbd.description: Fillet some edges of a brep.

4bdc2eb0-24ed-4c90-a27b-a32db069eaef.name: Split with Brep
4bdc2eb0-24ed-4c90-a27b-a32db069eaef.quick: Splits a curve at intersection points with a Brep; outputs curve segments and intersection points | Brep must actually intersect the curve
4bdc2eb0-24ed-4c90-a27b-a32db069eaef.description: Split a curve with a Brep.

contexts.cutting_curve_with_surface: Wire a Curve into C and a Brep (surface or solid) into B; outputs split curve segments and intersection points P. Use when you need all resulting pieces, unlike Trim which discards portions.
contexts.finding_intersection_points: Output P gives the intersection points between curve and Brep; useful for extracting exact hit locations on the Brep face.
contexts.single_vs_multiple_breps: For splitting against multiple Breps at once, use Split with Breps neighbor instead; this component handles one Brep input only.

4bdc2eb0-24ed-4c90-a27b-a32db069eaef.errors: No output if curve and Brep do not intersect; open Breps may produce unexpected splits if curve grazes edge; null output if either input is invalid geometry.

4c02a168-9aba-4f42-8951-2719f24d391f.name: Mesh | Ray
4c02a168-9aba-4f42-8951-2719f24d391f.quick: Casts a ray from point P in direction D and finds where it hits mesh M | ray is semi-infinite (one direction only)
4c02a168-9aba-4f42-8951-2719f24d391f.description: Intersect a mesh with a semi-infinite ray

contexts.hit_detection: Wire a Mesh to M, a base Point to P, and a direction Vector to D; outputs X (hit point) and H (boolean true if hit). Use H to filter valid intersections with a Gate or Dispatch.
contexts.closest_surface_point: Combine with Vector from point to mesh normal direction to simulate raycasting for closest-point or projection workflows onto mesh geometry.
contexts.visibility_occlusion: Use with multiple rays from a source point to test which rays are blocked by a mesh, filtering by H boolean output.

4c02a168-9aba-4f42-8951-2719f24d391f.errors: <~30 tokens: No hit returns H=False and X may be null/invalid; ensure D vector is non-zero and ray origin P is not inside mesh to avoid missed intersections.

4cb37955-a5a7-4251-8675-aa136cf9b84d.name: Import Content
4cb37955-a5a7-4251-8675-aa136cf9b84d.quick: Imports a Rhino model file; F input must be a valid file path string | outputs geometry, layers, materials, blocks, and other model content

contexts.import_model_objects: Wire a file path string to F; outputs O (Model Object) feeds into Content Cache or Group Content to organize imported geometry by layer or type
contexts.extract_materials_blocks: Connect F to get M (Model Material) and Bd (Model Block Definition) for downstream material assignment or block instance workflows
contexts.layer_filtering: Pipe L (Model Layer) into Equality Filter or Order Content to isolate specific layers from the imported file

4cb37955-a5a7-4251-8675-aa136cf9b84d.errors: Fails if F is not a valid, accessible file path string; empty or null path yields no outputs. Non-Rhino file formats may produce empty outputs. Missing file returns null on all outputs.

4cebcaf7-9a6a-435b-8f8f-95a62bacb0f2.name: Swap Columns
4cebcaf7-9a6a-435b-8f8f-95a62bacb0f2.quick: Swaps two columns in a matrix by index | A and B are zero-based column indices
4cebcaf7-9a6a-435b-8f8f-95a62bacb0f2.description: Swap two columns in a matrix

contexts.reordering_matrix_columns: Wire a Matrix into M, provide two Integer indices (A, B) to swap those columns; outputs reordered Matrix. Often paired with Construct Matrix or Deconstruct Matrix to inspect results.
contexts.matrix_manipulation_pipeline: Used alongside Swap Rows and Transpose Matrix to reorganize matrix structure before further operations like solving or deconstructing.

4cebcaf7-9a6a-435b-8f8f-95a62bacb0f2.errors: Out-of-range indices (A or B >= column count) likely cause null/invalid output. Non-integer or negative indices will fail. Swapping the same column (A == B) returns unchanged matrix.

4cfc0bb0-0745-4772-a520-39f9bf3d99bc.name: SubSet
4cfc0bb0-0745-4772-a520-39f9bf3d99bc.quick: Tests if set A is a subset of B; returns Boolean | order matters: A⊆B not B⊆A

contexts.membership_validation: Wire two lists into A and B; R returns True if every element in A exists in B. Pair with Disjoint or Set Intersection to build full set-logic checks.
contexts.filtering_logic: Use R output to drive conditional branches — if A is a subset of B, proceed with downstream operations. Combine with Member Index to locate elements.

4cfc0bb0-0745-4772-a520-39f9bf3d99bc.errors: Returns False when A has elements not in B; type mismatches between A and B (e.g., strings vs numbers) will cause False even if values appear equal. Empty A may return True (empty set is subset of any set).

4dbd15c7-ebcb-4af6-b3bd-32e80502520c.name: Point Deform
4dbd15c7-ebcb-4af6-b3bd-32e80502520c.quick: Deforms geometry by displacing control points individually via vectors | P and M lists must match in count
4dbd15c7-ebcb-4af6-b3bd-32e80502520c.description: Deform a shape by moving control-points individually

contexts.localized_deformation: Wire target geometry to G, a list of control points to P, and corresponding displacement vectors to M; each point moves geometry locally by its vector, enabling sculpt-like deformation
contexts.combined_with_spatial_deform: Use alongside Spatial Deform when you need both global space warping and precise local point-driven adjustments on the same geometry
contexts.mesh_or_brep_manipulation: Works on meshes, breps, or curves; control points P should ideally lie on or near the geometry surface for predictable deformation results

4dbd15c7-ebcb-4af6-b3bd-32e80502520c.errors: Mismatched P and M list lengths cause null output or partial deformation; points far from geometry may produce minimal visible effect

4dce5963-dc1a-4710-8991-9437ea23888d.name: Disjoint Mesh
4dce5963-dc1a-4710-8991-9437ea23888d.quick: Splits a single mesh into separate disconnected sub-meshes by connectivity | outputs multiple mesh pieces
4dce5963-dc1a-4710-8991-9437ea23888d.description: Split a mesh into disjoint pieces.

contexts.separating_imported_mesh: Feed a joined or imported mesh with multiple disconnected parts; outputs each disjoint piece as a separate mesh item in a list for individual processing
contexts.post_mesh_join_cleanup: Use after Mesh Join or Mesh Brep when geometry produces unintended merged disconnected regions; separates them for per-piece operations like Mesh Flip or analysis
contexts.mesh_boolean_results: After mesh boolean or split operations (e.g., Mesh Split Plane), use to isolate resulting disconnected fragments into individual meshes

4dce5963-dc1a-4710-8991-9437ea23888d.errors: No output if input mesh is null or invalid. If mesh is already a single connected piece, outputs one mesh unchanged. Expects a single Mesh input — feeding non-mesh geometry causes type error.

4df8df00-3635-45bd-95e6-f9206296c110.name: Replace Text
4df8df00-3635-45bd-95e6-f9206296c110.quick: Replaces all occurrences of fragment F in text T with replacement R | all three inputs are Text type
4df8df00-3635-45bd-95e6-f9206296c110.description: Replace all occurences of a specific text fragment with another

contexts.string_cleanup: Wire panel or Text param to T; literal string to F (what to find); literal string to R (replacement). Outputs cleaned text. Chain multiple Replace Text for multi-substitution.
contexts.dynamic_templating: Use with Text Join to build template strings, then Replace Text to swap placeholders (e.g., '{{name}}') with actual values from data.
contexts.preprocessing_for_split: Replace delimiter variants in T before feeding to Text Split, ensuring consistent separators.

4df8df00-3635-45bd-95e6-f9206296c110.errors: If F is empty string, behavior is undefined or may return unchanged text. Null/unconnected T or F inputs will cause no output. Case-sensitive matching — mismatched case means no replacement occurs.

4e007c9e-6521-4819-b16f-bdd3e768e003.name: Layout Viewport
4e007c9e-6521-4819-b16f-bdd3e768e003.quick: Exposes Rhino page layout viewports as a collection parameter | no inputs, outputs layout viewport data
4e007c9e-6521-4819-b16f-bdd3e768e003.description: Contains a collection of rhino page layouts

contexts.accessing_layouts: Use as a source parameter to retrieve all Rhino page layouts; wire output to components that consume layout/viewport data for documentation or printing workflows
contexts.paired_with_model_viewport: Complements Model Viewport — use Layout Viewport for paper-space layouts, Model Viewport for 3D model views; both output viewport collections

4e007c9e-6521-4819-b16f-bdd3e768e003.errors: No inputs to misconfigure; failures likely occur if no page layouts exist in the Rhino document, returning empty or null collection downstream

4e86ba36-05e2-4cc0-a0f5-3ad57c91f04e.name: Sort Points
4e86ba36-05e2-4cc0-a0f5-3ad57c91f04e.quick: Sorts points by X first, then Y, then Z coordinates | outputs sorted points P and original indices I
4e86ba36-05e2-4cc0-a0f5-3ad57c91f04e.description: Sort points by Euclidean coordinates (first x, then y, then z)

contexts.reordering_point_lists: Feed a flat list into P; get back sorted points and index map I. Use I with List Item to reorder associated data to match sorted order.
contexts.pre_processing_before_closest_point: Sort Points before Closest Points to establish predictable ordering; sorted output feeds directly into proximity or curve-based operations.
contexts.recovering_original_order: Output I (integer indices) lets you trace each sorted point back to its original position — useful for remapping geometry or data after sorting.

4e86ba36-05e2-4cc0-a0f5-3ad57c91f04e.errors: Fails or produces unexpected order if points share X and Y values — Z is tiebreaker only. Non-point geometry types wired to P will cause type mismatch. Null points in list may cause errors or be silently dropped.

4f3147f4-9fcd-4a7e-be0e-b1841caa5f97.name: Mesh Difference
4f3147f4-9fcd-4a7e-be0e-b1841caa5f97.quick: Subtracts mesh B from mesh A (solid difference) | Meshes must be closed/watertight for reliable results
4f3147f4-9fcd-4a7e-be0e-b1841caa5f97.description: Perform a solid difference on two sets of meshes

contexts.boolean_subtraction: Wire closed mesh geometry to A (base) and B (cutter); outputs single mesh R with B volume removed from A. Pair with Mesh Union/Intersection for full boolean workflow.
contexts.multiple_meshes: A and B accept mesh lists; performs difference across sets. Flatten or graft inputs to control pairing behavior.
contexts.brep_workflow_alternative: Use when working with mesh geometry instead of Breps; mirrors Solid Difference logic but operates on meshes rather than NURBS solids.

4f3147f4-9fcd-4a7e-be0e-b1841caa5f97.errors: Fails or produces invalid geometry if meshes are open/non-manifold; self-intersecting meshes cause unpredictable results; empty output R likely means meshes don't overlap or are not watertight.

4f381629-ece5-4012-ba3c-1906311e8b2e.name: Sun Preview
4f381629-ece5-4012-ba3c-1906311e8b2e.quick: Previews a sun or moon in viewport | Requires Sun object (S), Earth Location (L), and a Number (D) for date/time offset
4f381629-ece5-4012-ba3c-1906311e8b2e.description: Preview a sun or its related moon.

contexts.solar_preview: Wire Sun component output into S, Earth Location into L, and a numeric date/time value into D to visualize sun or moon position in the Rhino viewport for lighting studies.
contexts.lighting_setup: Used alongside Directional Light or other render lights to visually confirm sun angle before rendering; Sun component provides the anchor geometry.

4f381629-ece5-4012-ba3c-1906311e8b2e.errors: No outputs — purely a preview component; fails silently if S is not a valid Sun object or L is not an Earth Location type. D type mismatch (non-numeric) will prevent preview.

4f4fc2ac-98ac-485a-b88b-f23965e16de8.name: Intersection Filter
4f4fc2ac-98ac-485a-b88b-f23965e16de8.quick: AND-combines multiple predicate filters; all inputs must evaluate true | requires 2+ filter predicates wired to F input
4f4fc2ac-98ac-485a-b88b-f23965e16de8.description: Combine multiple filters together into an intersection which returns true only if all input filters evaluate to true.

contexts.multi_condition_filtering: Wire Equality Filter, Greater Than Filter, Less Than Filter outputs into F inputs; result predicate passes only objects satisfying every condition simultaneously — logical AND across all filters
contexts.complement_to_union: Use instead of Union Filter when you need strict all-conditions-met logic; Union Filter returns true if any one filter passes, Intersection requires all to pass

4f4fc2ac-98ac-485a-b88b-f23965e16de8.errors: Single filter input produces trivial result with no combining effect; mismatched filter types or incompatible predicate domains may silently pass no objects

4f65c681-9331-4818-9d54-6290cae686c3.name: Surface Box
4f65c681-9331-4818-9d54-6290cae686c3.quick: Creates a twisted box on a surface patch using a UV domain and height | Domain² must be a valid sub-domain of the surface UV space
4f65c681-9331-4818-9d54-6290cae686c3.description: Create a twisted box on a surface patch.

contexts.surface_morphing: Wire a Surface to S, a Domain² (sub-region of surface UV) to D, and a Number for height to H; output Twisted Box feeds directly into Box Morph to deform geometry onto the surface patch
contexts.patch_subdivision: Use construct Domain² from UV intervals to target specific surface regions; combine multiple Surface Boxes to tile geometry across a surface with Box Morph
contexts.workflow_with_surface_morph: Surface Box defines the target space; pair with Surface Morph for UVW-based geometry placement, or Twisted Box component when manually specifying corner points instead

4f65c681-9331-4818-9d54-6290cae686c3.errors: Fails if Domain² falls outside surface UV bounds; null output if surface is invalid or unset; height of 0 produces degenerate box unusable by Box Morph

4fe87ef8-49e4-4605-9859-87940d62e1de.name: Move To Plane
4fe87ef8-49e4-4605-9859-87940d62e1de.quick: Translates geometry onto a plane; booleans A/B likely control which axis alignment is preserved | outputs transform X for reuse
4fe87ef8-49e4-4605-9859-87940d62e1de.description: Translate (move) an object onto a plane.

contexts.snapping_geometry_to_plane: Wire geometry to G, target plane to P; A/B booleans control alignment behavior (e.g., maintain orientation or project). Output G is moved geometry; X transform can feed Orient or other transforms.
contexts.reusing_transform: Output X (Transform) can be passed to other transform components to apply the same move to additional geometry without recomputing.
contexts.combining_with_orient: Use alongside Orient when remapping geometry between coordinate systems; Move To Plane handles translation-only while Orient handles full axis remapping.

4fe87ef8-49e4-4605-9859-87940d62e1de.errors: Null geometry or invalid plane causes no output. A/B boolean defaults may produce unexpected orientation if not explicitly set. Geometry far from world origin may need Sanity XForm after.

5018bf8d-8566-4917-a6e3-5a623bda8079.name: Linear Dimension
5018bf8d-8566-4917-a6e3-5a623bda8079.quick: Creates a linear distance annotation between two points projected onto a line | Line L defines projection axis; A and B are measured points
5018bf8d-8566-4917-a6e3-5a623bda8079.description: Create a distance annotation between points, projected to a line.

contexts.basic_annotation: Connect two points to A/B, provide a Line L for projection direction, optional Text T overrides label, Number S sets text size; outputs display annotation in viewport
contexts.dimensioning_drawings: Pair with Serial Dimension for multiple measurements along same axis; use Aligned Dimension when no projection line is needed
contexts.custom_label: Feed formatted string to T input to override default distance value display; useful for units or custom notation

5018bf8d-8566-4917-a6e3-5a623bda8079.errors: <~30 tokens: No outputs — purely visual; nothing to wire downstream. Mismatched point/line geometry causes missing annotation. S must be positive number for visible text.

50b204ef-d3de-41bb-a006-02fba2d3f709.name: Circle TanTan
50b204ef-d3de-41bb-a006-02fba2d3f709.quick: Creates circle tangent to two curves A and B, near point P | P guides which tangent solution is selected
50b204ef-d3de-41bb-a006-02fba2d3f709.description: Create a circle tangent to two curves.

contexts.tangent_circle_construction: Wire two curves (lines, arcs, circles) to A and B; provide a Point P near desired tangent location to disambiguate among multiple possible tangent circles. Outputs a Circle C.
contexts.geometric_constraint_design: Useful when constructing geometry that must touch two existing curves tangentially; P acts as a seed/hint point — place it close to the expected circle location for reliable results.

50b204ef-d3de-41bb-a006-02fba2d3f709.errors: Fails or returns null if no tangent circle exists for given curve pair (e.g., parallel lines with incompatible geometry); P too far from valid solution region may select wrong tangent or yield no result.

50faccbd-9c92-4175-a5fa-d65e36013db6.name: Weave
50faccbd-9c92-4175-a5fa-d65e36013db6.quick: Weave | Inputs: Pattern, Stream 0, Stream 1 → Weave

5106bafc-d5d4-4983-83e7-7be3ed07f502.name: Divide Surface
5106bafc-d5d4-4983-83e7-7be3ed07f502.quick: Generates a UV grid of points and normals on a surface | U and V are division counts (integers), not distances
5106bafc-d5d4-4983-83e7-7be3ed07f502.description: Generate a grid of {uv} points on a surface.

contexts.point_sampling: Wire a surface to S, integers to U and V; outputs P (world points), N (normal vectors), uv (parameter coordinates) — useful for populating geometry across a surface
contexts.uv_parameterization: uv output gives parameter-space Point coordinates; feed into Surface Closest Point or Evaluate Surface for further surface operations
contexts.normal_extraction: N output provides per-point surface normals; commonly used to orient objects or extrude along surface normals without needing Surface Frames

5106bafc-d5d4-4983-83e7-7be3ed07f502.errors: Non-surface input to S causes failure; U or V of 0 or negative produces no output; untrimmed vs trimmed surfaces may place points outside visible boundary since division is based on full UV domain

510c4a63-b9bf-42e7-9d07-9d71290264da.name: Line 2Plane
510c4a63-b9bf-42e7-9d07-9d71290264da.quick: Projects/extends a line to intersect two planes; requires existing line L plus two target planes A and B.
510c4a63-b9bf-42e7-9d07-9d71290264da.description: Create a line between two planes.

contexts.trimming_line_to_planes: Wire a Line into L and two Plane components into A and B; output is a new Line trimmed/extended between the two plane intersections. Useful for bounding lines within a slab or region.
contexts.structural_framing: Use construction planes as floor/ceiling bounds; Line 2Plane clips a structural member line to exact plane intersections, feeding into downstream geometry like lofts or extrusions.

510c4a63-b9bf-42e7-9d07-9d71290264da.errors: Fails if input Line L is parallel to either plane (no intersection point). Null output if planes A or B are not properly defined. Missing any of the three inputs causes no output.

5184b8cb-b71e-4def-a590-cd2c9bc58906.name: Project Point
5184b8cb-b71e-4def-a590-cd2c9bc58906.quick: Projects a point onto geometry along a direction vector D; outputs projected point P and index I of hit geometry.
5184b8cb-b71e-4def-a590-cd2c9bc58906.description: Project a point onto a collection of shapes

contexts.project_to_surface: Wire a Point to P, a direction Vector (e.g., world Z) to D, and one or more surfaces/meshes to G; returns closest projected point and index of which geometry was hit.
contexts.multi_geometry_projection: Feed a list of breps or meshes to G; output I identifies which geometry index received the projection, useful for sorting or filtering results.
contexts.closest_point_comparison: Often paired with Closest Point when direction-based projection is needed instead of perpendicular closest-point; D controls projection axis.

5184b8cb-b71e-4def-a590-cd2c9bc58906.errors: Null output if projection ray misses all geometry in G; wrong direction vector D causes misses — ensure D points toward target geometry. No output if G is empty or incompatible type.

51a2ede9-8f8c-4fdf-a375-999c2062eab7.name: Colour Wheel
51a2ede9-8f8c-4fdf-a375-999c2062eab7.quick: Creates a palette of related colours via interactive wheel UI | outputs colour set, no inputs required
51a2ede9-8f8c-4fdf-a375-999c2062eab7.description: Creates a palette of related colours

contexts.colour_palette_generation: Double-click to open wheel UI; select base colour and harmony type; outputs multiple related colours for use in rendering, visualization, or gradient components
contexts.visual_design: Wire outputs to Colour Swatch or mesh/surface display components to preview palette; pairs naturally with Colour Picker for manual overrides

51a2ede9-8f8c-4fdf-a375-999c2062eab7.errors: No inputs means all configuration is UI-only; if no colours appear downstream, ensure wheel has been opened and a selection confirmed; output count may vary by harmony mode

51ef601d-f86e-4ee4-bcf2-3d459d3e95e9.name: Get Boolean
51ef601d-f86e-4ee4-bcf2-3d459d3e95e9.quick: Contextual boolean input with no inputs; outputs a boolean value from context | no wiring needed, value set via component UI

contexts.scripting_toggle: Used as a true/false toggle input in definitions; outputs boolean directly to gates, filters, or conditional logic components without needing a Boolean parameter component
contexts.cluster_input: Commonly used inside clusters or scripted contexts to expose a boolean input contextually; pairs with Get Number, Get Geometry for multi-type contextual inputs

51ef601d-f86e-4ee4-bcf2-3d459d3e95e9.errors: No inputs means value must be set contextually; if context is unresolved or component is used outside intended cluster/script context, output may be null or default false.

51f61166-7202-45aa-9126-3d83055b269e.name: Inverse Transform
51f61166-7202-45aa-9126-3d83055b269e.quick: Inverts a Transform — outputs the reverse transformation | only works on invertible transforms (non-singular matrices)

contexts.undo_transform: Feed any Transform (Move, Rotate, Scale, etc.) into T; output T is the inverse. Wire into Transform component to reverse geometry back to original position.
contexts.matrix_inversion: Pair with Transform Matrix to inspect or invert a 4x4 matrix. Useful when composing compound transforms and needing to undo one step.
contexts.split_and_invert: Use after Split component to isolate a fragment of a compound transform, then invert just that fragment before re-applying.

51f61166-7202-45aa-9126-3d83055b269e.errors: Fails or returns null if input transform is singular/non-invertible (e.g., a zero-scale transform). Null or disconnected T input produces no output.

522cee36-b61e-4e5a-a581-371795cb5d21.name: Get Object
522cee36-b61e-4e5a-a581-371795cb5d21.quick: Contextual object input with no inputs; outputs a referenced object from context (e.g., cluster or HumanUI binding).

contexts.cluster_input: Used inside clusters or HumanUI to expose an object parameter; no wiring needed on input side — object is passed contextually from the parent definition.
contexts.generic_object_passing: When geometry or data type is unknown/mixed, use Get Object instead of typed variants (Get Geometry, Get Number); wire output to components accepting generic object types.

522cee36-b61e-4e5a-a581-371795cb5d21.errors: No output if context provides no object; type mismatch if downstream component expects a specific type — use typed Get variants (Get Geometry, Get Boolean) when type is known.

522ffa00-cf42-4e34-90b6-eb375d901c74.name: Model Font
522ffa00-cf42-4e34-90b6-eb375d901c74.quick: Model Font | Inputs: F, Ff, W, S → F, Ff, W

52a53903-46bf-42c2-818f-c23344fc53c5.name: Print Width
52a53903-46bf-42c2-818f-c23344fc53c5.quick: Get/set object print width attributes | inputs/outputs mirror: Pw (PrintWidth), S (integer index), W (width value)

contexts.reading_print_width: Connect Rhino objects from Query Model Objects → extract Pw/S/W outputs to inspect assigned print width settings per object
contexts.setting_print_width: Feed Pw, S (integer index), W (numeric width) inputs to assign print width attributes before baking or passing to other attribute components like Object Linetype or Drafting Attributes
contexts.attribute_pipeline: Used alongside Object Linetype, Object Display Colour, Drafting Attributes to build complete object attribute sets for Rhino document objects

52a53903-46bf-42c2-818f-c23344fc53c5.errors: Mismatched types on W (expects PrintWidth, not plain number) or invalid S integer index likely cause null outputs; no observations to confirm

54241147-44f9-4019-a0a1-27a66871a867.name: Greater Than Filter
54241147-44f9-4019-a0a1-27a66871a867.quick: Creates > and ≥ predicate filters comparing a value V against key K; outputs are predicates, not booleans
54241147-44f9-4019-a0a1-27a66871a867.description: Create a filter that determines if a value is greater than another

contexts.filtering_rhino_objects: Wire K (attribute key as Text) and V (threshold value as Generic Data); outputs > and ≥ predicates feed into Intersection/Union/Logical Or Filter components to build compound queries
contexts.compound_filter_chains: Chain with Less Than Filter, Equality Filter, or Intersection Filter to create range filters (e.g., greater-than combined with less-than for bounded ranges)

54241147-44f9-4019-a0a1-27a66871a867.errors: Outputs are Predicate types, not direct boolean lists — cannot use directly as boolean masks; K must be Text (attribute key name); type mismatch between V and actual attribute type may produce no matches silently

546298c8-bcb4-4fc9-8ba9-e793fce3e8e5.name: Query Directory
546298c8-bcb4-4fc9-8ba9-e793fce3e8e5.quick: Lists subdirectories, files, and subfiles under a given path | M controls search mode/depth; N filters by text pattern
546298c8-bcb4-4fc9-8ba9-e793fce3e8e5.description: Query on the file system under the specified directory path.

contexts.file_listing: Wire a folder path string to D, set M (integer mode, e.g. 0=top only, 1=recursive), optionally wire a glob/text pattern to N; outputs D (subdirs), S (files), F (all files including nested)
contexts.filtered_search: Connect N to a Text Pattern (e.g. '*.3dm') to narrow results; pipe F or S into downstream filters like Equality Filter or Less Than Filter for further selection
contexts.content_pipeline: Use alongside Content Cache to locate files on disk before pushing/pulling Rhino model content; D output feeds back into another Query Directory for recursive traversal

546298c8-bcb4-4fc9-8ba9-e793fce3e8e5.errors: Invalid or non-existent path in D returns empty outputs with no warning. Wrong M integer value may return unexpected depth results. N pattern mismatch yields empty F/S lists.

54ab3f01-a769-4742-a7bf-cec48a1acb6f.name: Image Gallery
54ab3f01-a769-4742-a7bf-cec48a1acb6f.quick: Displays a sequence of images in the viewport | No I/O params exposed — images configured directly on component

contexts.image_sequence_display: Used standalone to show a series of images in the Grasshopper canvas or viewport; no wiring required — images loaded via component UI double-click or right-click menu
contexts.presentation_workflow: Placed alongside other display components (Text Tag, Vector Display) to annotate or illustrate geometry with reference images

54ab3f01-a769-4742-a7bf-cec48a1acb6f.errors: No inputs/outputs means no data wiring errors; likely fails silently if image paths are invalid or files are missing/moved

54ac80cf-74f3-43f7-834c-0e3fe94632c6.name: Construct Matrix
54ac80cf-74f3-43f7-834c-0e3fe94632c6.quick: Builds a matrix from R rows, C columns, and initial fill values V | V populates all cells unless list-matched
54ac80cf-74f3-43f7-834c-0e3fe94632c6.description: Construct a matrix from initial values

contexts.initialize_uniform_matrix: Set R and C as integers, provide single Number to V to fill all cells with one value; output M feeds Transpose Matrix or Deconstruct Matrix
contexts.populate_custom_values: Provide a list of Numbers to V matching R×C count to fill matrix cell-by-cell; wire to Swap Rows/Swap Columns for reordering
contexts.matrix_pipeline_start: Typical entry point before Transpose Matrix or Deconstruct Matrix; R and C must be positive integers or matrix construction fails

54ac80cf-74f3-43f7-834c-0e3fe94632c6.errors: Fails if R or C are zero/negative; V list shorter than R×C may leave cells uninitialized or repeat last value; non-integer R/C inputs cause type mismatch

54db2568-3441-4ae2-bcef-92c4cc608e11.name: Integer Division
54db2568-3441-4ae2-bcef-92c4cc608e11.quick: Divides A by B returning integer quotient (truncated, no remainder) | B=0 causes division by zero error

contexts.grid_subdivision: Feed panel count or grid dimension into A, divisor into B; R gives whole-number step size for evenly spacing geometry
contexts.index_bucketing: Use with Modulo to split a list index into row/column; A=index, B=row_length → R=row index
contexts.loop_counting: Combine with Multiplication and Subtraction to reconstruct remainders manually when Modulo unavailable

54db2568-3441-4ae2-bcef-92c4cc608e11.errors: Division by zero if B=0 (no output). Non-integer inputs auto-cast but fractional parts are silently truncated before division.

55f9ce6a-490c-4f25-a536-a3d47b794752.name: Scalar Display
55f9ce6a-490c-4f25-a536-a3d47b794752.quick: Visualizes scalar field values over a rectangular section as a mesh | N controls resolution grid density
55f9ce6a-490c-4f25-a536-a3d47b794752.description: Display the scalar values of a field section

contexts.field_visualization: Connect field source (e.g., Line Charge, Spin Force) to F, define sampling Rectangle S, set integer N for grid resolution; outputs colored Mesh showing scalar magnitude distribution
contexts.comparison_with_direction_display: Use alongside Direction Display and Tensor Display to inspect different field properties over same Rectangle S with matching N resolution for consistent comparison

55f9ce6a-490c-4f25-a536-a3d47b794752.errors: Null output if F is not a valid Field type; mesh resolution too coarse or too fine if N is zero or very large; Rectangle S must be planar and valid or mesh won't generate

55fb8124-766b-4d36-935a-ebb182d867dc.name: Annotation Style Overrides
55fb8124-766b-4d36-935a-ebb182d867dc.quick: Get or set annotation style overrides on geometry | Pass geometry (A) with style (As) and specific settings inputs to override
55fb8124-766b-4d36-935a-ebb182d867dc.description: Get-Set annotation style and overridden attributes

contexts.applying_style_overrides: Wire annotation geometry to A, connect Model Annotation Style from 'Annotation Style' or 'Query Annotation Styles' to As, then connect specific settings (Te, Di, Ar, Un, Le, To) from their respective components to override individual attributes
contexts.reading_existing_overrides: Connect annotated geometry to A input; outputs expose current style (As) and all override settings for inspection or downstream modification
contexts.selective_override: Only connect the specific settings inputs you want to override (e.g., just Te for text, Di for dimensions); unconnected inputs leave those attributes at style defaults

55fb8124-766b-4d36-935a-ebb182d867dc.errors: Null output if geometry (A) is not annotation type; mismatched style reference if As is not a valid Model Annotation Style; settings inputs from wrong component type will fail to connect

56c9c942-791f-4eeb-a4f0-82b93f1c0909.name: Data Path
56c9c942-791f-4eeb-a4f0-82b93f1c0909.quick: Stores data-tree path values (e.g., {0;1;2}) as a parameter; no inputs, outputs path collection
56c9c942-791f-4eeb-a4f0-82b93f1c0909.description: Contains a collection of data-tree paths

contexts.path_reference: Used as a constant path parameter; right-click to set path values like {0;1}; wire output to components expecting GH_Path inputs for tree manipulation
contexts.tree_operations: Feed into Shift Paths, Replace Paths, or path-filtering components to hardcode target branch addresses without computing them dynamically

56c9c942-791f-4eeb-a4f0-82b93f1c0909.errors: No inputs means paths must be set manually via right-click; passing to non-path inputs causes type mismatch; empty collection outputs null if no paths defined

57e1d392-e3fb-4de9-be98-982854a92351.name: Blur Numbers
57e1d392-e3fb-4de9-be98-982854a92351.quick: Averages each number with its neighbors in a list | Strength (S) and Iterations (I) control blur intensity
57e1d392-e3fb-4de9-be98-982854a92351.description: Blur a list of numbers by averaging neighbours

contexts.smoothing_value_lists: Connect a Number list to N, set S (0-1 strength) and I (integer iteration count); L toggles loop/wrap, W toggles weighted averaging; outputs smoothed number list
contexts.mesh_or_field_smoothing: Feed per-vertex or per-cell numeric data into N; chain multiple Blur Numbers or combine with Smooth Numbers for stronger smoothing effects
contexts.controlled_averaging: Use low S values (e.g. 0.1–0.3) with few iterations for subtle blending; increase I for progressive smoothing without single-pass distortion

57e1d392-e3fb-4de9-be98-982854a92351.errors: Empty or single-item list produces no meaningful blur; non-numeric input to N fails; I must be positive integer — zero or negative likely causes no output or error; S outside 0–1 range may produce unexpected amplification

57edd208-760a-4f0f-87e6-ca1bbd74133b.name: Cull Faces
57edd208-760a-4f0f-87e6-ca1bbd74133b.quick: Removes mesh faces where Boolean pattern P is True | P list must match face count

contexts.filtering_faces: Wire mesh M from Mesh Brep/Mesh Surface; supply Boolean list P (one per face) from analysis or manual pattern. Outputs culled mesh ready for Mesh Join or further ops.
contexts.occlusion_culling: Use Occlusion results or custom Boolean logic to generate P pattern; cull back-faces or hidden faces from mesh before display or export.

57edd208-760a-4f0f-87e6-ca1bbd74133b.errors: Mismatch between P list length and mesh face count causes incorrect culling or errors. Non-mesh input to M fails. Empty or all-True P removes all faces, yielding null mesh.

5816ec9c-f170-4c59-ac44-364401ff84cd.name: Planar
5816ec9c-f170-4c59-ac44-364401ff84cd.quick: Tests if a curve is planar | outputs best-fit plane P and deviation D; non-planar curves return False with approximate plane

contexts.planarity_check: Feed any curve into C; p (Boolean) confirms planarity, P gives the best-fit plane for further surface/loft ops, D gives max deviation from that plane
contexts.pre-loft_validation: Use before Loft or surface ops to confirm input curves are planar; gate downstream logic on p output
contexts.extract_plane: Even for near-planar curves, P provides a usable reference plane for Orient, Project, or PlaneSurface components

5816ec9c-f170-4c59-ac44-364401ff84cd.errors: Null/invalid curve input causes component error. Open vs closed curves both accepted. D > 0 with p=False means curve is 3D; tolerance-sensitive — very slightly non-planar curves may still return False.

586706a8-109b-43ec-b581-743e920c951a.name: Series Addition
586706a8-109b-43ec-b581-743e920c951a.quick: Adds N repeatedly from start S until reaching goal G | All inputs are Integers
586706a8-109b-43ec-b581-743e920c951a.description: Perform serial addition until a goal has been reached

contexts.counting_to_goal: Wire an integer start value to S, target integer to G, and step size to N; outputs final sum S and remainder R when goal is reached or exceeded
contexts.iterative_accumulation: Use alongside Mass Addition for comparing serial vs. bulk summation; N controls increment, G sets stopping condition

586706a8-109b-43ec-b581-743e920c951a.errors: Non-integer inputs cause type errors; if N=0, infinite loop or no progress toward G; if S already exceeds G, result may be immediate with unexpected R remainder

5909dbcb-4950-4ce4-9433-7cf9e62ee011.name: Blend Curve
5909dbcb-4950-4ce4-9433-7cf9e62ee011.quick: Creates a smooth blend curve connecting two curves; Fa/Fb control blend bulge/continuity weight at each end.
5909dbcb-4950-4ce4-9433-7cf9e62ee011.description: Create a blend curve between two curves.

contexts.connecting_curve_ends: Wire two curves into A and B; Fa and Fb (numbers, typically 0–1) control tangent influence at each endpoint; C (integer) sets continuity type (0=position, 1=tangent, 2=curvature). Output is a single blended curve.
contexts.continuity_control: Set C to 2 for curvature-continuous blends (G2); lower values give positional or tangential joins. Adjust Fa/Fb to tune how much each source curve's direction pulls the blend.
contexts.chaining_with_sub_curve: Use Sub Curve to extract specific portions of larger curves before feeding into A/B inputs, ensuring blend attaches at desired locations.

5909dbcb-4950-4ce4-9433-7cf9e62ee011.errors: Blend may fail or produce unexpected results if input curves are not valid/open at blend endpoints; extreme Fa/Fb values can cause self-intersecting curves. C out of valid integer range may error.

5958a658-20c2-4a2b-86ba-4d1b81bf5348.name: Colour HSV
5958a658-20c2-4a2b-86ba-4d1b81bf5348.quick: Creates a Colour from Hue (0–360), Saturation (0–1), Value (0–1), and Alpha (0–1) floats | All inputs expect normalized floats; H is 0–360
5958a658-20c2-4a2b-86ba-4d1b81bf5348.description: Create a colour from floating point {HSV} channels.

contexts.gradient_coloring: Wire a remap or range output to H to cycle hues across geometry; keep S and V at 1.0 for vivid colors; feed result to Custom Preview or Swatch
contexts.alpha_blending: Connect A input (0–1) to control transparency; useful when layering colored geometry in viewport via Custom Preview
contexts.color_space_conversion: Use alongside Colour RGB or Colour HSL neighbors when switching between color models; HSV is intuitive for hue-based workflows

5958a658-20c2-4a2b-86ba-4d1b81bf5348.errors: Out-of-range values (H>360, S/V/A outside 0–1) likely clamp silently or produce unexpected colors; missing inputs default to 0, yielding black or fully transparent

595aded2-8916-402d-87a3-a825244bbe3d.name: Construct Time
595aded2-8916-402d-87a3-a825244bbe3d.quick: Builds a Time value from hours, minutes, seconds integers | Used with Combine Date & Time to form full datetime

contexts.combine_with_date: Wire T output into Combine Date & Time component alongside a Construct Date output to produce a full date-time value for scheduling or date range operations
contexts.time_range: Feed T into Date Range or Interpolate Date to generate sequences of times; H/M/S accept integer sliders for parametric control

595aded2-8916-402d-87a3-a825244bbe3d.errors: Out-of-range integers (H>23, M/S>59) may produce invalid or wrapped Time values; non-integer inputs will fail type conversion

59aaebf8-6654-46b7-8386-89223c773978.name: Sort Along Curve
59aaebf8-6654-46b7-8386-89223c773978.quick: Sorts points by their parameter position along a curve | Curve C must be valid; outputs reordered points and original indices I

contexts.reorder_points_along_path: Wire a list of points to P and a reference curve to C; outputs sorted Point list and Integer indices I for tracking original order. Useful before lofting or paneling.
contexts.recover_original_order: Use output I (integer indices) with List Item to map sorted points back to original data or other parallel lists.
contexts.sequential_operations: Combine with Closest Point to first find relevant points, then sort them along a guide curve for ordered downstream processing.

59aaebf8-6654-46b7-8386-89223c773978.errors: Fails if C is null or invalid curve; points not near the curve still sort by closest parameter projection. Mismatched data trees between P and C may cause unexpected results.

59e1f848-38d4-4cbf-ad7f-40ffc52acdf5.name: Solar Incidence
59e1f848-38d4-4cbf-ad7f-40ffc52acdf5.quick: Solar Incidence | Inputs: L, T, P → D, E, H
59e1f848-38d4-4cbf-ad7f-40ffc52acdf5.description: Gets the solar incidence vector for a certain time and place

59e94548-cefd-4774-b3de-48142fc783fb.name: Polygon Center
59e94548-cefd-4774-b3de-48142fc783fb.quick: Finds center of a polyline/polygon via 3 methods (vertex avg, edge midpoint avg, area centroid) | Input must be a polyline/polygon curve
59e94548-cefd-4774-b3de-48142fc783fb.description: Find the center point (average) for a polyline.

contexts.centroid_of_polygon: Wire a closed polyline (e.g., from Polygon or boundary curve) into P; use Ca output for area centroid, Cv for vertex average, Ce for edge midpoint average — pick based on geometry regularity needs
contexts.labeling_or_placing_objects: Connect Polygon Center to a closed curve to get a representative center point for text tags, attractor logic, or object placement; Ca is most geometrically accurate for irregular polygons
contexts.comparing_center_methods: Cv averages vertex positions, Ce averages edge midpoints, Ca computes area centroid — results differ for irregular polygons; use Ca when mass distribution matters

59e94548-cefd-4774-b3de-48142fc783fb.errors: Fails or gives unexpected results if input is a non-polyline NURBS curve (component expects polyline); open curves may produce misleading centroids; null or invalid curve input yields no output

5a27203a-e05f-4eea-b80f-a5f29a00fdf2.name: Shear
5a27203a-e05f-4eea-b80f-a5f29a00fdf2.quick: Shears geometry using a plane origin and target point vector | P defines shear plane, T is the shear target point
5a27203a-e05f-4eea-b80f-a5f29a00fdf2.description: Shear an object based on a shearing vector.

contexts.deforming_geometry: Connect geometry to G, define reference Plane P (origin + orientation), set T as target Point to control shear direction and magnitude; outputs transformed geometry and reusable Transform X
contexts.reusing_transform: Output X (Transform) can be fed into other transform components to apply same shear to multiple objects without recomputing

5a27203a-e05f-4eea-b80f-a5f29a00fdf2.errors: <~30 tokens: T as Point (not vector) confuses users; wrong plane orientation produces unexpected shear axis; mismatched geometry types may yield null G output>

5a2b0735-ba98-4b7d-a7d3-c1dfc04475ad.name: Trigger
5a2b0735-ba98-4b7d-a7d3-c1dfc04475ad.quick: Manually or cyclically fires updates to connected components | no inputs or outputs — acts as a button/timer signal
5a2b0735-ba98-4b7d-a7d3-c1dfc04475ad.description: Manually or cyclically trigger updates of certain components.

contexts.manual_update: Right-click to trigger a single update pulse; useful for forcing recalculation of components like Data Recorder without changing input data
contexts.cyclic_animation: Enable cyclic mode to repeatedly trigger updates on a timer; commonly wired to Data Recorder or dynamic components to animate or log over time
contexts.controlled_refresh: Use alongside Get Data or Gene Pool to selectively refresh parts of a definition without full recompute

5a2b0735-ba98-4b7d-a7d3-c1dfc04475ad.errors: No wirable inputs/outputs — must be connected via right-click 'Trigger' target menu on destination components; cyclic mode may cause infinite loops if not managed

5a41528b-12b9-40dc-a3f2-842034d267c4.name: Text Tag 3D

5a4ddedd-5af9-49e5-bace-12910a8b9366.name: Mesh Triangle
5a4ddedd-5af9-49e5-bace-12910a8b9366.quick: Creates a triangular mesh face from 3 vertex indices (integers) | Indices must reference valid vertices in a mesh

contexts.building_custom_mesh: Wire integer vertex indices (A, B, C) into this component; output F (Mesh face) feeds into Construct Mesh along with a vertex list to build a complete mesh. Typically used when manual face topology control is needed.
contexts.mixed_face_mesh: Combine Mesh Triangle and Mesh Quad face outputs into a list, then pass to Construct Mesh F input to create meshes with both triangle and quad faces.

5a4ddedd-5af9-49e5-bace-12910a8b9366.errors: <~30 tokens: Indices out of range if integers exceed vertex count in Construct Mesh; non-integer inputs cause type mismatch on A, B, C.

5b0be57a-31f5-4446-a11a-ae0d348bca90.name: Cube Root
5b0be57a-31f5-4446-a11a-ae0d348bca90.quick: Computes ∛x of a value | works on negative numbers unlike Square Root
5b0be57a-31f5-4446-a11a-ae0d348bca90.description: Compute the cube root of a value

contexts.scalar_math: Wire a Number or expression into x; outputs ∛x as a number. Commonly chained with Cube or Power components for inverse operations.
contexts.geometry_scaling: Use to find edge length from a known volume value; plug volume number into x, get side length out.

5b0be57a-31f5-4446-a11a-ae0d348bca90.errors: Non-numeric Generic Data input may cause null output. Unlike Square Root, negative inputs are valid (cube root of negatives is real), so domain errors are less likely.

5b424e1c-d061-43cd-8c20-db84564b0502.name: Smooth Numbers
5b424e1c-d061-43cd-8c20-db84564b0502.quick: Smooths a number value over time (temporal averaging) | Requires live/animated input to have effect
5b424e1c-d061-43cd-8c20-db84564b0502.description: Smooth out changing numbers over time

contexts.animation_smoothing: Connect animated or slider-driven Number to N input; output N returns temporally smoothed value, reducing abrupt jumps. Useful with timer-driven simulations.
contexts.data_filtering: Wire noisy or rapidly changing numeric values (e.g., sensor data, slider) into N; smoothed output reduces spikes. Pair with Blur Numbers for spatial vs temporal smoothing.

5b424e1c-d061-43cd-8c20-db84564b0502.errors: No effect on static numbers — smoothing only activates with changing values over time. Single static input returns same value unchanged.

5b742537-9bcb-4f06-9613-866da5bf845e.name: Split with Breps
5b742537-9bcb-4f06-9613-866da5bf845e.quick: Splits a curve using multiple Breps as cutters; outputs curve segments and intersection points.
5b742537-9bcb-4f06-9613-866da5bf845e.description: Split a curve with multiple Breps.

contexts.curve_sectioning: Wire a curve into C and a list of Breps into B; outputs split curve segments where Breps intersect the curve, plus intersection points P. Use Flatten/Graft to manage multiple curves.
contexts.vs_split_with_brep: Use this (plural) when splitting against multiple Breps at once rather than a single Brep; avoids looping manually through Brep list.
contexts.extracting_intersections: P output gives intersection points between curve and Breps — useful for placing elements at cut locations without separate Curve|Brep component.

5b742537-9bcb-4f06-9613-866da5bf845e.errors: No output if curve doesn't intersect any Brep. Null/invalid Brep in B list can cause silent failure. Open vs. closed Brep affects whether curve is fully split or only clipped at surface.

5ba20fab-6d71-48ea-a98f-cb034db6bbdc.name: Direction Display
5ba20fab-6d71-48ea-a98f-cb034db6bbdc.quick: Visualizes force directions of a field as a mesh; requires Field, bounding Rectangle, and integer sample count N
5ba20fab-6d71-48ea-a98f-cb034db6bbdc.description: Display the force directions of a field section

contexts.field_visualization: Connect a field source (e.g., Spin Force, Line Charge) to F, a Rectangle defining the display region to S, and an integer grid resolution to N; outputs a Mesh showing direction arrows
contexts.debugging_fields: Use alongside Scalar Display and Tensor Display to inspect field behavior; same F and S inputs can be shared across all three display components for consistent region sampling

5ba20fab-6d71-48ea-a98f-cb034db6bbdc.errors: No output mesh if F is null or S is not a valid Rectangle; N too low (0 or 1) produces sparse or empty mesh; N very high may cause slow computation

5c270622-ee80-45a4-b07a-bd8ffede92a2.name: Control Point Loft
5c270622-ee80-45a4-b07a-bd8ffede92a2.quick: Lofts through curve control points (not curve geometry) using degree D | curves must share compatible control point counts
5c270622-ee80-45a4-b07a-bd8ffede92a2.description: Create a loft through curve control points.

contexts.nurbs_surface_from_curves: Wire multiple NURBS curves into C (list), set D (integer) for loft degree; outputs single Surface S. Curves should have matching control point structure for clean results.
contexts.degree_control: D input controls loft degree; lower values (1-3) give tighter or smoother interpolation through control point frames of input curves.

5c270622-ee80-45a4-b07a-bd8ffede92a2.errors: Fails if curves have mismatched control point counts or incompatible structure; non-NURBS curves may not expose usable control points; D too high for point count causes failure.

5c5fbc42-3e1d-4081-9cf1-148d0b1d9610.name: Smooth Polyline
5c5fbc42-3e1d-4081-9cf1-148d0b1d9610.quick: Smooths polyline vertices via averaging | S=strength (0-1), T=iterations; input must be a polyline curve
5c5fbc42-3e1d-4081-9cf1-148d0b1d9610.description: Smooth the vertices of a polyline curve.

contexts.smoothing_jagged_polylines: Wire a polyline (from Curve To Polyline or direct) into P; set S (0–1) for smoothing strength and T (integer) for iteration count. Higher T with moderate S gives gradual smoothing.
contexts.post_processing_curves: Use after Project Curve or Offset Curve when resulting polylines have jagged vertices. Chain with Simplify Curve afterward to reduce point count.
contexts.iterative_relaxation: Increase T to apply multiple smoothing passes. Low S with high T produces gentle, stable smoothing without collapsing geometry.

5c5fbc42-3e1d-4081-9cf1-148d0b1d9610.errors: Fails or has no effect if input P is not a polyline (use Curve To Polyline first). S outside 0–1 range may cause unexpected results. T=0 returns unchanged curve.

5ca0914d-b372-4a5e-aef3-137bd34abb6f.name: Model Annotation Style
5ca0914d-b372-4a5e-aef3-137bd34abb6f.quick: Provides collection of Rhino model annotation styles (text, dimension styles) | no inputs, outputs style data only
5ca0914d-b372-4a5e-aef3-137bd34abb6f.description: Contains a collection of model annotation styles

contexts.annotation_style_reference: Used as a source parameter to retrieve annotation styles defined in the Rhino document; wire output to components that need style names or settings for dimensions/text annotations
contexts.document_styles: Pairs with Model Layer, Model Object, or Model Material to access document-level properties; output feeds style selectors or annotation-related components

5ca0914d-b372-4a5e-aef3-137bd34abb6f.errors: No inputs means output depends entirely on active Rhino document; fails silently if no annotation styles are defined in the model

5d192b90-1ae3-4439-bbde-b05976fc4ac3.name: Copy Trim
5d192b90-1ae3-4439-bbde-b05976fc4ac3.quick: Copies UV trim data from surface T onto surface S | both inputs must be surfaces; output is S with T's trim applied
5d192b90-1ae3-4439-bbde-b05976fc4ac3.description: Copy UV trim data from one surface to another.

contexts.transfer_trim: Wire source surface (S) and trim-donor surface (T); useful when offsetting or rebuilding a surface loses its trim — pair with Offset Surface to reapply original trim curves to the offset result
contexts.isotrim_workflow: After Isotrim extracts a subsurface, use Copy Trim to reassign trim boundaries from the original surface, preserving UV trim topology across surface operations

5d192b90-1ae3-4439-bbde-b05976fc4ac3.errors: Fails or produces unexpected geometry if S and T have incompatible UV domains or parameterizations; no trim data on T yields no meaningful transfer; non-surface inputs (e.g., Breps with multiple faces) likely rejected

5d4e1eeb-482e-42a7-aa2f-e5deb8a1018e.name: Suirify

5dcad41a-2cc6-4f24-a0e2-fbe949e0a7ee.name: Text Balloon
5dcad41a-2cc6-4f24-a0e2-fbe949e0a7ee.quick: Visual annotation balloon for adding thought/speech bubble labels to canvas | no inputs or outputs, purely decorative

contexts.documentation: Used alongside Sketch, Gene Pool, or other components to annotate canvas sections; helps organize complex definitions with visual callouts

5dcad41a-2cc6-4f24-a0e2-fbe949e0a7ee.errors: No computational errors possible — no I/O. Text may not be visible if balloon is hidden or overlapped by other components.

5de23a52-b490-4d85-9c87-fbc0e353ecaf.name: Dimension Settings
5de23a52-b490-4d85-9c87-fbc0e353ecaf.quick: Holds a collection of dimension settings for Rhino annotation | No inputs or outputs — acts as a settings container/parameter
5de23a52-b490-4d85-9c87-fbc0e353ecaf.description: Contains a collection of dimension settings

contexts.annotation_workflow: Used alongside Arrow Settings, Text Settings, Tolerance Settings, and Leader Settings to configure Rhino dimension annotation styles; likely passed into annotation or drafting components as a settings bundle
contexts.settings_aggregation: Acts as a parameter container with no I/O pins; typically referenced or connected to components that consume dimension style configurations

5de23a52-b490-4d85-9c87-fbc0e353ecaf.errors: No inputs/outputs means it cannot be wired directly; likely must be referenced or used as a parameter type — misuse as a data-flow component will fail silently

5e33c760-adcd-4235-b1dd-05cf72eb7a38.name: Sum Surface
5e33c760-adcd-4235-b1dd-05cf72eb7a38.quick: Creates a sum surface by adding two edge curves together as parametric basis; both inputs must be Curves → outputs Brep
5e33c760-adcd-4235-b1dd-05cf72eb7a38.description: Create a sum surface from two edge curves.

contexts.basic_surface_generation: Wire two curves into A and B inputs; curves act as directional edge guides. Similar to Ruled Surface but uses vector addition of curve positions rather than linear interpolation between them.
contexts.comparison_with_ruled_surface: Unlike Ruled Surface (linear blend between two curves), Sum Surface adds curve geometry parametrically. Use when you need a surface whose shape reflects the combined geometry of both input curves.
contexts.edge_curve_workflows: Often used alongside Edge Surface and Network Surface when building complex multi-surface models; output Brep can feed into Join, Trim, or Boolean operations.

5e33c760-adcd-4235-b1dd-05cf72eb7a38.errors: Fails if A or B are not valid curves or are null. Non-compatible curve domains or mismatched parameterization may produce unexpected surface shapes. Open vs. closed curve mismatches can cause degenerate output.

5edaea74-32cb-4586-bd72-66694eb73160.name: Rotate Direction
5edaea74-32cb-4586-bd72-66694eb73160.quick: Rotates geometry from one direction vector to another around center point C | F=from vector, T=to vector, both required
5edaea74-32cb-4586-bd72-66694eb73160.description: Rotate an object from one direction to another.

contexts.align_geometry_to_direction: Wire geometry to G, define pivot point C, supply current facing direction as F and target direction as T; outputs rotated geometry and reusable transform X
contexts.reuse_transform: Output X (Transform) can be fed into other transform components to apply same rotation to multiple objects without recomputing
contexts.chaining_with_orient: Often paired with Orient Direction or Orient when full axis-system remapping is needed beyond single-direction rotation

5edaea74-32cb-4586-bd72-66694eb73160.errors: <~30 tokens: Null output if F and T vectors are parallel or zero-length; missing C defaults to world origin unexpectedly; non-unitized vectors may cause unpredictable rotation angle

5ef8ffe8-789a-45cf-8232-46be0fc552a6.name: Mesh FromPoints
5ef8ffe8-789a-45cf-8232-46be0fc552a6.quick: Creates a mesh from a grid of points; U×V count must match total point count exactly.
5ef8ffe8-789a-45cf-8232-46be0fc552a6.description: Create a mesh from a grid of points.

contexts.grid_mesh_from_points: Feed a flat list of grid points into P, set U (columns) and V (rows) as integers so U×V = total point count. Optional C input assigns vertex colors. Outputs a quad mesh M.
contexts.colored_mesh: Wire a matching list of Colour values to C alongside P, U, V to produce a vertex-colored mesh. Color count must match point count.
contexts.downstream_processing: Output M connects to Mesh Join to combine with other meshes, or Mesh Flip to correct face normals if surface appears inverted.

5ef8ffe8-789a-45cf-8232-46be0fc552a6.errors: Fails or produces corrupt mesh if U×V ≠ len(P). Non-grid (unordered) point lists produce incorrect topology. Mismatched color list length causes errors on C input.

5f127fa4-ca61-418e-bb2d-e3739d900f1f.name: Plane Coordinates
5f127fa4-ca61-418e-bb2d-e3739d900f1f.quick: Returns X, Y, Z coordinates of a point relative to a given plane's axis system | plane S defines the local coordinate frame
5f127fa4-ca61-418e-bb2d-e3739d900f1f.description: Get the coordinates of a point in a plane axis system.

contexts.local_space_analysis: Wire any Point to P and a custom Plane (from Construct Plane or Deconstruct Plane) to S; outputs X/Y/Z are distances along plane axes, not world axes
contexts.world_plane_decomposition: Use XY/XZ/YZ Plane components as S input to get standard projected coordinates of a point onto those planes
contexts.remapping_to_local_frame: Useful after Construct Plane to measure how far a point lies along custom X/Y/Z axes, e.g. for alignment or sorting operations

5f127fa4-ca61-418e-bb2d-e3739d900f1f.errors: Wrong results if S is not the intended reference plane — coordinates are relative, not world. Null output if P or S is unset. Z=0 only when point lies on the plane.

5f9e4549-8135-4a90-97c8-8a34bf05e99a.name: Pattern Hatch
5f9e4549-8135-4a90-97c8-8a34bf05e99a.quick: Creates a patterned hatch fill inside boundary curves | P selects pattern index, S sets scale, A sets angle

contexts.hatching_regions: Wire closed curves to B (boundary), integer to P for pattern type, Number to S for scale and A for rotation angle in degrees; displays hatch in viewport only
contexts.annotation_and_drawing: Pair with Gradient Hatch or Hatch Line for varied fill styles; useful for technical drawing output where regions need patterned fills

5f9e4549-8135-4a90-97c8-8a34bf05e99a.errors: Fails if B curves are not closed or planar; P out of range for available Rhino hatch patterns causes no output; S=0 or negative scale likely produces no visible hatch

5fa4e736-0d82-4af0-97fb-30a79f4cbf41.name: Stack Data
5fa4e736-0d82-4af0-97fb-30a79f4cbf41.quick: Duplicates each item individually in a list by count S | S controls per-item repeat count
5fa4e736-0d82-4af0-97fb-30a79f4cbf41.description: Duplicate individual items in a list of data

contexts.repeat_each_item: Connect any list to D and an integer (or integer list) to S; each element is repeated S times in place, unlike Duplicate Data which repeats the whole list. S can be a single value or per-item list.
contexts.pattern_generation: Use before Cull Pattern or Cull Index to expand a list before filtering; pair with Random to vary repeat counts per item for irregular sequences.

5fa4e736-0d82-4af0-97fb-30a79f4cbf41.errors: Mismatched list lengths between D and S may cause shortest-list truncation. S=0 removes items entirely. Negative S likely errors or returns empty. Confusing with Duplicate Data (whole-list repeat vs per-item repeat) is a common mistake.

60103def-1bb7-4700-b294-3a89100525c4.name: Secant
60103def-1bb7-4700-b294-3a89100525c4.quick: Computes sec(x) = 1/cos(x) of an angle | Input in radians; undefined where cos(x)=0 (x=π/2+nπ)
60103def-1bb7-4700-b294-3a89100525c4.description: Compute the secant (reciprocal of the Cosine) of an angle.

contexts.angle_to_secant: Wire a radian angle value (Number or expression) into x; outputs 1/cos(x). Pair with Cosine to verify: sec result equals 1 divided by Cosine output.
contexts.trigonometric_expressions: Used alongside Sine, Cosine, Tangent when building trig-based surface or curve formulas requiring reciprocal cosine terms.

60103def-1bb7-4700-b294-3a89100525c4.errors: Returns undefined/infinite values when input angle equals π/2 + nπ (cos=0); ensure angle inputs avoid these singularities. Non-numeric input to x will cause type error.

608e1d69-2b19-4a59-a752-871686ec29b4.name: Text Settings
608e1d69-2b19-4a59-a752-871686ec29b4.quick: Outputs a text settings object (font, size, style) for use in annotation/dimension components | no inputs required
608e1d69-2b19-4a59-a752-871686ec29b4.description: Contains a collection of text settings

contexts.annotation_styling: Connect output to Dimension Settings, Leader Settings, or similar annotation components that accept text settings to control font, size, and text appearance in drawings.
contexts.dimension_workflow: Used alongside Arrow Settings, Tolerance Settings, and Dimension Settings to fully configure annotation styles; wire into dimension or leader components.

608e1d69-2b19-4a59-a752-871686ec29b4.errors: No inputs to misconfigure; errors likely occur downstream if connected component expects a specific text settings type that doesn't match, or if the component outputs a null/default object incompatible with target input.

615367b4-c9d0-4cb7-986c-cb861226136f.name: Value Tracker
615367b4-c9d0-4cb7-986c-cb861226136f.quick: Tracks numeric values over time as a running history | No explicit inputs/outputs defined; works as a display-only component
615367b4-c9d0-4cb7-986c-cb861226136f.description: Track a collection of numeric values over time

contexts.monitoring_values: Connect numeric outputs (sliders, computed values) to watch how values change across solution iterations; useful for debugging parameter drift or animation
contexts.animation_debugging: Place alongside animated or time-driven components to visualize value evolution; neighbors like Vector Display Ex suggest use in simulation/preview workflows

615367b4-c9d0-4cb7-986c-cb861226136f.errors: No inputs defined in schema — connection method unclear; may require right-click menu to add tracked parameters. No data = blank display.

61647ba2-31eb-4921-9632-df81e3286f7d.name: To Polar
61647ba2-31eb-4921-9632-df81e3286f7d.quick: Converts a 3D point to polar coords (Phi, Theta, Radius) relative to a reference plane | plane S defines the coordinate origin and orientation
61647ba2-31eb-4921-9632-df81e3286f7d.description: Convert a 3D point to plane polar coordinates.

contexts.polar_analysis: Wire a Point to P and a reference Plane to S; outputs Phi (P), Theta (T), Radius (R) — inverse of Point Polar component for round-trip coordinate conversion
contexts.coordinate_transform: Use with Point Polar to convert points to polar, manipulate angles/radius, then reconstruct points; S plane controls the polar origin frame
contexts.array_patterns: Pair with Polar Array or Point Cylindrical when decomposing geometry into angular/radial components for pattern generation

61647ba2-31eb-4921-9632-df81e3286f7d.errors: Wrong output if S plane is not set correctly — defaults may misalign coordinate frame. Null output if P input is not a valid Point type. Theta/Phi may be in radians; feeding to degree-expecting components causes unexpected results.

61d81100-c4d3-462d-8b51-d951c0ae32db.name: Triangle Mapping
61d81100-c4d3-462d-8b51-d951c0ae32db.quick: Maps geometry from source triangle (S) to target triangle (T) | Both S and T must be triangular closed curves
61d81100-c4d3-462d-8b51-d951c0ae32db.description: Transform geometry from one triangle into another.

contexts.geometry_remapping: Wire geometry into G, provide source triangle curve to S and target triangle curve to T; outputs transformed geometry and the transform matrix X for reuse
contexts.reusing_transform: Output X (Transform) can feed other Transform components to apply the same triangle-to-triangle mapping to additional geometry without recomputing
contexts.pattern_distribution: Use alongside Rectangle Mapping or Box Mapping when distributing geometry across triangulated surfaces; each triangle pair defines a local coordinate remap

61d81100-c4d3-462d-8b51-d951c0ae32db.errors: Fails if S or T are not triangular curves (wrong vertex count or open curves); non-planar or degenerate triangles may produce unexpected transforms

6283fb37-e273-4eb2-8d2a-e347881e3928.name: Blend Box
6283fb37-e273-4eb2-8d2a-e347881e3928.quick: Creates a twisted box bridging two surface patches via Domain² regions | both surfaces need valid UV domains
6283fb37-e273-4eb2-8d2a-e347881e3928.description: Create a twisted box between two surfaces.

contexts.morphing_between_surfaces: Wire two surfaces into Sa/Sb; use Domain² (e.g., from Construct Domain²) for Da/Db to define UV patch regions; output Twisted Box feeds Box Morph to deform geometry between the two patches
contexts.surface_patch_targeting: Da/Db Domain² inputs control which UV subregion of each surface is used; full-surface domain (0-1 in U and V) is typical starting point; pair with Surface Box for single-surface variant

6283fb37-e273-4eb2-8d2a-e347881e3928.errors: Fails if Domain² inputs are null or out of surface UV range; mismatched surface orientations may produce self-intersecting twisted box; non-NURBS geometry not accepted as surface inputs

62d5ead4-53c4-4d0b-b5ce-6bd6e0850ab8.name: Symbol Display
62d5ead4-53c4-4d0b-b5ce-6bd6e0850ab8.quick: Displays symbols at points in viewport | Requires Symbol Display data (D) from Symbol component, not raw geometry

contexts.point_annotation: Pair with Point Order or Text Tag for annotated point sets; P accepts point lists, D controls symbol appearance/style

62d5ead4-53c4-4d0b-b5ce-6bd6e0850ab8.errors: No output — purely visual component; fails silently if D input is wrong type or disconnected; P must be valid Point data, not curves or other geometry

62f8596e-ad64-4012-91d4-9fde13b96442.name: Annotation Style
62f8596e-ad64-4012-91d4-9fde13b96442.quick: Annotation Style | Inputs: As, N, Ms, Te → As, N, Ms

634cf2ca-3655-40d3-8eff-c3c606b2e3c2.name: Hyper Index
634cf2ca-3655-40d3-8eff-c3c606b2e3c2.quick: Stores/outputs a hyper-index (multi-dimensional index) value | no inputs, purely a parameter container

contexts.data_tree_navigation: May be used alongside Integer or Domain params to reference specific items within complex nested data structures

634cf2ca-3655-40d3-8eff-c3c606b2e3c2.errors: No inputs means value must be set manually or via right-click; passing to components expecting simple integers may cause type mismatch

6354d626-df14-488d-885d-ed51b2efe97f.name: Model Block Instance
6354d626-df14-488d-885d-ed51b2efe97f.quick: Deconstructs/accesses a Rhino block instance: extracts or sets its Transform and Block Definition | inputs mirror outputs

contexts.inspect_block: Feed block instances from Query Model Block Definitions into Bi; outputs T (transform/placement) and Bd (definition) for downstream use like Export Model Block Definition
contexts.transform_block: Wire a Transform component into T to reposition block instance; Bd links to block definition queries for filtering or exporting specific block types

6354d626-df14-488d-885d-ed51b2efe97f.errors: <~30 tokens: Null Bi if no block instances exist in model; mismatched Bd type if non-block geometry fed to Bi input

63781bc9-6705-4a8c-8704-010655dcad76.name: Union Filter
63781bc9-6705-4a8c-8704-010655dcad76.quick: Combines multiple Predicate filters with OR logic — true if any one filter passes | requires multiple Predicate inputs
63781bc9-6705-4a8c-8704-010655dcad76.description: Combine multiple filters together into a union which returns true if at least one input filter evaluates to true.

contexts.multi_condition_filtering: Wire several filters (Equality, Greater Than, Less Than) into F input; Union Filter returns combined Predicate that passes items matching any condition. Use before object/content filtering components.
contexts.vs_intersection: Use Union Filter when any match suffices (OR); use Intersection Filter when all conditions must be met (AND). Logical Or Filter does same but only accepts two inputs — Union Filter handles N inputs.

63781bc9-6705-4a8c-8704-010655dcad76.errors: Fails if non-Predicate types are connected to F input. With only one filter input, output is redundant but valid. Empty input list likely returns null or always-false Predicate.

63d12974-2915-4ccf-ac26-5d566c3bac92.name: Create Complex
63d12974-2915-4ccf-ac26-5d566c3bac92.quick: Combines Real (R) and Imaginary (i) numbers into a Complex type | Both inputs are plain Numbers
63d12974-2915-4ccf-ac26-5d566c3bac92.description: Create a complex number from a Real and an Imaginary component
