contexts.relocate_world_plane: Wire XY/XZ/YZ Plane into B, a target Point into O; outputs same-orientation plane at new location. Common for placing oriented frames at geometry points.
contexts.rebase_constructed_plane: Feed Construct Plane output into B, new origin Point into O; useful when axes were built from vectors but origin needs adjustment without rebuilding.
contexts.deconstruct_reconstruct_workflow: Use after Deconstruct Plane to swap only the origin component, then pass result downstream — avoids full plane reconstruction.

75eec078-a905-47a1-b0d2-0934182b1e3d.errors: Null output if B or O is null/unconnected. If O is a list and B is single, plane axes replicate per point (data tree mismatch may produce unexpected branching).

76975309-75a6-446a-afed-f8653720a9f2.name: Create Material
76975309-75a6-446a-afed-f8653720a9f2.quick: Creates an OpenGL shader/material from diffuse (Kd), specular (Ks), emissive (Ke) colors, transparency (T), and shininess (S) | outputs Shader type

contexts.custom_display_material: Wire Color components into Kd (diffuse), Ks (specular), Ke (emissive); set T (0.0–1.0 transparency) and S (shininess integer); output M (Shader) feeds Custom Preview or similar display components
contexts.deconstructing_and_rebuilding: Use Deconstruct Material to extract channels from existing shader, modify specific values (e.g. via Split AHSL for color tweaks), then rewire into Create Material to rebuild a modified shader

76975309-75a6-446a-afed-f8653720a9f2.errors: Wrong type on color inputs (non-Color data); T out of 0–1 range may clamp or fail; S expects Integer — float input may cause type mismatch; output M only works with display-family components expecting Shader type

769f9064-17f5-4c4a-921f-c3a0ee05ba3a.name: Catenary Ex
769f9064-17f5-4c4a-921f-c3a0ee05ba3a.quick: Variable catenary curve between two points with per-segment weights (W) and gravity vector (G) | L must exceed A-B distance
769f9064-17f5-4c4a-921f-c3a0ee05ba3a.description: Create a variable catenary chain between two points.

contexts.hanging_chain_simulation: Connect two anchor Points (A, B), set L (chain length > point distance), provide W (weight values per segment, list), and G (gravity vector, typically -Z) → outputs C (catenary curve) and S (segmented curve)
contexts.variable_load_modeling: Feed a list of Numbers into W to model non-uniform weight distribution along chain; data tree matching with L controls segment count and shape variation
contexts.comparison_with_basic_catenary: Use instead of basic Catenary when per-segment weight variation is needed; same A/B/L/G pattern but W adds variable loading capability

769f9064-17f5-4c4a-921f-c3a0ee05ba3a.errors: L shorter than A-B distance causes failure (chain can't reach). W list length mismatch with segments causes null output. G as zero vector or wrong type causes solver error.

76c87974-75f6-40b1-a6f6-3ced07a6c903.name: Aligned Dimension
76c87974-75f6-40b1-a6f6-3ced07a6c903.quick: Creates aligned linear dimension annotation between two points A and B on a plane | offset O controls dimension line distance

contexts.create_dimension: Wire two Points to A/B, a Plane to P for orientation, Number to O for offset distance; outputs Linear Dimension object for use in Rhino annotations or further annotation style assignment
contexts.deconstruct_dimension: Feed existing Linear Dimension into D input to extract its plane, points, offset, and annotation style — useful for reading or modifying existing dimensions
contexts.styled_annotation: Connect Model Annotation Style to As input to apply custom text/arrow styles; pair with Annotation Dimension Settings component to configure style properties

76c87974-75f6-40b1-a6f6-3ced07a6c903.errors: <~30 tokens: Missing A or B points causes null output; Plane must match geometry orientation or dimension appears misaligned; O=0 may overlap geometry

76f85ee4-5a88-4511-8ba7-30df07e50533.name: Mesh Sphere Ex
76f85ee4-5a88-4511-8ba7-30df07e50533.quick: Creates mesh sphere from square patches; B=base plane, R=radius, C=count (patch subdivisions per face)
76f85ee4-5a88-4511-8ba7-30df07e50533.description: Create a mesh sphere from square patches.

contexts.basic_sphere: Connect a Plane (or origin point) to B, a Number slider to R for radius, and an Integer slider to C to control patch density; outputs a quad-dominant Mesh M
contexts.subdivision_control: C integer controls square patch count — higher C increases mesh resolution; wire to downstream Mesh components or analysis tools
contexts.comparison_with_mesh_sphere: Use over standard Mesh Sphere when square/quad patch topology is needed instead of triangulated poles; avoids pole singularities

76f85ee4-5a88-4511-8ba7-30df07e50533.errors: Invalid if R≤0 or C<1; non-plane input to B causes type mismatch; very high C values may produce heavy meshes slowing computation

770b71bf-1a1d-45d1-bc55-cc2a6b097070.name: Mesh ExtractAttributes
770b71bf-1a1d-45d1-bc55-cc2a6b097070.quick: Extracts named attributes (D=keys as Text, 0=values as Generic Data) from a Mesh object | mesh must carry embedded attributes

contexts.attribute_inspection: Connect a Mesh to M; D outputs attribute key names as Text, 0 outputs corresponding values as Generic Data. Pair with Panel to inspect key-value pairs from meshes with embedded metadata.
contexts.data_pipeline: Use after importing meshes from external sources (e.g., OBJ, FBX) that embed custom attributes. Feed D into text matching or 0 into type-cast components to use attribute values downstream.

770b71bf-1a1d-45d1-bc55-cc2a6b097070.errors: If mesh has no embedded attributes, D and 0 return empty/null. Non-mesh input to M causes type error. Generic Data output 0 may need explicit casting before use in typed operations.

77185dc2-2f18-469d-9686-00f5b6049195.name: Colour XYZ
77185dc2-2f18-469d-9686-00f5b6049195.quick: Creates a Colour from CIE 1931 XYZ floating point channels plus alpha | XYZ values follow CIE 1931 colorimetry spec
77185dc2-2f18-469d-9686-00f5b6049195.description: Create a colour from floating point {XYZ} channels (CIE 1931 spec).

contexts.colorimetry_pipeline: Wire X, Y, Z Numbers from scientific/colorimetric data sources; A sets alpha (0.0–1.0); outputs Colour C for display or material use, similar to Colour RGB/HSV neighbors
contexts.color_space_conversion: Use when working with CIE-based color science; connect to downstream display or mesh color components; pair with Colour LCH or Colour RGB for cross-space comparison

77185dc2-2f18-469d-9686-00f5b6049195.errors: Invalid output if XYZ values exceed CIE 1931 gamut bounds; null Colour if any input is disconnected or non-numeric; A outside 0–1 may clamp or produce unexpected transparency

778e8a8d-3ae6-4253-bd63-f0e725cb852e.name: Hatch Line
778e8a8d-3ae6-4253-bd63-f0e725cb852e.quick: Stores/references a collection of model hatch lines for use in hatch patterns | acts as a data container with no inputs
778e8a8d-3ae6-4253-bd63-f0e725cb852e.description: Contains a collection of model hatch lines

contexts.hatch_pattern_construction: Used alongside Pattern Hatch or Gradient Hatch to supply hatch line geometry; no inputs — references existing model hatch lines baked into Rhino document
contexts.display_annotation: Paired with display components like Text Tag or Cloud Display to annotate viewport; provides hatch line data as a passive container

778e8a8d-3ae6-4253-bd63-f0e725cb852e.errors: No inputs means no live wiring — data comes from model; fails silently if no hatch lines exist in the Rhino document

78669f9c-4fea-44fd-ab12-2a69eeec58de.name: Gate Majority
78669f9c-4fea-44fd-ab12-2a69eeec58de.quick: Returns True if 2 or 3 of inputs A, B, C are True; majority vote of three booleans.
78669f9c-4fea-44fd-ab12-2a69eeec58de.description: Calculates the majority vote among three booleans.

contexts.voting_logic: Wire three boolean conditions to A, B, C; R is True when at least two inputs are True. Useful for fault-tolerant or redundant condition checks.
contexts.combined_gates: Chain with Gate Not, Gate And, Gate Or to build complex logic; Gate Majority replaces nested AND/OR combinations for 2-of-3 patterns.

78669f9c-4fea-44fd-ab12-2a69eeec58de.errors: All inputs must be Boolean; passing non-boolean types will fail. With fewer than three inputs connected, missing inputs default to False, skewing the majority result.

791ad613-4da4-4f2f-97b7-d3855c1bba98.name: Script Input/Output Parameter
791ad613-4da4-4f2f-97b7-d3855c1bba98.quick: Defines a named input or output port on a script component (Python, C#, VB) | no fixed type; type is set per parameter

contexts.script_io_wiring: Added to Python 3, C#, or VB script components to expose custom inputs/outputs; each parameter gets a name and type, then wired to external Grasshopper data or receives script results
contexts.dynamic_port_definition: Used when scripting components need more or fewer ports than default; right-click script component to add/remove these parameters, naming them to match variable names inside the script

791ad613-4da4-4f2f-97b7-d3855c1bba98.errors: Mismatch between parameter name in script and port name causes null/unresolved data; wrong type assignment causes cast failures inside script body

79747717-1874-4c34-b790-faef53b50569.name: Symbol (Simple)
79747717-1874-4c34-b790-faef53b50569.quick: Defines simple symbol display properties (shape index, size, rotation, color) → Symbol Display output for use with Symbol Display component

contexts.symbol_visualization: Wire integer X (shape type index) + Number S (size) + Number R (rotation angle) + Colour C → D (Symbol Display). Feed D into Symbol Display component to render symbols at points in viewport.
contexts.point_annotation: Combine with Point Order or Text Tag neighbors to annotate point lists with colored/sized symbols. Vary X for different shape types, S for scale emphasis.

79747717-1874-4c34-b790-faef53b50569.errors: Wrong type on X (must be Integer, not Number) causes failure. No Symbol Display component downstream means D output is unused. Null Colour input C may produce invisible or default-colored symbols.

797d922f-3a1d-46fe-9155-358b009b5997.name: One Over X
797d922f-3a1d-46fe-9155-358b009b5997.quick: Computes 1/x | Division by zero (x=0) returns null/error

contexts.reciprocal_scaling: Wire a Number or expression output into x; returns 1/x as a number. Useful for inverting frequencies, weights, or scale factors in parametric models.
contexts.math_chain: Chains with Square, Square Root, Logarithm neighbors for compound math expressions. Output y feeds directly into further polynomial or arithmetic components.

797d922f-3a1d-46fe-9155-358b009b5997.errors: x=0 causes division by zero — output undefined or null. Non-numeric generic data may fail silently or return null.

7986486c-621a-48fb-8f27-a28a22c91cc9.name: Average
7986486c-621a-48fb-8f27-a28a22c91cc9.quick: Computes arithmetic mean of a set of numbers; input accepts a list of numeric/generic data → outputs single average value
7986486c-621a-48fb-8f27-a28a22c91cc9.description: Solve the arithmetic average for a set of items

contexts.averaging_numbers: Feed a list of numbers into I; component returns single AM value. Commonly paired with Maximum/Minimum to compare mean against extremes.
contexts.data_reduction: Use after collecting multiple numeric outputs (e.g., distances, areas) to reduce to a representative single value before feeding into Clamp or Truncate.
contexts.weighted_vs_unweighted: When equal weighting is insufficient, swap for Weighted Average neighbor component which accepts weight factors per item.

7986486c-621a-48fb-8f27-a28a22c91cc9.errors: Fails or returns unexpected results if non-numeric generic data is passed; empty list input likely returns null/error on AM output.

7991bc5f-8a01-4768-bfb0-a39357ac6b84.name: Clean Tree
7991bc5f-8a01-4768-bfb0-a39357ac6b84.quick: Removes null/invalid items from a data tree | X toggles null removal, E toggles invalid/empty removal
7991bc5f-8a01-4768-bfb0-a39357ac6b84.description: Removed all null and invalid items from a data tree.

contexts.pre_processing: Wire any messy data tree into T before downstream operations; X (Boolean) controls null removal, E controls invalid item removal; outputs cleaned tree ready for Tree Branch or Explode Tree
contexts.pipeline_cleanup: Use after geometry operations that may produce nulls (e.g., failed intersections); pair with Tree Statistics to verify branch counts before and after cleaning
contexts.simplify_workflow: Often combined with Simplify Tree — first clean nulls, then simplify path structure to reduce unnecessary nesting

7991bc5f-8a01-4768-bfb0-a39357ac6b84.errors: If X or E are both False, no cleaning occurs and output equals input. Empty branches may persist if only nulls are removed. Boolean inputs default behavior unknown without observations — verify defaults.

79a2eb73-658a-41a1-99e6-c12fe3357de0.name: Text Entity
79a2eb73-658a-41a1-99e6-c12fe3357de0.quick: Parameter container holding text entity geometry objects | no inputs, used to store/pass text entities between components
79a2eb73-658a-41a1-99e6-c12fe3357de0.description: Contains a collection of text entities

contexts.storing_text_geometry: Used as a persistent parameter to hold text entities (3D text objects with position/plane). Typically receives baked or referenced text geometry from Rhino or upstream text-creation components.
contexts.pipeline_passthrough: Acts as a typed container in a definition, ensuring downstream components receive correctly typed text entity data rather than generic geometry.

79a2eb73-658a-41a1-99e6-c12fe3357de0.errors: Fails if non-text-entity geometry is connected; no inputs means data must be internalized or referenced from Rhino document.

7a1e5fd7-b7da-4244-a261-f1da66614992.name: Power of 2
7a1e5fd7-b7da-4244-a261-f1da66614992.quick: Computes 2^x | Input x is exponent; output is 2 raised to that power
7a1e5fd7-b7da-4244-a261-f1da66614992.description: Raise 2 to the power of N.

contexts.bit_shifting_or_binary_scaling: Feed integer N into x to get powers of 2 (1,2,4,8,16…). Useful for binary subdivision counts or texture resolution steps. Pair with integer sliders.
contexts.inverse_of_logarithm: Use alongside Logarithm (base-10) or Natural Logarithm as inverse operations. Power of 2 undoes a base-2 log. Neighbors Power of E and Power of 10 follow same pattern for other bases.
contexts.exponential_growth_curves: Connect a range or series of numbers to x to generate exponential growth sequences. Output y feeds downstream math or graph components.

7a1e5fd7-b7da-4244-a261-f1da66614992.errors: Non-numeric Generic Data input will fail silently or return null. Very large x values may produce overflow. No observations available; infer from I/O that mismatched data types are the primary risk.

7ab8d289-26a2-4dd4-b4ad-df5b477999d8.name: Log N
7ab8d289-26a2-4dd4-b4ad-df5b477999d8.quick: Computes log base B of value V | B must be positive and not equal to 1; V must be positive
7ab8d289-26a2-4dd4-b4ad-df5b477999d8.description: Return the N-base logarithm of a number.

contexts.custom_base_logarithm: Wire any positive Number into V (the value) and a positive Number ≠ 1 into B (the base); outputs R = log_B(V). Use when Log (base-10) or Natural Log don't match your needed base.
contexts.inverse_of_power: Pair with Power of E or exponentiation logic to invert exponential relationships; e.g., if output = B^x, recover x via Log N with same B.

7ab8d289-26a2-4dd4-b4ad-df5b477999d8.errors: Fails or returns NaN if V ≤ 0 (logarithm undefined) or B ≤ 0 or B = 1 (invalid base); no domain clamping inferred from I/O types.

7b181be1-30e7-4a97-915a-1b461741aef8.name: Voronoi Cell
7b181be1-30e7-4a97-915a-1b461741aef8.quick: Computes a single 3D Voronoi cell (Brep) for point P given neighbor points N and bounding Box B.

contexts.single_cell_extraction: Wire one target point to P, a list of surrounding neighbor points to N, and a Box to B to get one Brep cell; useful when only one cell is needed rather than full 3D Voronoi decomposition.
contexts.custom_voronoi_workflow: Use alongside 3D Voronoi or Voronoi Groups when per-cell control is needed; feed the same point cloud as neighbors N and a bounding box derived from the cloud extents to B.
contexts.iterative_cell_generation: Loop over a point list using item-access or Dispatch, feeding each point as P with the remaining points as N to build cells one at a time.

7b181be1-30e7-4a97-915a-1b461741aef8.errors: Fails or returns null Brep if N is empty or missing (no neighbors to define cell boundaries); B must fully contain P or cell may be unbounded/invalid. Type mismatch if non-Point geometry fed to P or N.

7b36b876-9451-46f5-8220-a200d969cc66.name: Get Number
7b36b876-9451-46f5-8220-a200d969cc66.quick: Contextual numeric input parameter; outputs a number value from ambient/cluster context with no explicit inputs.

contexts.cluster_input: Used inside clusters or scripts to receive a numeric value from the calling context; no wiring needed on input side, output connects to downstream math or geometry ops.
contexts.scripting_context: Pairs with Get Boolean, Get Geometry, etc. to pull multiple typed values from context; output is a Number type compatible with standard numeric params.

7b36b876-9451-46f5-8220-a200d969cc66.errors: No output if context provides no numeric value; type mismatch if context passes non-numeric data to this parameter.

7b371d04-53e3-47d8-b3dd-7b113c48bc59.name: Atom Data
7b371d04-53e3-47d8-b3dd-7b113c48bc59.quick: Extracts detailed properties from an Atom input | requires Atom type object, outputs position, element, charge, radii, and numeric atomic data
7b371d04-53e3-47d8-b3dd-7b113c48bc59.description: Get detailed information for an atom

contexts.atomic_property_extraction: Wire an Atom object into A; outputs include Point (P) for position, Text for element (E), category (C), role (R), and integers/numbers for electron count (e), atomic number (AN), shell number (SN), ring number (RN), occupancy (O), temperature factor (T)
contexts.geometry_and_chemistry: Use P output to place geometry at atom positions in 3D space; combine with E or C outputs to filter or label atoms by element or category in molecular visualization workflows

7b371d04-53e3-47d8-b3dd-7b113c48bc59.errors: Fails if input A is not a valid Atom type — no implicit conversion from generic geometry or text. Outputs like AN, SN, RN may return null if atom lacks that property.

7d2a6064-51f0-45b2-adc4-f417b30dcd15.name: Complex Conjugate
7d2a6064-51f0-45b2-adc4-f417b30dcd15.quick: Flips sign of imaginary part of complex number (a+bi → a-bi) | Input must be Complex type, not plain number
7d2a6064-51f0-45b2-adc4-f417b30dcd15.description: Create the conjugate of a Complex number

contexts.complex_arithmetic: Wire output of Create Complex into C input; outputs conjugate Complex for use in modulus, division, or further math. Pair with Complex Modulus to compute magnitude squared (z × z̄ = |z|²).
contexts.signal_processing: Chain after Complex Components to inspect real/imaginary parts of conjugate. Use with Maximum/Minimum to compare magnitudes of original and conjugate (always equal).

7d2a6064-51f0-45b2-adc4-f417b30dcd15.errors: Fails if non-Complex type is wired to C input — use Create Complex first to convert real/imaginary pairs. No output if upstream complex creation fails.

7dd42002-75bb-4f41-857f-472a140b3b28.name: Serial Dimension
7dd42002-75bb-4f41-857f-472a140b3b28.quick: Annotates distances between multiple points projected onto a line | requires a Line (L), multiple Points (P), optional Text (T) and scale (S)
7dd42002-75bb-4f41-857f-472a140b3b28.description: Create a distance annotation between multiple points, projected to a line.

contexts.multi-point_dimensioning: Wire a reference Line to L, a list of Points to P for sequential distance annotations; T overrides labels, S controls text size. Points are projected onto L for measurement.
contexts.drawing_annotation: Used alongside Aligned Dimension and Linear Dimension for annotating geometry in viewport; outputs display only — no geometry output to wire downstream.

7dd42002-75bb-4f41-857f-472a140b3b28.errors: No outputs — cannot wire to other components. Points not near the line may produce unexpected projected distances. Missing L input causes failure; P needs 2+ points for meaningful annotation.

7e266319-a439-481e-afa5-daa09ab97417.name: Query Model Linetypes

7e266319-a439-481e-afa5-daa09ab97417.description: Query a Rhino document for all available linetypes

contexts.filter_linetypes: Connect text string to N to filter linetypes by name pattern; outputs matching Model Linetype objects for use with drafting/annotation components
contexts.list_all_linetypes: Leave N empty or use wildcard to retrieve all available linetypes defined in the Rhino document model
contexts.assign_linetype: Wire L output to Model Linetype input on geometry or drafting components to apply specific linetypes to objects

7e266319-a439-481e-afa5-daa09ab97417.errors: No results if pattern N doesn't match any linetype name; returns empty if document has no custom linetypes defined beyond defaults

7e3185eb-a38c-4949-bcf2-0e80dee3a344.name: Cube
7e3185eb-a38c-4949-bcf2-0e80dee3a344.quick: Raises input x to the power of 3 (x³) | accepts numeric or generic data
7e3185eb-a38c-4949-bcf2-0e80dee3a344.description: Compute the cube of a value

contexts.basic_math: Connect a Number or expression to x; output y returns x³. Useful in polynomial equations or scaling operations where cubic relationships are needed.

7e3185eb-a38c-4949-bcf2-0e80dee3a344.errors: Non-numeric generic data may fail silently or return null; very large inputs can produce overflow values. No observations available — infer from Generic Data type flexibility.

7e9489e0-122d-401a-aba8-f1dae0217c40.name: Circular Dimension
7e9489e0-122d-401a-aba8-f1dae0217c40.quick: Creates angle annotation projected onto a circle | Requires Circle, two Points (A, B), optional Text and Scale number
7e9489e0-122d-401a-aba8-f1dae0217c40.description: Create an angle annotation projected to a circle.

7e9489e0-122d-401a-aba8-f1dae0217c40.errors: No outputs — cannot pass result downstream. Points A/B must lie on or relate to Circle C plane; mismatched planes or null Circle input will likely cause no annotation to display.

7ed18011-746c-415e-88a7-dd1c9d7ffc8d.name: Point Light

contexts.place_new_light: Connect a Point component to L input to position the light; leave Pl empty to create new. Outputs Pl (light object) and L (position) for downstream use.
contexts.modify_existing: Pass an existing light into Pl input along with new L point to reposition. Chain with other light components (Directional, Rectangular) for multi-light setups.
contexts.render_pipeline: Wire Pl output into render environment or document bake workflow. Pair with Query Model Environments to manage scene lighting.

7ed18011-746c-415e-88a7-dd1c9d7ffc8d.errors: Null output if L input is not a valid Point type. No light created if both inputs are disconnected. Point light has no direction, so directional properties are ignored.

7f3681b2-84bb-4da1-ba7a-c19bce165595.name: Logical And Filter
7f3681b2-84bb-4da1-ba7a-c19bce165595.quick: Combines two Predicate filters with logical AND; both must be true for items to pass.

7f5c6c55-f846-4a08-9c9a-cfdc285cc6fe.name: Scribble

7fa15783-70da-485c-98c0-a099e6988c3e.name: Culture
7fa15783-70da-485c-98c0-a099e6988c3e.quick: Stores/passes culture specifier values (e.g., en-US, fr-FR) | no inputs, outputs culture data for locale-sensitive operations
7fa15783-70da-485c-98c0-a099e6988c3e.description: Contains a collection of culture specifiers

contexts.locale_formatting: Used as a parameter container to supply culture info to components that format numbers or text differently by locale; wire output to culture-sensitive formatting inputs
contexts.data_pipeline: Acts like Text or Integer params — a primitive holder; right-click to set culture value, then pass downstream to components requiring locale context

7fa15783-70da-485c-98c0-a099e6988c3e.errors: No inputs means value must be set via right-click menu; if downstream component expects specific culture format, mismatched or unset culture may cause formatting errors

7fe5b7ab-f156-48e2-bc80-b97a046e109f.name: Display Colour
7fe5b7ab-f156-48e2-bc80-b97a046e109f.quick: Gets/sets object display colour attributes (source S and colour C) | Works as getter and setter depending on inputs provided

contexts.reading_display_colour: Connect object's Dc attribute output to Dc input; outputs S (source integer: by-layer, by-object, etc.) and C (actual colour value) for inspection or downstream use
contexts.setting_display_colour: Wire a Colour component to C and an integer to S to construct a Display Colour attribute; feed resulting Dc into object attribute workflows alongside Render Material or Object Linetype
contexts.attribute_pipeline: Used within rhino_objects attribute pipelines; pair with Query Model Objects to read existing colours, or feed into object attribute setters to override display colour

7fe5b7ab-f156-48e2-bc80-b97a046e109f.errors: <S> integer out of valid source range may produce unexpected colour behaviour; supplying no C when S expects by-object colour may yield null colour output

80e3614a-25ae-43e7-bb0a-760e68ade864.name: Plane Region
80e3614a-25ae-43e7-bb0a-760e68ade864.quick: Creates a closed curve region from intersecting planes; P=cutting planes, B=boundary planes defining the region extent.
80e3614a-25ae-43e7-bb0a-760e68ade864.description: Create a bounded region from intersecting planes.

contexts.bounded_region_from_planes: Feed a list of planes into P and boundary planes into B; output R is a closed curve representing the polygon formed by plane intersections. Useful for generating planar cut regions.
contexts.section_geometry: Often paired with Brep|Plane or Plane|Plane neighbors to first find intersection lines, then bound them into a closed region curve for further surface or area operations.

80e3614a-25ae-43e7-bb0a-760e68ade864.errors: Fails if planes in P are parallel (no intersection). No region produced if B boundary planes don't fully enclose the intersection geometry. Output R may be null if inputs are coplanar or insufficient planes provided.

80e55fc2-933b-4bfb-a353-12358786dba8.name: Offset Curve Loose
80e55fc2-933b-4bfb-a353-12358786dba8.quick: Offsets curve by moving control points, not arc-length distance | result shape differs from standard Offset Curve
80e55fc2-933b-4bfb-a353-12358786dba8.description: Offset the control-points of a curve with a specified distance.

contexts.loose_stylistic_offset: Wire curve (C), number distance (D), and plane (P) defining offset direction; outputs approximate offset by displacing CVs — useful when exact offset fidelity is less important than speed or smooth result
contexts.comparison_with_standard_offset: Use instead of Offset Curve when you want a looser, potentially smoother result; standard Offset Curve preserves arc-length distance, this one does not — compare outputs side by side
contexts.planar_curves: Plane input (P) controls the offset direction plane; for flat curves supply the construction plane matching the curve's plane to get predictable 2D offset behavior

80e55fc2-933b-4bfb-a353-12358786dba8.errors: Wrong offset direction if plane (P) doesn't match curve's plane; non-planar curves may produce unexpected results since control-point displacement ignores curvature; null output if curve or distance is invalid

8102032b-9699-4949-ab12-3017a31d1062.name: QuadTree
8102032b-9699-4949-ab12-3017a31d1062.quick: Builds 2D quadtree spatial subdivision from points | requires a base Plane (Pl) and integer Grid depth (G)

contexts.spatial_subdivision: Feed a point cloud into P, set Pl as the reference plane (e.g. XY), toggle S for subdivision mode, set G (integer) for depth/granularity; outputs Q (cell boundary curves) and P (cell center points) for downstream mesh or analysis ops
contexts.proximity_analysis: Use output P (cell centers) with Delaunay Mesh or Convex Hull 3D to build adaptive meshes denser where input points cluster; Q curves visualize cell boundaries

8102032b-9699-4949-ab12-3017a31d1062.errors: Empty Q/P if P input has no points or G=0; mismatched plane orientation causes off-axis subdivision; very high G values may produce excessive cells and slow performance

8159a06a-1e33-498e-8884-97d3f76d1d7c.name: Query Named Views
8159a06a-1e33-498e-8884-97d3f76d1d7c.quick: Returns all named views from Rhino doc as Model Content | N filters by text pattern
8159a06a-1e33-498e-8884-97d3f76d1d7c.description: Query a Rhino document for all available named views

contexts.list_all_named_views: Leave N empty to retrieve all named views; output V provides Model Content items usable with Model View component to activate or reference specific views
contexts.filtered_view_lookup: Pass a text pattern to N to filter named views by name; useful when document has many saved views and only specific ones are needed downstream
contexts.viewport_workflow: Typically wired to Model View or used alongside Query Viewports to distinguish named saved views from active viewports in automation scripts

8159a06a-1e33-498e-8884-97d3f76d1d7c.errors: <~30 tokens: No output if no named views exist in document; invalid pattern in N may return empty list silently

81800098-1060-4e2b-80d4-17f835cc825f.name: Disjoint
81800098-1060-4e2b-80d4-17f835cc825f.quick: Returns true if sets A and B share no common elements | both inputs accept generic data
81800098-1060-4e2b-80d4-17f835cc825f.description: Test whether two sets are disjoint.

contexts.set_membership_check: Wire two lists into A and B; outputs single Boolean R. True means no overlap. Pair with Set Intersection to confirm: if intersection is empty, Disjoint returns true.
contexts.filtering_logic: Use R output to drive conditional logic — e.g., gate downstream operations only when two groups of objects are completely separate with no shared members.

81800098-1060-4e2b-80d4-17f835cc825f.errors: Returns false (not disjoint) if any single element matches between A and B. Comparison is value-based; mismatched data types between A and B may cause all elements to appear disjoint even when logically equivalent.

81dfff08-0c83-4f1b-a358-14791d642d9e.name: Time
81dfff08-0c83-4f1b-a358-14791d642d9e.quick: Stores a collection of times/dates as a parameter; no inputs, outputs DateTime values directly
81dfff08-0c83-4f1b-a358-14791d642d9e.description: Contains a collection of times and dates

contexts.date_time_input: Used as a standalone parameter panel to supply DateTime values to downstream components; right-click to set date/time values manually; outputs a list of DateTime objects
contexts.scheduling_or_filtering: Wire output into components that accept DateTime type for filtering, sorting, or time-based logic; similar pattern to Integer or Text params

81dfff08-0c83-4f1b-a358-14791d642d9e.errors: No inputs to wire incorrectly; downstream errors likely if connected component expects Number or Text instead of DateTime type

81f6afc9-22d9-49f0-8579-1fd7e0df6fa6.name: Point Groups
81f6afc9-22d9-49f0-8579-1fd7e0df6fa6.quick: Groups nearby points by proximity distance D; outputs grouped points G and group index I per point

contexts.clustering_points: Feed a flat list of points into P and a threshold number into D; G returns points reorganized by group, I returns integer group index per point — use I to partition downstream geometry by cluster
contexts.downstream_grouping: Pair with Closest Point or Project Point to first filter/project points, then group results by proximity; use I indices with List Item or Partition List to isolate each cluster

81f6afc9-22d9-49f0-8579-1fd7e0df6fa6.errors: If D is too small, every point becomes its own group; if D is too large, all points merge into one group. Mismatched data trees between P and D may cause grouping errors. Expects Point type for P — curves or surfaces will fail.

8248da39-0729-4e04-8395-267b3259bc2f.name: Convex Edges
8248da39-0729-4e04-8395-267b3259bc2f.quick: Returns edge indices (convex, concave, mixed) from a Brep | outputs are integer indices, not edge geometry
8248da39-0729-4e04-8395-267b3259bc2f.description: Select concave or convex brep edges.

contexts.filtering_brep_edges: Connect a Brep to B; use Cv (convex indices) or Cc (concave indices) with 'Edges from Faces' or list item components to extract actual edge curves for downstream use
contexts.edge_classification: Mx output returns mixed/non-manifold edge indices; useful for identifying problem edges or complex topology in solids and polysurfaces

8248da39-0729-4e04-8395-267b3259bc2f.errors: Outputs are integer indices — must use with edge extraction component to get geometry; open or non-manifold Breps may produce unexpected Mx results; null if B is not a valid Brep

82f19c48-9e73-43a4-ae6c-3a8368099b08.name: Set Intersection
82f19c48-9e73-43a4-ae6c-3a8368099b08.quick: Returns unique items present in both sets A and B | duplicates removed, order not guaranteed
82f19c48-9e73-43a4-ae6c-3a8368099b08.description: Creates the intersection of two sets (the collection of unique objects present in both sets).

contexts.filtering_common_elements: Wire two Generic Data lists to A and B; output U contains only items appearing in both. Pair with Member Index to locate positions of shared items in original sets.
contexts.set_logic_pipeline: Use alongside SubSet to first test inclusion, then extract shared members. Combine with Disjoint to branch logic when sets share no elements.
contexts.deduplication: Because output is a set (unique objects), Set Intersection inherently removes duplicates from the shared items — useful when both input lists may have repeated values.

82f19c48-9e73-43a4-ae6c-3a8368099b08.errors: Empty output if sets share no common items (not an error, but unexpected if inputs are mismatched types). Type mismatches between A and B (e.g., numbers vs. strings) will yield empty intersection since equality checks fail across types.

831aceec-b30d-439e-99ce-bae5daf25bfe.name: Integer
831aceec-b30d-439e-99ce-bae5daf25bfe.quick: Stores/passes integer values; floats auto-truncated to whole numbers | right-click to set value
831aceec-b30d-439e-99ce-bae5daf25bfe.description: Contains a collection of integer numbers

contexts.slider_replacement: Use when you need a fixed whole number; right-click > Set Integer to hardcode values like panel counts, iterations, or indices
contexts.data_input: Wire into components expecting integer inputs (e.g., Series N, Divide count); avoids accidental float passing
contexts.list_of_integers: Can hold multiple integers via right-click > Manage Integer Collection; useful for fixed index lists

831aceec-b30d-439e-99ce-bae5daf25bfe.errors: Floats wired in get truncated silently; no inputs means value must be set manually or component outputs null

83c81431-17bc-4bff-bb85-be0a846bd044.name: SubD Faces
83c81431-17bc-4bff-bb85-be0a846bd044.quick: Extracts face data from SubD: center points (P), face corner count (C), edge indices (E), vertex indices (V)
83c81431-17bc-4bff-bb85-be0a846bd044.description: Extract all face data from a SubD.

contexts.face_analysis: Connect SubD (from SubD Box or SubD from Mesh) to S; outputs P (face center points), C (corner count per face), E (edge index text), V (vertex index text) for topology inspection
contexts.topology_query: Use C output to identify quad vs triangle faces; pair with SubD Edges for full mesh topology breakdown; useful before SubD Fuse operations

83c81431-17bc-4bff-bb85-be0a846bd044.errors: Null output if S receives non-SubD geometry; E and V are Text (index lists), not geometry — don't wire to geometry inputs downstream

846470bd-4918-4d00-9388-7e022b2cba73.name: Knot Vector
846470bd-4918-4d00-9388-7e022b2cba73.quick: Constructs a NURBS knot vector from count (N), degree (D), and periodic flag (P) | N must be >= D+1
846470bd-4918-4d00-9388-7e022b2cba73.description: Construct a nurbs curve knot vector.

contexts.nurbs_curve_construction: Feed K output into a NURBS Curve component alongside control points and weights. N = number of control points, D = curve degree (e.g. 3 for cubic), P = true for periodic/closed curves.
contexts.manual_knot_control: Use when default knot vectors are insufficient. Set P=false for clamped (open) curves, P=true for uniform periodic. Output K is a list of Numbers representing knot parameter values.

846470bd-4918-4d00-9388-7e022b2cba73.errors: Fails or produces invalid results if N < D+1 (insufficient control points for degree). Mismatched N/D with downstream NURBS Curve control point count causes curve construction failure.

8465bcce-9e0a-4cf4-bbda-1a7ce5681e10.name: Box Mapping
8465bcce-9e0a-4cf4-bbda-1a7ce5681e10.quick: Maps geometry from source box (S) to target box (T), outputting transformed geometry and transform matrix.
8465bcce-9e0a-4cf4-bbda-1a7ce5681e10.description: Transform geometry from one box into another.

contexts.geometry_remapping: Wire geometry to G, define source box S (original space) and target box T (destination space); outputs remapped geometry. Useful for fitting/distorting geometry between two bounding volumes.
contexts.transform_reuse: Output X (Transform) can be applied to other geometry via Transform component, enabling consistent box-to-box mapping across multiple objects.
contexts.deformation_workflow: Pair with Box component to define S from geometry bounds, then specify T manually to stretch/reposition geometry into a new spatial region.

8465bcce-9e0a-4cf4-bbda-1a7ce5681e10.errors: Fails if S or T boxes are degenerate (zero volume). Geometry outside source box S may produce unexpected extrapolated results. Non-matching box orientations cause skewed output.

847cf05e-e195-4bc7-b472-e05459b9792b.name: Reverse Surface
847cf05e-e195-4bc7-b472-e05459b9792b.quick: Flips U, V, or W parameterization directions of a surface | Boolean toggles control which axes are reversed
847cf05e-e195-4bc7-b472-e05459b9792b.description: Reverse directions of surface parameterization (U, V, and W)

contexts.fixing_normal_direction: Connect surface to S, set U/V True to flip parameterization; use before Surface Frames or Divide Surface when normals point inward or UV orientation is misaligned
contexts.isotrim_reordering: Reverse U or V before Isotrim to reorder how isoparametric subsets are extracted, correcting panel sequencing or domain orientation
contexts.offset_surface_prep: Reverse surface direction before Offset Surface to ensure offset goes in intended direction when normals are flipped

847cf05e-e195-4bc7-b472-e05459b9792b.errors: No effect if all U/V/W are False. W only relevant for volumetric/polysurface contexts; may have no visible effect on standard surfaces. Non-surface input causes type error.

84d708eb-a8dc-4afd-94eb-ba953fddfd19.name: 3D Delaunay
84d708eb-a8dc-4afd-94eb-ba953fddfd19.quick: 3D Delaunay triangulation of a point cloud; outputs tetrahedral edges (E) and connectivity counts (C) | requires 3D (non-coplanar) points
84d708eb-a8dc-4afd-94eb-ba953fddfd19.description: Computes the 3D delaunay of a pointcloud based based on MIConvexHull by David Sehnal, Matthew Campbell

contexts.volumetric_structure: Feed a 3D point cloud into P; E outputs tetrahedral edge lines usable for spatial frame structures; C gives integer connectivity data per tetrahedron
contexts.voronoi_pairing: Often paired with 3D Voronoi (same MIConvexHull library) to get dual volumetric tessellation; share same point input P for consistent topology
contexts.mesh_conversion: E lines can be used to reconstruct mesh faces or fed into Plankton/CreatePlankton for halfedge mesh workflows

84d708eb-a8dc-4afd-94eb-ba953fddfd19.errors: Fails or gives degenerate results if points are coplanar/collinear (2D input); too few points (<4) cannot form tetrahedra; duplicate points may cause instability

84fa917c-1ed8-4db3-8be1-7bdc4a6495a2.name: Variable
84fa917c-1ed8-4db3-8be1-7bdc4a6495a2.quick: Stores a named script-friendly variable/data collection for use in scripting components | No typed inputs or outputs — acts as a flexible data container
84fa917c-1ed8-4db3-8be1-7bdc4a6495a2.description: Contains a collection of script-friendly data

contexts.scripting_integration: Used alongside VB Script, Expression, or Evaluate components to pass named variables; holds arbitrary data without type enforcement, wired into script inputs
contexts.data_passing: Acts as a named placeholder/container between scripting nodes; useful when passing collections of mixed data into Expression or Evaluate components

84fa917c-1ed8-4db3-8be1-7bdc4a6495a2.errors: No inputs/outputs defined — cannot be directly wired like typed params; data must be accessed via scripting context. Likely fails if expected to behave as a standard param.

850b6368-ff26-48ce-9773-ac554ffbaeef.name: Point Cloud
850b6368-ff26-48ce-9773-ac554ffbaeef.quick: Parameter container holding point cloud geometry; no inputs, outputs stored cloud data for downstream use
850b6368-ff26-48ce-9773-ac554ffbaeef.description: Contains a collection of point clouds

contexts.data_storage: Acts as a persistent parameter holding one or more point clouds; right-click to set/internalize cloud data; wire output to mesh, transform, or analysis components
contexts.pipeline_source: Used as a source node at the start of a definition; connects to components expecting point cloud geometry such as mesh reconstruction or spatial analysis tools

850b6368-ff26-48ce-9773-ac554ffbaeef.errors: No inputs means data must be internalized or referenced from Rhino; fails silently if no cloud is set — downstream components receive null geometry

8555a743-36c1-42b8-abcc-06d9cb94519f.name: Construct Domain²
8555a743-36c1-42b8-abcc-06d9cb94519f.quick: Combines two 1D domains (U, V) into a Domain² | Both inputs must be Domain type, not raw numbers
8555a743-36c1-42b8-abcc-06d9cb94519f.description: Create a two-dimensional domain from two simple domains.

contexts.surface_parameterization: Wire U and V domains (e.g., from Divide Domain or manual Construct Domain) to define a 2D parameter space for Divide Domain² or surface evaluation
contexts.domain_construction: Pair with Deconstruct Domain² to round-trip a Domain²; use when you have separate U/V ranges that need combining for surface or grid operations

8555a743-36c1-42b8-abcc-06d9cb94519f.errors: Fails if U or V inputs are numbers instead of Domain type — use Construct Domain first to convert number pairs into domains before wiring here

859daa86-3ab7-49cb-9eda-f2811c984070.name: Point In Breps
859daa86-3ab7-49cb-9eda-f2811c984070.quick: Tests if a point is inside a collection of closed Breps | Breps must be closed/solid; open Breps will fail or return unreliable results
859daa86-3ab7-49cb-9eda-f2811c984070.description: Test whether a point is inside a collection of closed breps

contexts.containment_filtering: Wire a list of closed Breps to B, a point to P, set S (strict) as needed. Output I (Boolean) drives Dispatch to filter points inside vs outside; i returns index of containing Brep.
contexts.multi_brep_index: When multiple closed Breps overlap, i (Integer) identifies which Brep contains the point — useful for zone/region assignment workflows.
contexts.point_cloud_testing: Feed a flattened point list to P with a single or multiple Breps; use I output with Cull Pattern to retain only interior points.

859daa86-3ab7-49cb-9eda-f2811c984070.errors: Fails or returns false negatives if Breps are open/non-manifold. S (strict) toggle affects boundary-coincident points. Null or non-Brep geometry on B input causes component error.

8600a3fc-30f0-4df6-b126-aaa79ece5bfe.name: Swap Rows
8600a3fc-30f0-4df6-b126-aaa79ece5bfe.quick: Swaps two rows in a matrix by index | A and B are zero-based row indices
8600a3fc-30f0-4df6-b126-aaa79ece5bfe.description: Swap two rows in a matrix

contexts.row_reordering: Connect a Matrix to M, provide two Integer indices (A, B) to swap those rows; outputs modified Matrix. Often used before Deconstruct Matrix to reorder data.
contexts.matrix_manipulation: Pair with Swap Columns or Transpose Matrix for broader matrix restructuring. Construct Matrix first if building from scratch.

8600a3fc-30f0-4df6-b126-aaa79ece5bfe.errors: Out-of-range indices (A or B >= row count) likely cause null/error output. Passing non-integer or negative indices will fail. Swapping same index (A==B) is valid but redundant.

86503240-d884-43f9-9323-efe30488a6e1.name: Characters
86503240-d884-43f9-9323-efe30488a6e1.quick: Splits text into individual characters; outputs character list (C) and count (U)

contexts.character_analysis: Feed text string to T; C outputs each character as separate text item in a list; U gives total character count as integer. Useful before Text Join or Concatenate for reordering/filtering.
contexts.text_processing_pipeline: Pair with Text Fragment or Text Join to extract, rearrange, or reconstruct characters. Works well upstream of Concatenate when custom character-level manipulation is needed.

86503240-d884-43f9-9323-efe30488a6e1.errors: Null or empty text input produces empty C list and U=0. Non-text types must be converted to string first. Multi-line text splits newline characters as individual items.

866222ee-6093-4af8-8944-2f9264885385.name: TriRemesh
866222ee-6093-4af8-8944-2f9264885385.quick: Remeshes Brep or Mesh into near-equilateral triangles | Length controls target edge size; Iters controls refinement quality
866222ee-6093-4af8-8944-2f9264885385.description: Convert a Brep or Mesh into a mesh of near equilateral triangles

contexts.brep_to_trimesh: Connect Brep to Geometry, set Length for target edge size, increase Iters for smoother result; outputs T (remeshed mesh), D (dual mesh), C (feature lines)
contexts.preserving_sharp_edges: Enable Sharp boolean to preserve hard edges/creases; wire curves or edges into Features to protect specific geometry during remeshing
contexts.guided_remesh: Wire an existing mesh into Target to guide density distribution; useful for adaptive remeshing where detail varies across surface
contexts.downstream_to_plankton: T output feeds directly into CreatePlankton for halfedge mesh operations; D (dual) useful for Voronoi-like patterns

866222ee-6093-4af8-8944-2f9264885385.errors: Null output if Geometry is invalid or non-manifold; very small Length values with high Iters can cause long compute times or crashes; Features input expects curves/edges — wrong type causes silent ignore of feature constraints

866ee39d-9ebf-4e1d-b209-324c56825605.name: Brep Topology
866ee39d-9ebf-4e1d-b209-324c56825605.quick: Returns face-face (FF), face-edge (FE), and edge-face (EF) adjacency indices for a Brep | outputs are integer index lists
866ee39d-9ebf-4e1d-b209-324c56825605.description: Get and display the topology of a brep.

contexts.topology_analysis: Connect a Brep to B; FF outputs face-to-face adjacency pairs, FE outputs face-to-edge pairs, EF outputs edge-to-face pairs — useful for mesh-like traversal or connectivity analysis of solid/surface geometry
contexts.paired_with_deconstruct: Use alongside Deconstruct Brep to cross-reference topology indices with actual faces/edges; integer outputs index into the Brep's face and edge lists
contexts.adjacency_queries: Use FF to find neighboring faces, EF to find which faces share an edge — helpful for identifying non-manifold or boundary conditions

866ee39d-9ebf-4e1d-b209-324c56825605.errors: Null or invalid Brep input returns no data; open or degenerate Breps may produce incomplete adjacency lists; outputs are flat integer lists requiring careful indexing to interpret correctly

86720a45-ee9e-49d6-b65e-494c06f66e59.name: Jump
86720a45-ee9e-49d6-b65e-494c06f66e59.quick: Navigation shortcut to jump between canvas locations | no data I/O, purely organizational

contexts.canvas_navigation: Place Jump components as paired bookmarks on large canvases; clicking jumps viewport to linked location. No wiring needed — purely a UI/navigation aid.
contexts.organization: Use alongside Get Data and other param_utilities to manage sprawling definitions; helps locate distant canvas sections without scrolling.

86720a45-ee9e-49d6-b65e-494c06f66e59.errors: No data inputs/outputs means no data errors. Failure mode: linked Jump target not set, so clicking does nothing. Purely UI — won't affect computation.

86a9944b-dea5-4126-9433-9e95ff07927a.name: Triangular
86a9944b-dea5-4126-9433-9e95ff07927a.quick: Generates 2D triangular cell grid; P=base plane, S=cell size, Ex/Ey=cell count per axis → curves and points

contexts.basic_grid_generation: Connect a Plane (e.g., XY Plane) to P, a Number slider to S for cell size, and Integer sliders to Ex/Ey for grid extent. Outputs C (triangle curves) and P (cell/node points).
contexts.surface_paneling: Feed output C or P into Triangular Panels A or surface mapping components to tile triangular geometry onto surfaces. Pair with Rectangular or Hexagonal for comparative grid layouts.
contexts.point_sampling: Use output P (grid points) as sample locations for data mapping, attractor fields, or driving other geometry. Points correspond to triangle vertices or centroids.

86a9944b-dea5-4126-9433-9e95ff07927a.errors: Wrong output if S=0 or negative (zero-size cells). Ex/Ey must be positive integers; non-integer or zero values likely cause empty/null output. Plane input required — missing P may default to World XY or error.

87391af3-35fe-4a40-b001-2bd4547ccd45.name: Location
87391af3-35fe-4a40-b001-2bd4547ccd45.quick: Stores latitude-longitude coordinate collection; no inputs, outputs location data for geo-referenced workflows.
87391af3-35fe-4a40-b001-2bd4547ccd45.description: Contains a collection of latitude-longitude coordinates

contexts.geo_referencing: Used as a parameter container for lat-lon coordinates; right-click to set location data; feeds into components requiring geographic position inputs.
contexts.data_storage: Acts as a persistent parameter holding location collections, similar to how Plane or Vector params store geometric data; no wiring inputs required.

87391af3-35fe-4a40-b001-2bd4547ccd45.errors: No inputs to mis-wire; errors likely from empty/unset parameter (no location defined) or downstream components expecting specific coordinate formats.

874eebe7-835b-4f4f-9811-97e031c41597.name: Group
874eebe7-835b-4f4f-9811-97e031c41597.quick: Combines multiple geometry objects into a single group object | output is a Group type, not raw geometry

contexts.organizing_geometry: Wire multiple geometry inputs to G; outputs a grouped set useful for passing geometry collections as a single unit before Ungroup or downstream transforms
contexts.data_tree_consolidation: Often used after Flatten Tree to collect flattened geometry into one group; pairs with Shift Paths when managing branch structure before grouping

874eebe7-835b-4f4f-9811-97e031c41597.errors: Downstream components expecting raw geometry (Brep, Curve, etc.) may fail if fed a Group output directly — use Ungroup first to extract members

884646c3-0e70-4ad1-90c5-42601ee26450.name: Reduce
884646c3-0e70-4ad1-90c5-42601ee26450.quick: Removes least significant vertices from a polyline by tolerance T | only works on polylines, not smooth curves
884646c3-0e70-4ad1-90c5-42601ee26450.description: Reduce a polyline by removing least significant vertices.

contexts.simplify_polyline: Wire a polyline curve into P; set T (number) as tolerance threshold — higher T removes more vertices. Output P is reduced polyline, R is count of removed vertices. Useful before offsetting or filleting to reduce complexity.
contexts.mesh_boundary_cleanup: Use after extracting mesh boundary polylines to reduce vertex count before further curve operations. Pair with Simplify Curve for smooth curves; Reduce targets polylines specifically.

960a32ab-3e64-4075-855d-df701ee924e7.name: Query Model Block Definitions

97c28a7c-5d5a-4b3d-a935-b8730e88749b.name: DeconstructPlankton
97c28a7c-5d5a-4b3d-a935-b8730e88749b.quick: Decomposes a Plankton halfedge mesh into full topology arrays (vertices, halfedge adjacency, face links) | Input must be PlanktonMesh type, not standard GH Mesh
97c28a7c-5d5a-4b3d-a935-b8730e88749b.description: Decompose a plankton mesh into its topology information

contexts.vertex_neighbor_queries: Use V_He (vertex→outgoing halfedge) combined with He_P (pair halfedge) to walk vertex one-rings; V outputs Point3d positions for geometry reconstruction
contexts.face_analysis: F_He gives one halfedge per face; chain He_Nxt to collect all face vertices; useful after Delaunay Mesh or Quad Remesh converted to Plankton

97c28a7c-5d5a-4b3d-a935-b8730e88749b.errors: Fails if input is standard GH Mesh — must convert via CreatePlankton first. Null/empty PlanktonMesh yields no outputs. Integer index outputs are raw topology; out-of-range indexing in downstream logic causes silent errors.

983c7600-980c-44da-bc53-c804067f667f.name: Perp Frames

988fbdfd-d3eb-4ead-ab83-d0db9f2a36d9.name: Model Block Definition

98c2a1f2-5ba6-4be0-8999-c540097406c2.name: Mesh CullUnused Vertices

98c2a1f2-5ba6-4be0-8999-c540097406c2.description: Cull (remove) all vertices that are currently not used by the Face list

98c2a1f2-5ba6-4be0-8999-c540097406c2.errors: Null or non-mesh input causes no output; if mesh has no unused vertices, output is identical to input (no visible change, not an error); degenerate meshes with no faces will cull all vertices.

98c2a1f2-5ba6-4be0-8999-c540097406c5.name: Mesh UnifyNormals

98c3c63a-e78a-43ea-a111-514fcf312c95.name: Create Set

9c9f8219-ae88-4d29-ba1b-3433ed713639.description: Mirror a shape in a freeform curve.

9cacad37-b09f-4b54-b2b1-1ccdc2e3ffea.name: Sporph

9d0c5284-ea24-4f9f-a183-ef57fc48b5b8.name: Convex Hull

9d4854fe-70db-4863-967b-4120d0b6d2e4.name: Voronoi Groups
