contexts.basic_geometry: Connect a Plane to Pln, Number for Rad (size), and Trunc (0=full tetrahedron, 1=fully truncated). Output Plato is Generic Data — likely mesh or brep, requires casting downstream.
contexts.truncated_form: Vary Trunc with a slider (0 to 1) to morph between standard and truncated tetrahedron. Pair with similar Platonic Octahedron for comparative platonic solid studies.
contexts.positioning: Use Plane component or Construct Plane to orient tetrahedron in 3D space via Pln input. Rad scales the solid uniformly.

1d27e28c-c3e9-4371-ac6a-416bac497b78.errors: Output is Generic Data — direct use in surface/mesh operations may fail without explicit casting. Trunc values outside 0–1 may produce degenerate geometry. Null Plane defaults to WorldXY but may error if unconnected.

2019c995-53af-4eb2-976d-95b1fdc823fa.name: Load
2019c995-53af-4eb2-976d-95b1fdc823fa.quick: Load | Inputs: Point, Force vector, Weighting → Unary

20b86e86-2311-465d-9f3a-9e2f9cb662c9.name: Mobius Surface
20b86e86-2311-465d-9f3a-9e2f9cb662c9.quick: Generates a Möbius strip surface | U/V control mesh resolution, R=radius, T=thickness, S=scale, D1/D2=parameter domains

contexts.basic_generation: Connect integer sliders to U and V for mesh density, number slider to R for radius and T for tube thickness; output Srf is Generic Data—feed into Surface or Mesh components for display
contexts.domain_control: D1 and D2 accept Domain inputs (e.g., from Domain component) to control the parametric range of the Möbius surface; default domains likely 0-1 or 0-2π
contexts.comparison_with_similar: Sits alongside Klein Surface, Enneper Surface, Conoid in LunchBox form family—all produce Generic Data outputs requiring downstream type conversion for standard GH surface ops

20b86e86-2311-465d-9f3a-9e2f9cb662c9.errors: Output is Generic Data, not native Brep/Surface—direct connection to surface-expecting inputs will fail; very low U/V values may produce degenerate geometry; R=0 collapses surface

2128cde3-9694-40b0-874c-670c89341acd.name: AnchorXYZ
2128cde3-9694-40b0-874c-670c89341acd.quick: Constrains a point along selected world axes (X/Y/Z toggles) | Disconnect/reconnect P to reset initial position
2128cde3-9694-40b0-874c-670c89341acd.description: Fix a point only along chosen world axes. If you need to reset the initial position, disconnect then reconnect the Point input.

contexts.partial_constraint: Wire a mesh vertex or particle point to P; toggle X/Y/Z booleans true to fix those axes, false to allow free movement. Strength controls stiffness. Output A feeds Kangaroo solver.
contexts.sliding_along_axis: Set two axes true, one false to create a rail-like constraint — point slides only along the free axis. Combine with Load or Floor goals for physics-driven sliding.
contexts.resetting_position: If geometry changes and anchor drifts, disconnect P input then reconnect to re-capture the new initial position before re-running solver.

2128cde3-9694-40b0-874c-670c89341acd.errors: Wrong initial position locked in: disconnect/reconnect P to fix. All axes false = no constraint, goal has no effect. Strength too low may allow drift under competing goals like Load or Bomb.

22643c83-7db2-46fd-bf0a-36801978754c.name: Deserialize Geometry
22643c83-7db2-46fd-bf0a-36801978754c.quick: Converts serialized string (JSON, XML, or Binary) back to GH geometry | Input must be valid serialized geometry string
22643c83-7db2-46fd-bf0a-36801978754c.description: Deserialize string (JSON, XML, or Binary) to Grasshopper geometry.

contexts.roundtrip_serialization: Wire output of Serialize Geometry component directly into Text input; outputs Generic Data geometry ready for use in GH pipeline
contexts.data_storage_retrieval: Read serialized geometry strings from file or panel, feed into Text input to reconstruct geometry objects for further operations
contexts.format_flexibility: Accepts JSON, XML, or Binary string formats — ensure format matches what was used during serialization to avoid parse failures

22643c83-7db2-46fd-bf0a-36801978754c.errors: Fails if Text input is malformed, wrong format, or not produced by a compatible Serialize Geometry operation; outputs Generic Data may need type casting downstream

236d3928-a06f-4c60-bd2d-787691421391.name: CoLinear
236d3928-a06f-4c60-bd2d-787691421391.quick: Kangaroo2 goal: pulls a set of points toward collinearity | Strength controls force weight

contexts.physics_simulation: Feed a list of Points (e.g., from curve control points or mesh vertices) and a Strength number into a Kangaroo2 solver via the C output. Higher Strength forces points closer to a shared line.
contexts.alignment_relaxation: Use alongside CoPlanar or CoCircular goals to enforce geometric constraints simultaneously in a Kangaroo solver. All co-goals output Generic Data fed into the solver's Goals input.

236d3928-a06f-4c60-bd2d-787691421391.errors: Fails if Points list has fewer than 2 points or contains nulls. Strength of 0 produces no effect. Output C must connect to a Kangaroo solver Goals input — wiring elsewhere yields no result.

2491e794-8360-4317-b0ad-4950f6e0906a.name: Combine&Clean
2491e794-8360-4317-b0ad-4950f6e0906a.quick: Joins a list of meshes into one, removing duplicate/unused vertices | input must be a list of meshes
2491e794-8360-4317-b0ad-4950f6e0906a.description: Combine and Clean a list of meshes, removing unused and duplicate vertices

contexts.pre_simulation_cleanup: Feed multiple mesh pieces into M (list); outputs single cleaned mesh ready for Kangaroo2 simulation. Typically placed before HingePoints or Refine to ensure topology is valid.
contexts.post_refinement_merge: After ByParent or RefineStrips produce multiple sub-meshes, use Combine&Clean to reunify them into one clean mesh with no duplicate vertices at seams.

2491e794-8360-4317-b0ad-4950f6e0906a.errors: Fails or produces bad topology if non-mesh geometry is passed; duplicate vertices at seams won't be welded if meshes have mismatched vertex positions (floating point gaps).

24e2b0d2-d7b8-4478-8a83-1f04cba701a1.name: EdgeLengths
24e2b0d2-d7b8-4478-8a83-1f04cba701a1.quick: EdgeLengths | Inputs: Mesh, LengthFactor, Strength → EL

24f82a13-a700-45e0-9528-8646323d4af2.name: HingePoints
24f82a13-a700-45e0-9528-8646323d4af2.quick: Extracts 4 hinge points per internal mesh edge for use in Kangaroo2 Hinge Force goals | requires clean mesh with shared internal edges
24f82a13-a700-45e0-9528-8646323d4af2.description: Get the 4 points for each internal edge to use in a Hinge Force

contexts.kangaroo_bending_simulation: Connect mesh (often pre-processed with Combine&Clean) to M; outputs 4 points (edge endpoints + opposite face vertices) wired directly into a Hinge Force component for bending stiffness simulation
contexts.mesh_refinement_pipeline: Use after Refine or RefineStrips to get denser internal edges, then feed HingePoints output into Hinge Force for finer bending control

24f82a13-a700-45e0-9528-8646323d4af2.errors: Outputs empty if mesh has no internal edges (open mesh with all boundary edges). Mesh must be clean/welded — duplicate or unused vertices from uncleaned meshes may produce incorrect point sets; use Combine&Clean first.

259e0d29-431e-47e3-b556-2ed9bd797b00.name: Flatness Check
259e0d29-431e-47e3-b556-2ed9bd797b00.quick: Measures flatness of quad panel surfaces | Input must be quad/planar-ish Surface; outputs F (flatness value), P (point?), D (deviation?)
259e0d29-431e-47e3-b556-2ed9bd797b00.description: Checks the flatness of a quad panel.

contexts.panel_fabrication: Feed quad surfaces from paneling tools into Panels input; F output gives flatness metric, D likely gives max deviation from plane — use to filter panels exceeding fabrication tolerance
contexts.quality_check: Wire panel surfaces directly; compare F or D values against threshold using conditional components to flag non-flat panels for redesign

259e0d29-431e-47e3-b556-2ed9bd797b00.errors: Fails or gives meaningless results if non-quad (triangular or n-gon) surfaces are input; trimmed surfaces may cause issues; outputs are Generic Data so downstream type casting may be needed

25c345c7-9bd6-471a-974c-8fd901adf4b5.name: Create RTree
25c345c7-9bd6-471a-974c-8fd901adf4b5.quick: Builds a spatial RTree index from geometry for fast nearest-neighbor queries | feed into RTree Closest Point

contexts.nearest_neighbor_search: Wire a list of geometry (points, curves, breps) into Geo; output RTree connects directly to 'RTree Closest Point' component to find closest geometry to search points efficiently
contexts.large_dataset_optimization: Use when querying closest points across large point clouds or geometry sets; RTree spatial indexing avoids brute-force distance checks

25c345c7-9bd6-471a-974c-8fd901adf4b5.errors: Fails or returns null if Geo input is empty or contains unsupported geometry types; RTree output is opaque generic data — only usable with compatible LunchBox RTree query components

26e5dee7-a353-4d76-b0ee-48814b6ea92d.name: Create XML from Tree
26e5dee7-a353-4d76-b0ee-48814b6ea92d.quick: Converts a Grasshopper data tree (text/numbers) to XML and writes to file | Write toggle must be True to output
26e5dee7-a353-4d76-b0ee-48814b6ea92d.description: Create XML from a Grasshopper tree containing text or numbers.

contexts.export_tree_to_xml: Wire a text/number tree into Tree, provide file Path (string), set Write to True. Output XML can be read back with Read XML by Tag. Pair with Panel to preview structure.
contexts.data_pipeline: Used alongside Create JSON and Create DataSet as alternative serialization. Tree branch/path structure maps to XML hierarchy. Numbers and text supported; geometry not accepted.

26e5dee7-a353-4d76-b0ee-48814b6ea92d.errors: <~30 tokens: Write=False produces no file output; non-text/number tree data likely fails; invalid Path string causes write error>

26efde70-0c5c-4181-af3e-1a767d64b449.name: Volume
26efde70-0c5c-4181-af3e-1a767d64b449.quick: Kangaroo2 goal: constrains total mesh volume to target value V | requires closed mesh
26efde70-0c5c-4181-af3e-1a767d64b449.description: Set the total volume of a mesh

contexts.inflatable_simulation: Wire closed mesh to M, target volume number to V, Strength controls stiffness. Combine with SoapFilm or EdgeLengths goals in Kangaroo solver to simulate pressure-inflated forms.
contexts.volume_preservation: Use alongside Smooth or EdgeLengths goals to maintain volume while deforming mesh. Output V feeds into Kangaroo solver goal list as Generic Data.

26efde70-0c5c-4181-af3e-1a767d64b449.errors: Fails or produces nonsense if mesh is open (volume undefined). Zero or negative V input likely causes solver instability. Mesh must be valid and manifold.

28bedc62-006a-4f19-b97d-e12b20aff875.name: MagnetSnap
28bedc62-006a-4f19-b97d-e12b20aff875.quick: Snaps nearby points together in Kangaroo2 simulation | R sets proximity threshold radius
28bedc62-006a-4f19-b97d-e12b20aff875.description: Snap points together according to proximity

contexts.particle_clustering: Feed particle Points from solver, set R as snap radius distance, Strength controls pull force. Output S goal connects to Kangaroo solver Goals input alongside Anchor/Load goals.
contexts.form_finding: Use with AnchorXYZ to constrain snapped clusters while allowing free axes. Lower Strength for soft snapping, higher for rigid merging of nearby points.

28bedc62-006a-4f19-b97d-e12b20aff875.errors: No snap occurs if R is too small relative to point spacing. Zero or null Strength disables goal. Points must be live solver particles, not static geometry — wrong input type yields null S output.

2b3f5029-cfec-4f95-96d1-757bd9c51da1.name: VertexLoads
2b3f5029-cfec-4f95-96d1-757bd9c51da1.quick: Applies equal vertical (gravity-like) loads to all mesh vertices | outputs goal object for Kangaroo solver, not geometry
2b3f5029-cfec-4f95-96d1-757bd9c51da1.description: Apply equal vertical loads to all vertices of a mesh

contexts.gravity_simulation: Connect a mesh (e.g., from Loft or SoapFilm) to Mesh, set negative Strength for downward force; feed L into Kangaroo solver Goals list alongside EdgeLengths or SoapFilm goals
contexts.form_finding: Combine with SoapFilm or Smooth goals in Kangaroo solver to find equilibrium shapes under vertical loading; Strength controls load magnitude per vertex

2b3f5029-cfec-4f95-96d1-757bd9c51da1.errors: Wrong type if non-mesh geometry connected to Mesh input; no visible output until fed into Kangaroo solver; zero or missing Strength produces no load effect

2daea094-2b19-4961-b22d-1df0e4beb0f5.name: Mesh Offset
2daea094-2b19-4961-b22d-1df0e4beb0f5.quick: Offsets mesh along vertex normals by a distance; Solid? and Both Sides? control whether result is closed or double-sided.
2daea094-2b19-4961-b22d-1df0e4beb0f5.description: Offsets a mesh object using the vertex normals of the source mesh.

contexts.simple_shell_offset: Connect a mesh to Mesh input, wire a Number slider to Offset. Set Solid? False for open shell. Output is Generic Data — may need casting back to Mesh.
contexts.solid_thickened_mesh: Set Solid? True to cap the offset into a closed solid. Useful for fabrication thickness. Pair with Mesh Edges to check for naked edges afterward.
contexts.double_sided_offset: Enable Both Sides? True to offset symmetrically in both normal directions, creating a centered thickened shell around the original mesh.

2daea094-2b19-4961-b22d-1df0e4beb0f5.errors: Output is Generic Data, not Mesh — downstream mesh components may fail without explicit cast. Non-manifold or inverted normals produce irregular offsets. Zero or null Offset value yields coincident geometry.

2e1fb4fb-22a8-4853-a9f5-ab65602aad77.name: Pressure
2e1fb4fb-22a8-4853-a9f5-ab65602aad77.quick: Applies area-proportional normal force to each mesh triangle | Strength drives inflation/deflation; mesh must be triangulated
2e1fb4fb-22a8-4853-a9f5-ab65602aad77.description: A force normal to each triangle, and proportional to its area

contexts.inflating_membrane: Connect triangulated mesh to M, numeric strength to Strength, output P fed into Kangaroo solver alongside EdgeLengths or SoapFilm goals to simulate inflated membrane or balloon
contexts.pressure_with_volume: Pair with Volume goal to constrain total enclosed volume while Pressure drives outward normal forces; both goals fed to solver as list
contexts.soap_film_inflation: Combine with SoapFilm goal: SoapFilm minimizes area while Pressure inflates, producing minimal-surface-like pressurized forms

2e1fb4fb-22a8-4853-a9f5-ab65602aad77.errors: Fails or gives unexpected results if mesh is not triangulated (quads unsupported); zero or null Strength produces no force; open meshes may inflate unpredictably without boundary constraints

2f3fd2e9-2cc4-47be-af5a-2f3916f76a92.name: Bomb
2f3fd2e9-2cc4-47be-af5a-2f3916f76a92.quick: Kangaroo2 goal: explodes points outward from Location after N iterations | Detonation sets iteration countdown
2f3fd2e9-2cc4-47be-af5a-2f3916f76a92.description: Causes an explosion after a given number of iterations

contexts.particle_explosion: Wire Location (Point) as blast center, Points as affected simulation points, Detonation (Integer) as iteration trigger, Strength (Number) as force magnitude. Output B feeds Kangaroo solver goals list.
contexts.resetting_simulation: Use Reset (Boolean) input to re-arm the bomb. Toggle Reset to restart detonation countdown, similar to AnchorXYZ disconnect/reconnect pattern for resetting state.

2f3fd2e9-2cc4-47be-af5a-2f3916f76a92.errors: No explosion if Detonation iteration count exceeds simulation steps run. Strength=0 produces no displacement. Points not in solver will be unaffected. Output B must connect to Kangaroo solver Goals input or nothing happens.

302feaef-a1f1-4089-8b09-4892dc6fce16.name: Read XML by Tag
302feaef-a1f1-4089-8b09-4892dc6fce16.quick: Extracts inner text and inner XML from an XML string by tag name | XML input must be valid XML text, Tag must match exactly

contexts.parsing_xml_output: Wire XML text (from Create XML from Tree or file read) into XML input; provide tag name string to Tag; outputs InnerText (plain content) and InnerXML (content with child markup) for matched nodes
contexts.chained_xml_workflow: Typically follows Create XML from Tree or precedes Convert XML to JSON; use InnerXML output to drill into nested tags by chaining multiple Read XML by Tag components

302feaef-a1f1-4089-8b09-4892dc6fce16.errors: No output if Tag name doesn't match case-sensitively or XML is malformed; multiple matching tags may return a list — ensure downstream components handle data trees

313490f5-8e38-4dde-9e9a-05e4d739b35d.name: Solver
313490f5-8e38-4dde-9e9a-05e4d739b35d.quick: Kangaroo2 physics solver | feed GoalObjects list, toggle Reset to restart simulation, On to run
313490f5-8e38-4dde-9e9a-05e4d739b35d.description: The main component where Goals are combined and applied

contexts.basic_simulation: Connect Goal components (Anchor, Length, etc.) into GoalObjects as flattened list; wire Toggle to Reset and On; outputs V=solved point positions, O=goal output geometry, I=iteration count
contexts.iterative_solving: Set Threshold/Tolerance to control convergence stopping criteria; lower values = more precise but slower; use I output to monitor iteration count
contexts.extracting_results: V outputs solved particle positions as Points; O outputs goal-specific geometry; use Show component to visualize mid-solve; downstream components read from O per goal type

313490f5-8e38-4dde-9e9a-05e4d739b35d.errors: Simulation won't start if On=False or Reset stuck True; GoalObjects must be flat list — nested trees cause missing goals; mismatched anchor indices cause instability

33d13c41-30e0-55d9-4144-c40791381949.name: Weaverbird's Unify face windings
33d13c41-30e0-55d9-4144-c40791381949.quick: Normalizes all mesh face normals to a consistent winding direction | Input must be a mesh geometry
33d13c41-30e0-55d9-4144-c40791381949.description:
Makes sure that the face winding is in one direction, when possible.

Provided by Weaverbird 0.9.0.1.

contexts.pre_subdivision: Feed mesh into M before Weaverbird subdivision ops; consistent winding prevents inverted normals and shading artifacts in output mesh O
contexts.post_join: Use after Weaverbird's Join Meshes and Weld when merged meshes may have inconsistent face orientations; pipe joined mesh into M
contexts.rendering_prep: Place before export or rendering to ensure normals face outward uniformly; O outputs corrected mesh ready for downstream use

33d13c41-30e0-55d9-4144-c40791381949.errors: Fails silently or produces no change if mesh topology prevents unification (non-orientable surfaces like Möbius strips); non-mesh geometry input will cause type error

35644787-bd9d-4440-b1d5-b8879699afcd.name: Create DataSet
35644787-bd9d-4440-b1d5-b8879699afcd.quick: Bundles named DataTables into a DataSet container | Tables input expects DataTable objects (from Create DataTable)

contexts.data_pipeline: Wire one or more DataTable outputs into Tables input, provide a Name string; output DataSet feeds Create JSON or Create XML for serialization
contexts.export_workflow: Chain Create DataTable → Create DataSet → Create JSON/CSV to structure and export tabular data from Grasshopper

35644787-bd9d-4440-b1d5-b8879699afcd.errors: Tables input expects DataTable Generic Data — passing raw lists or non-DataTable objects will likely produce null/empty DataSet; Name must be non-empty text

35c49588-244d-43a4-81b2-fd3ef59c1b1d.name: Soft & Hard Solver
35c49588-244d-43a4-81b2-fd3ef59c1b1d.quick: Kangaroo2 solver separating soft (energy-minimizing) from hard (constraint) goals; hard goals run inner iterations first
35c49588-244d-43a4-81b2-fd3ef59c1b1d.description: Solver with separate inputs for soft goals, and hard constraint type goals

contexts.form_finding_with_constraints: Wire geometry goals to SoftGoals, rigid constraints (anchors, lengths) to HardGoals. HardIterations controls inner loops per step; SoftMultiplier scales soft goal strength relative to hard. Reset/On toggle simulation.
contexts.replacing_standard_solver: Drop-in alternative to standard Solver when some goals must be strictly enforced (hard) while others flex (soft). V output gives solved point positions; O returns goal output data for downstream use.
contexts.tuning_convergence: Increase HardIterations for stiffer constraint satisfaction before soft goals apply. Adjust Threshold/Tolerance to control when solver considers converged. I output tracks iteration count.

35c49588-244d-43a4-81b2-fd3ef59c1b1d.errors: Mixing incompatible goal types across SoftGoals/HardGoals inputs causes solver instability. HardIterations=0 effectively ignores hard constraints. Forgetting Reset toggle leaves solver in stale state after geometry changes.

370e8c20-a977-45d1-987d-d26c4a4df0ca.name: Diagrid Structure
370e8c20-a977-45d1-987d-d26c4a4df0ca.quick: Maps diagonal grid structure onto a surface | U/V control grid density; T toggles diagonal orientation
370e8c20-a977-45d1-987d-d26c4a4df0ca.description: Creates a diagrid structure on a surface.

contexts.facade_paneling: Connect NURBS surface to Srf, set U/V integers for grid resolution; outputs Lines (structural members) and Nodes (connection points) for further detailing
contexts.structural_layout: Wire Lines to pipe or beam components; wire Nodes to point-based connection detail geometry; T boolean switches between two diagrid orientations
contexts.density_control: U and V are integers controlling subdivisions in each surface direction — low values give coarse diagrid, high values give dense pattern

370e8c20-a977-45d1-987d-d26c4a4df0ca.errors: <~30 tokens: Non-NURBS or untrimmed surfaces may fail; mismatched U/V values can produce irregular diagonals; T must be Boolean not integer

38a071b4-9887-4828-86fb-d301d7f61fd6.name: Conoid Surface
38a071b4-9887-4828-86fb-d301d7f61fd6.quick: Generates Plücker's Conoid parametric surface | U/V control mesh resolution; R, T, S shape parameters; D1/D2 define UV domains

contexts.basic_generation: Set U/V integers (e.g. 20x20) for mesh density, R for radius, T and S for shape variation, D1/D2 as domains (e.g. 0 to 2π). Output Srf is Generic Data — may need casting to Surface for downstream ops like paneling or analysis.
contexts.domain_control: D1 and D2 inputs accept Domain type; use Domain component or construct with numbers. Adjusting these clips or extends the parametric surface range, useful for partial conoid forms.
contexts.form_exploration: Pairs well with Mobius Surface, Enneper Surface, Klein Surface neighbors for comparative parametric surface studies. Output feeds into mesh, paneling, or fabrication workflows.

38a071b4-9887-4828-86fb-d301d7f61fd6.errors: Output is Generic Data, not native Surface — downstream components expecting Brep/Surface may fail without explicit cast. Low U/V values produce coarse geometry. Invalid domain inputs (null or reversed) likely cause no output.

390c8a3b-9f14-4c66-bacd-13410333c118.name: Enneper Surface
390c8a3b-9f14-4c66-bacd-13410333c118.quick: Generates parametric Enneper minimal surface mesh | U/V control resolution, a controls shape order, S scales, D1/D2 set UV domains

contexts.basic_surface_generation: Connect integer sliders to U and V (e.g., 10–30) for mesh resolution, integer to 'a' for surface order (typically 1–3), Number to S for scale. D1/D2 accept Domain inputs (e.g., from Domain component) defaulting to standard UV range. Output Srf is Generic Data, likely a mesh or surface.
contexts.parametric_exploration: Vary 'a' integer to change the number of self-intersecting lobes on the Enneper surface. Pair with neighbors like Klein Surface or Mobius Surface for comparative minimal surface studies. Use Construct Domain to feed custom D1/D2 ranges.

390c8a3b-9f14-4c66-bacd-13410333c118.errors: <~30 tokens: Low U/V integers produce coarse mesh; 'a' values outside expected range may cause self-intersections or degenerate geometry. Srf outputs Generic Data — may need casting before downstream surface ops.

3962cf86-9b9e-41d7-94f9-42bd0326291d.name: TangentIncircles
3962cf86-9b9e-41d7-94f9-42bd0326291d.quick: Kangaroo2 goal: pack tangent incircles in mesh faces | outputs goal object (TI) for Kangaroo solver, not geometry directly

contexts.circle_packing: Connect mesh (M) from a base mesh component, boundary curve (B) to constrain edge circles, Strength as number slider; feed TI output into Kangaroo solver Goals list alongside other mesh goals like Smooth or EdgeLengths
contexts.architectural_paneling: Use with SoapFilm or CyclicQuad goals to generate meshes where each face contains a tangent incircle — useful for fabrication-aware paneling workflows

3962cf86-9b9e-41d7-94f9-42bd0326291d.errors: Null output if M is not a valid mesh or B curve doesn't match mesh boundary; TI is generic goal data — plugging directly into geometry components will fail; Strength=0 disables goal effect

39a12e0c-25a7-43ce-9546-115f3a211a0c.name: RefineStrips
39a12e0c-25a7-43ce-9546-115f3a211a0c.quick: Subdivides quad mesh strips in one direction only | L controls subdivision count; input must be quad mesh
39a12e0c-25a7-43ce-9546-115f3a211a0c.description: Directional subdivision, refines quads in one direction only

contexts.directional_refinement: Connect quad mesh to M, integer level to L; outputs refined mesh with quads split along one axis only — useful for paneling or structural strip patterns
contexts.kangaroo_simulation_prep: Use before Kangaroo solver to increase mesh resolution in one direction; pair with Combine&Clean to merge meshes and remove duplicate vertices before feeding simulation
contexts.strip_paneling: Wire alongside ByParent to track which refined faces belong to original parent quads; useful for fabrication workflows needing directional panel density

39a12e0c-25a7-43ce-9546-115f3a211a0c.errors: Fails or produces unexpected results on non-quad or mixed meshes; L=0 or negative integer likely returns unchanged mesh; triangulated meshes incompatible with directional subdivision logic

3b1c0717-2c58-2a99-00a0-57604cd5549a.name: Weaverbird's Mesh Mesh Icosahedron
3b1c0717-2c58-2a99-00a0-57604cd5549a.quick: Generates a mesh icosahedron (20-face polyhedron) | P sets orientation/position, W controls size/radius
3b1c0717-2c58-2a99-00a0-57604cd5549a.description:
Construct a mesh (Mesh Icosahedron)

Provided by Weaverbird 0.9.0.1.

contexts.base_geometry: Connect a Plane (e.g., XY Plane) to P and a Number slider to W for radius; outputs closed triangulated Mesh ready for Weaverbird subdivision or smoothing
contexts.subdivision_workflow: Feed O into Weaverbird Catmull-Clark or Loop subdivision components to create smooth sphere-like meshes; icosahedron topology subdivides evenly due to all-triangle faces
contexts.positioning: Use Plane component or Construct Plane to orient icosahedron in 3D space; default plane likely World XY if P left unconnected

3b1c0717-2c58-2a99-00a0-57604cd5549a.errors: Null output if W is zero or negative; no Plane input may default to World XY but could error in some versions — always provide explicit Plane

3c30b1a1-4473-4ad4-a700-ea9770726c03.name: Anchor
3c30b1a1-4473-4ad4-a700-ea9770726c03.quick: Anchor | Inputs: Point, Target, Strength → A

3c822206-4de9-484f-9ccb-8bc5b563ccff.name: Rhino Command
3c822206-4de9-484f-9ccb-8bc5b563ccff.quick: Sends a text command to Rhino's command-line when Send (bool) is triggered | command executes immediately on True
3c822206-4de9-484f-9ccb-8bc5b563ccff.description: Sends a command to the Rhino command-line.

contexts.automation: Wire a Button or Toggle to Send; pass command string (e.g., '_Zoom _Extents') to Command. Useful for triggering Rhino operations like zoom, redraw, or layer changes from GH.
contexts.bake_workflow: Often paired with Object Bake or Object Save — run a Rhino command after baking to finalize or export geometry programmatically.
contexts.external_workflow: Used alongside Launch Application to coordinate Rhino-side actions before/after external app calls.

3c822206-4de9-484f-9ccb-8bc5b563ccff.errors: No output to confirm success; command silently fails if string is malformed or requires interactive input. Toggle Send carefully — fires every solution if left True.

3d13a415-6ac5-4b59-9677-3975e4696a85.name: Grab
3d13a415-6ac5-4b59-9677-3975e4696a85.quick: Enables interactive dragging of Kangaroo particles in Rhino viewport | Must be wired into Solver as a Goal
3d13a415-6ac5-4b59-9677-3975e4696a85.description: This lets you drag Kangaroo particles in Rhino viewports

contexts.interactive_simulation: Wire G output into Solver Goals list alongside other goals. Set On=True, tune Strength and Range. Hold Alt+LMB to drag particles; LMB+RMB toggles anchors during live simulation.
contexts.controlled_dragging: Use Boolean toggle for On to enable/disable grab interactivity. Strength controls pull force; Range sets capture radius around cursor. Higher Strength overrides soft goals.

3d13a415-6ac5-4b59-9677-3975e4696a85.errors: No effect if not connected to an active Solver. Grab inactive if On=False. Range too small may fail to capture particles; Strength too high may destabilize simulation.

3e563215-b163-4843-4c37-e1512b636ecc.name: Weaverbird's Vertices Component
3e563215-b163-4843-4c37-e1512b636ecc.quick: Extracts mesh vertices as points | Input G must be a mesh; W (Boolean) likely controls welded/unwelded vertex output
3e563215-b163-4843-4c37-e1512b636ecc.description:
Returns the point representation of a mesh.

Provided by Weaverbird 0.9.0.1.

contexts.mesh_analysis: Connect mesh from Weaverbird smoothing ops (Laplacian, LaplacianHC) to G; outputs P as point list for downstream analysis, manipulation, or re-meshing
contexts.vertex_editing: Use after Bevel Edges or subdivision to extract resulting vertex positions; feed P into Move or transform components before rebuilding mesh
contexts.wireframe_pairing: Pair with Weaverbird's Mesh Edges to get both vertex points and edge curves simultaneously for full mesh topology extraction

3e563215-b163-4843-4c37-e1512b636ecc.errors: Fails if G is not a valid mesh (curves or surfaces rejected); W=false may return duplicate vertices at seams; null/empty mesh yields no output

3efefe13-1114-4638-521c-602969182936.name: Weaverbird's Sierpinski Triangles Subdivision
3efefe13-1114-4638-521c-602969182936.quick: Sierpinski triangle subdivision: places corner triangles in each mesh face, adding one hole per face | L controls iteration levels
3efefe13-1114-4638-521c-602969182936.description:
Places a triangle in each corner of a mesh face. The mesh will have one more hole per face.

Provided by Weaverbird 0.9.0.1.

contexts.fractal_mesh_patterning: Connect mesh geometry to M, integer level to L; each iteration subdivides corners into triangles and punches holes; works on triangulated or polygonal meshes; chain iterations for deeper fractal detail
contexts.combining_with_other_wb_subd: Often paired with Weaverbird's Split Polygons (which also uses Sierpinski triangles) or Sierpinski Carpet for multi-pattern holed mesh exploration; output O feeds into further Weaverbird operations

3efefe13-1114-4638-521c-602969182936.errors: Non-mesh geometry input to M will fail; high L values cause exponential face/hole growth leading to crashes or memory issues; non-triangulated faces may produce unexpected hole topology

3f8b0f83-6e8e-4a9d-b0ff-9474cc9eb89b.name: Beam
3f8b0f83-6e8e-4a9d-b0ff-9474cc9eb89b.quick: Defines a structural beam goal resisting bending and torsion in Kangaroo2 6DOF simulation | requires start/end frames AND nodes as Planes

contexts.structural_simulation: Wire StartFrame/EndFrame (local orientation planes at beam ends) and StartNode/EndNode (rigid body planes) from Kangaroo solver nodes; supply E (Young's modulus), A (cross-section area), Ix/Iy (second moments of area), GJ (torsional stiffness) as Numbers; output B feeds Kangaroo solver
contexts.beam_with_supports: Pair with Support component at StartNode or EndNode planes to set boundary conditions; frames define beam orientation, nodes track rigid body positions during simulation

3f8b0f83-6e8e-4a9d-b0ff-9474cc9eb89b.errors: Fails if StartFrame/EndFrame and StartNode/EndNode are not Planes; mismatched frame vs node assignments cause incorrect bending axis; zero or null E/A/Ix/Iy/GJ values produce degenerate stiffness behavior

4098ec7a-819a-4ced-9ccc-86835d7e21c9.name: Weaverbird's Sierpinski Carpet
4098ec7a-819a-4ced-9ccc-86835d7e21c9.quick: Creates Sierpinski carpet mesh: punches quad holes in each face center | Input mesh M, inset depth D, inset type T; output is always quad mesh
4098ec7a-819a-4ced-9ccc-86835d7e21c9.description:
Computes a new mesh with higher genus, where each face has a new hole in the center. The resulting mesh always consists of quad faces.

Provided by Weaverbird 0.9.0.1.

contexts.fractal_subdivision: Connect a base quad or triangulated mesh to M; set D (number) to control hole size/depth; T (InsetTypeEnum) selects inset method. Output O feeds into further Weaverbird ops like Mesh Thicken or Bevel Edges for solid results.
contexts.higher_genus_modeling: Use after Weaverbird subdivision to create perforated surfaces. Wire O to Weaverbird's Picture Frame or Mesh Window for layered hole effects. Always outputs quads regardless of input face type.

4098ec7a-819a-4ced-9ccc-86835d7e21c9.errors: Fails or produces degenerate mesh if M is not a valid closed/open mesh geometry; D too large collapses holes into invalid faces; non-mesh geometry input not accepted

4098ec7a-819a-4ced-9ccc-86835d7e25c9.name: Weaverbird's Mesh Window
4098ec7a-819a-4ced-9ccc-86835d7e25c9.quick: Insets each mesh face inward, creating a smaller face per original face | D controls inset distance; T sets inset type (uniform vs. per-edge)
4098ec7a-819a-4ced-9ccc-86835d7e25c9.description:
Replaces each original mesh face with a new one, reconstructed on the inside. Each face has the same number of sides as the original one.

Provided by Weaverbird 0.9.0.1.

contexts.facade_paneling: Connect mesh geometry to M, drive D with a slider (0–1 range typical) to control inset depth; T selects inset method. Output O feeds into Weaverbird smoothing or further subdivision.
contexts.perforation_pattern: Apply to a base mesh to create window-like openings; combine output with Weaverbird's Mesh Edges to extract frame wireframes or with Join Mesh for boolean-style effects.
contexts.iterative_refinement: Chain output O back into another Mesh Window or LaplacianHC Smoothing to progressively refine inset geometry while preserving face topology.

4098ec7a-819a-4ced-9ccc-86835d7e25c9.errors: Fails or produces degenerate faces if D is too large (faces collapse inward past center); non-manifold or open meshes on M may cause unexpected results. T must match valid InsetTypeEnum values.

4098ec7a-819a-4ced-9eee-86835d7e21c9.name: Weaverbird's Catmull-Clark Subdivision
4098ec7a-819a-4ced-9eee-86835d7e21c9.quick: Weaverbird's Catmull-Clark Subdivision | Inputs: Mesh/Curves, Level, Smooth Naked Edges → Output Mesh/Curves

4098ec8a-819a-4ced-9ccc-86835d7e21cd.name: Weaverbird's Picture Frame
4098ec8a-819a-4ced-9ccc-86835d7e21cd.quick: Creates quad-only mesh with hole in each face (picture frame effect) | D controls inset distance, T sets inset type
4098ec8a-819a-4ced-9ccc-86835d7e21cd.description:
Computes a new mesh with higher genus, where each face has a new hole in the center and resembles a picture frame. The resulting mesh always consists of quad faces.

Provided by Weaverbird 0.9.0.1.

contexts.architectural_facade: Feed base mesh into M, set D (number) for frame thickness, choose T (InsetTypeEnum) for inset method; output O is all-quad mesh with holes per face, ready for further subdivision
contexts.mesh_perforation: Use after a base mesh generator; D drives how much border remains around each hole — small D = thin frame, large D = small hole; output always quads regardless of input face type
contexts.combining_with_weaverbird: Chain O into Weaverbird subdivision or Bevel Edges for refined results; compare with Mesh Window (no hole, same sides) when quads specifically needed

4098ec8a-819a-4ced-9ccc-86835d7e21cd.errors: Fails or produces degenerate mesh if D is too large (frame collapses) or zero; non-mesh geometry in M will error; invalid InsetTypeEnum value in T causes failure

4098ecba-269a-1ced-9ce4-86836dae2101.name: Weaverbird's Face Polylines
4098ecba-269a-1ced-9ce4-86836dae2101.quick: Extracts each mesh face as a closed polyline loop | one polyline per face, output count matches face count
4098ecba-269a-1ced-9ce4-86836dae2101.description:
Returns the polygonal representation of a mesh: as though each face would be made of a closed polyline loop.

Provided by Weaverbird 0.9.0.1.

contexts.face_analysis: Wire M (mesh) → P outputs one closed polyline per face; use with Weaverbird's Vertices or Mesh Edges for full mesh decomposition. Useful for per-face geometry operations.
contexts.pattern_generation: Feed P curves into curve-based operations (offset, scale, loft) to generate per-face patterns. Pair with List Item or Graft to isolate individual face loops.
contexts.covering_detection: Output P can feed into Weaverbird's Discover Covering and Retrim — curves must be in matching order to compare face groupings correctly.

4098ecba-269a-1ced-9ce4-86836dae2101.errors: Null output if M input is not a valid mesh or is empty. Non-manifold or degenerate faces may produce malformed polylines. Output count mismatch if mesh has ngons mixed with triangles unexpectedly.

4098ecba-299a-1ced-9ce4-86835dae21c9.name: Weaverbird's Mesh Edges
4098ecba-299a-1ced-9ce4-86835dae21c9.quick: Extracts all mesh edges as lines (wireframe) from a Weaverbird mesh | Input must be mesh geometry, not surfaces or curves
4098ecba-299a-1ced-9ce4-86835dae21c9.description:
Returns the wireframe representation of a mesh.

Provided by Weaverbird 0.9.0.1.

contexts.visualization: Connect any Weaverbird-processed mesh to G; outputs L (lines) for display or piping into curve-based components like Pipe or Loft for wireframe aesthetics
contexts.edge_analysis: Feed smoothed mesh (from Laplacian or LaplacianHC) into G to extract edge lines; useful for comparing edge density before/after subdivision
contexts.bevel_prep: Use alongside Weaverbird's Bevel Edges to identify edges prior to beveling; output lines can help select or filter specific edges

4098ecba-299a-1ced-9ce4-86835dae21c9.errors: Fails or returns null if G receives non-mesh geometry (surfaces, polysurfaces, curves); no output if mesh has zero faces or is invalid/open in unexpected ways

4142e474-4707-4d9e-af4e-f4bbed4d9279.name: Create Data Grid
4142e474-4707-4d9e-af4e-f4bbed4d9279.quick: Displays tabular data in a grid UI; accepts Headers and Values as Text lists | no outputs — visual/export only, save as CSV
4142e474-4707-4d9e-af4e-f4bbed4d9279.description: Creates a Data Grid view of data.  Data can be saved as CSV file.

contexts.data_review: Wire flat or nested Text lists to Values; provide column name strings to Headers. Grid renders in Grasshopper canvas for inspection. Pair with Create CSV or Write XML File for export.
contexts.csv_export: Feed structured Text data rows into Values with matching Headers; use the built-in CSV save option to export without needing a separate file-write component.

4142e474-4707-4d9e-af4e-f4bbed4d9279.errors: Mismatch between Headers count and column count in Values may produce misaligned grid. Non-text input types must be converted to Text first. No outputs means downstream wiring is not possible.

41910ccd-37aa-4c63-ba32-34632cd01f82.name: Klein Surface
41910ccd-37aa-4c63-ba32-34632cd01f82.quick: Generates a parametric Klein surface mesh/surface | U, V control resolution; R, T, S shape parameters; D1, D2 set UV domains

contexts.basic_generation: Connect integer sliders to U and V for surface resolution, number sliders to R, T, S for shape control; D1/D2 domains (e.g., 0 to 2π) define UV range; Srf output is Generic Data, likely a surface or mesh for downstream use
contexts.domain_tuning: D1 and D2 domain inputs control parametric range; typical Klein surface uses 0–2π for both; adjusting these clips or extends the surface topology
contexts.form_exploration: Pair with neighbors like Mobius Surface or 3D Supershape for comparative non-orientable/exotic surface studies; Srf output feeds into Bake, Mesh, or analysis components

41910ccd-37aa-4c63-ba32-34632cd01f82.errors: Srf outputs Generic Data — may need casting to Surface or Mesh before geometry operations. Zero or very low U/V values likely cause null output. Invalid domain inputs may produce degenerate geometry.

4327c857-28b9-4c60-9f1e-20e2b9b21607.name: Hash Objects
4327c857-28b9-4c60-9f1e-20e2b9b21607.quick: Generates SHA hash string from geometry or text input | output is a unique fingerprint string per object
4327c857-28b9-4c60-9f1e-20e2b9b21607.description: Use a Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA) to hash geometry or strings.

contexts.geometry_fingerprinting: Connect geometry output to obj; Hash output gives unique SHA string per shape — useful for detecting duplicate or changed geometry across iterations
contexts.string_hashing: Feed text/string data into obj; returns SHA hash for comparison or identity checks without exposing original content
contexts.change_detection: Pair with Serialize Geometry neighbor — serialize geometry first, then hash to track version changes or validate data integrity

4327c857-28b9-4c60-9f1e-20e2b9b21607.errors: Non-serializable or null data in obj may produce empty or error hash; list mismatches if obj receives mixed types without proper data alignment

435f31b6-89bf-4825-8d8d-a3f663bc01b1.name: Subdivide Triangle
435f31b6-89bf-4825-8d8d-a3f663bc01b1.quick: Subdivides a triangle curve into self-similar sub-triangles | N controls subdivision depth; Tri must be a closed triangular curve
435f31b6-89bf-4825-8d8d-a3f663bc01b1.description: Subdivides a triangle into self-similar cells.

contexts.panel_subdivision: Wire a triangular curve into Tri, set N (integer) for subdivision level; B1-B4 booleans toggle subdivision pattern variants; Wires boolean shows/hides wire display; outputs TriA/TriB are two sets of resulting sub-triangle geometry
contexts.mesh_generation: Pair with Triangle Panels B to first generate triangular panels on a surface, then feed individual triangles into Subdivide Triangle for finer tessellation control

435f31b6-89bf-4825-8d8d-a3f663bc01b1.errors: Fails if Tri is not a closed triangular curve (wrong curve type or non-triangular polygon); N=0 or negative produces no subdivision; Generic Data outputs may need type casting before further geometry operations

4408343b-577e-4fd8-96ff-df7549189186.name: ZombieSolver
4408343b-577e-4fd8-96ff-df7549189186.quick: ZombieSolver | Inputs: GoalObjects, Threshold, Tolerance → I

4a2d099c-b195-9a90-6452-57ab4cd556da.name: Weaverbird's Polylines Dodecahedron
4a2d099c-b195-9a90-6452-57ab4cd556da.quick: Weaverbird's Polylines Dodecahedron | Inputs: P, W → P
4a2d099c-b195-9a90-6452-57ab4cd556da.description:
Construct a mesh (Polylines Dodecahedron)

Provided by Weaverbird 0.9.0.1.

4b106d6a-0e09-4edc-941c-27d734ac4d59.name: SphereCollide
4b106d6a-0e09-4edc-941c-27d734ac4d59.quick: Collision goal for equal-sized spheres between many points | R sets uniform radius for all spheres
4b106d6a-0e09-4edc-941c-27d734ac4d59.description: Collisions between large numbers of equal sized spheres

contexts.particle_packing: Feed point list from random/grid distribution into Points, single number into R (uniform radius), Strength ~1. Output S goes to Kangaroo Solver goals list. Prevents sphere overlap.
contexts.crowd_simulation: Points from agent positions, R as personal space radius, Strength controls push force. Combine with other goals (anchors, loads) in solver.
contexts.sphere_arrangement: Use with Kangaroo2 solver to settle non-overlapping sphere configurations. All spheres must be equal radius — use SolidPointCollide for mesh-bounded containment.

4b106d6a-0e09-4edc-941c-27d734ac4d59.errors: All spheres must share the same radius R — no per-point radius variation. Output S is generic goal data; must connect to Kangaroo Solver, not geometry components. Empty or mismatched Points list causes no collision response.

4c53ba00-f4bd-4ede-8d26-55106278268d.name: Grab
4c53ba00-f4bd-4ede-8d26-55106278268d.quick: Interactive drag tool for Kangaroo particles in Rhino viewport | Alt+LMB to drag, LMB+RMB to toggle anchors
4c53ba00-f4bd-4ede-8d26-55106278268d.description: This lets you drag particles in Rhino. Hold Alt key and drag with LMB, or toggle anchors with LMB+RMB

contexts.interactive_simulation: Connect G output to Kangaroo Solver goals list; set On (bool), Strength (number), Range (number) to control grab sensitivity; allows real-time particle dragging during simulation
contexts.anchor_toggling: Use LMB+RMB click on particles to pin/unpin anchors interactively; A output returns anchor points created during interaction

4c53ba00-f4bd-4ede-8d26-55106278268d.errors: No effect if Solver is not running or On=False; Strength/Range of 0 may produce no response to dragging; G output must be fed into Solver goals to activate

4c7433b7-f637-124b-b012-77416c453352.name: Weaverbird's Laplacian Smoothing
4c7433b7-f637-124b-b012-77416c453352.quick: Smooths mesh by averaging vertex positions (Laplacian); no face count change | L=iterations, T=strength, S controls naked edge behavior
4c7433b7-f637-124b-b012-77416c453352.description:
Calculates a smoothened representation of an original mesh. Does not increase the face count.

Provided by Weaverbird 0.9.0.1.

contexts.basic_smoothing: Connect mesh to M, set L (integer iterations, e.g. 3-10), T (0-1 strength), S (NakedEdgeEnum to fix or free boundary edges); outputs smoothed mesh O
contexts.subdivision_workflow: Typically placed after Weaverbird subdivision components; use low L values first to avoid over-smoothing; chain with Weaverbird's Mesh Edges or Vertices to inspect result
contexts.boundary_control: S input (NakedEdgeEnum) determines whether naked/boundary edges are fixed in place or allowed to move — critical for open meshes to prevent boundary collapse

4c7433b7-f637-124b-b012-77416c453352.errors: Wrong input type on M (non-mesh geometry) causes null output; very high L iterations may over-smooth to near-flat; T=0 produces no change; open meshes with wrong S setting may collapse boundaries

4c90aad1-0748-4800-99db-a27d690bb1e1.name: Grab
4c90aad1-0748-4800-99db-a27d690bb1e1.quick: Interactive particle dragging in Rhino viewport during Kangaroo simulation | outputs goal (G) wired to solver
4c90aad1-0748-4800-99db-a27d690bb1e1.description: This lets you drag particles in Rhino. Hold Left Ctrl and drag with LMB, or toggle anchors with LMB+RMB

contexts.interactive_simulation: Wire G output to Kangaroo solver's Goals input. Set On=True, tune Strength and Range. Use Ctrl+LMB to drag particles live; LMB+RMB toggles anchors. A output gives grabbed point position.
contexts.anchor_toggling: A output exposes the grabbed/anchored point as geometry. Can be used to record or react to interactively placed anchor positions during simulation.

4c90aad1-0748-4800-99db-a27d690bb1e1.errors: If G is not connected to solver, grab has no effect. Strength=0 or very low Range means particles won't respond to dragging. On=False disables interaction entirely.

4c91e97a-a19d-41bd-9ac8-86635fe28c11.name: Weaverbird's Bevel Edges
4c91e97a-a19d-41bd-9ac8-86635fe28c11.quick: Bevels mesh edges by replacing each edge with a new face | D controls bevel distance; T sets inset type
4c91e97a-a19d-41bd-9ac8-86635fe28c11.description:
Replaces each original mesh edge with a new face, connecting the two vertices and, on the long side, with the two faces.

Provided by Weaverbird 0.9.0.1.

contexts.mesh_detailing: Connect mesh geometry to M, set D (number) for bevel width, choose T (InsetTypeEnum) for bevel style; outputs beveled mesh O ready for smoothing with Weaverbird's Laplacian Smoothing
contexts.subdivision_prep: Apply before Weaverbird smoothing components to create chamfered edges; wire O directly into smoothing M input for softened bevel results

4c91e97a-a19d-41bd-9ac8-86635fe28c11.errors: Fails if M is not a valid mesh geometry; D=0 produces no visible bevel; invalid InsetTypeEnum value for T may cause null output

4dd9ea95-2ec8-44e3-a772-0e5889d95344.name: Collide2d
4dd9ea95-2ec8-44e3-a772-0e5889d95344.quick: 2D polygon-polygon collision goal for Kangaroo2 | Polylines must be closed curves; operates within a specified Plane
4dd9ea95-2ec8-44e3-a772-0e5889d95344.description: Collisions between closed polygons in a given plane

contexts.packing_2d: Feed a list of closed polylines and a base Plane; Strength controls repulsion force. Output C connects to Kangaroo2 Solver as a goal. Useful for 2D shape packing or layout optimization.
contexts.kangaroo_solver_setup: Wire C output directly into Kangaroo2 'Goals' input alongside other goal types. Plane typically set to WorldXY unless working in a custom coordinate system.

4dd9ea95-2ec8-44e3-a772-0e5889d95344.errors: Fails if polylines are not closed or not planar to the given Plane. Non-polygon curves (e.g., NURBS arcs) may cause unexpected behavior. Strength of 0 disables collision response.

5002d2f7-7878-4965-98ab-2403503891ab.name: Transform
5002d2f7-7878-4965-98ab-2403503891ab.quick: Kangaroo2 goal: enforces a Transform relationship between two points P0→P1 | Strength controls constraint stiffness
5002d2f7-7878-4965-98ab-2403503891ab.description: Keep a given transformation between 2 points

contexts.rigid_body_motion: Wire two tracked points P0, P1 with a Transform (e.g. rotation/translation matrix) to maintain relative transformation; output T feeds into Kangaroo Solver as a goal object
contexts.constraint_setup: Strength (number) scales how strictly the transform is maintained; lower values allow elastic deviation; combine with other goals in solver list

5002d2f7-7878-4965-98ab-2403503891ab.errors: Null output if T input is not a valid Transform type; mismatched point/transform pairing causes solver instability; Strength=0 disables constraint entirely

5186d211-40eb-4af0-a2fb-a4fb640f4ca3.name: Launch Application
5186d211-40eb-4af0-a2fb-a4fb640f4ca3.quick: Launches external app or file via path | requires Boolean trigger; fires on True
5186d211-40eb-4af0-a2fb-a4fb640f4ca3.description: Launch an external application or file

contexts.open_external_file: Wire a file path (Text) to Path and a Button or toggle to Launch; triggers OS to open the file with its default application
contexts.automation_workflow: Chain with Rhino Command or other workflow components; use a Button (not persistent True) to avoid repeated launches on recompute

5186d211-40eb-4af0-a2fb-a4fb640f4ca3.errors: Nothing launches if Path is invalid or empty; persistent True toggle may re-launch on every solution; no error output beyond generic 'out'

51cbcf97-8cf9-4f52-9941-a9b484593db2.name: Rod
51cbcf97-8cf9-4f52-9941-a9b484593db2.quick: Bending and stretching resistant rod goal for Kangaroo2 | input must be a Polyline curve

contexts.structural_simulation: Connect a polyline (segmented curve) to Polyline input; tune AxialStrength for stretch resistance and BendStrength for bending stiffness; wire output R into Kangaroo2 solver Goals list
contexts.form_finding: Use with multiple rods to simulate beam/frame networks; LengthFactor and AngleFactor scale rest-length and rest-angle targets respectively; combine with other Kangaroo goals

51cbcf97-8cf9-4f52-9941-a9b484593db2.errors: Fails if input is a non-polyline curve (NURBS/arc) — must be segmented polyline. Missing solver connection means R output unused. Zero strength values produce no resistance effect.

51ea6cbf-9681-4a4b-8f66-20e0e2faf182.name: Möbius Transformation
51ea6cbf-9681-4a4b-8f66-20e0e2faf182.quick: Applies 3D Möbius transformation to geometry via 4D rotation | Circle C defines the inversion circle; T and Q control transformation parameters
51ea6cbf-9681-4a4b-8f66-20e0e2faf182.description: 3d Möbius Transformations of any geometry using 4d rotation

contexts.geometry_inversion: Connect any geometry to G, provide a Circle to C for the inversion reference, use T (Number) for transformation amount and Q (Number) for additional parameter; F (Boolean) likely toggles inversion direction. Outputs transformed geometry.
contexts.kangaroo_workflow: Typically used as a pre/post-processing step in Kangaroo2 simulations to apply conformal mappings; wire output G into downstream mesh or curve components.

51ea6cbf-9681-4a4b-8f66-20e0e2faf182.errors: Null output if C is not a valid circle or is unset. Non-geometric data in G may fail silently. T or Q out of expected range may produce degenerate geometry.

521f5358-c59b-4a64-be84-3a88e5aef29d.name: 2D Truss
521f5358-c59b-4a64-be84-3a88e5aef29d.quick: Generates 2D truss geometry between two edge curves; N controls divisions, T selects truss type
521f5358-c59b-4a64-be84-3a88e5aef29d.description: Creates a 2-D Truss using a set of edge curves.

contexts.basic_truss_generation: Connect two parallel or angled curves to CrvA/CrvB, set N (integer) for segment count, T (integer) to select truss topology; outputs LinesA/LinesB (chord lines) and LinesC (diagonal/web members) plus Nodes
contexts.structural_layout: Pair with Grid Structure or Braced Grid for multi-directional structural systems; use Nodes output to place connections or joints at truss intersection points

521f5358-c59b-4a64-be84-3a88e5aef29d.errors: Fails or produces no output if CrvA/CrvB are null or non-curve types; N≤0 or T out of valid range likely causes empty output; mismatched curve domains may produce skewed diagonals

531d7a1b-3c88-48c0-bc2c-2f65695444b9.name: Building Mass (Area Constrained)
531d7a1b-3c88-48c0-bc2c-2f65695444b9.quick: Creates rectangular building mass from total area; derives floor count from Area/(Width×Length) | floor height required
531d7a1b-3c88-48c0-bc2c-2f65695444b9.description: Create rectangular building mass constrained by a total area value.

contexts.comparison_with_floor_count: Use this instead of 'Building Mass (Floor Count)' when total area is the design constraint rather than a fixed number of floors. Both share the same pln/Width/Length/floorHeight inputs.

531d7a1b-3c88-48c0-bc2c-2f65695444b9.errors: Fails or gives zero floors if Area < Width×Length (less than one floor). Non-positive Width, Length, or floorHeight will cause invalid geometry. Plane must be valid; null plane crashes component.

537d4d9a-a8a8-4aa1-87fa-2aedbd07e6bd.name: Write XML File
537d4d9a-a8a8-4aa1-87fa-2aedbd07e6bd.quick: Writes a DataSet to an XML file at specified path | Write toggle must be True to execute

contexts.export_dataset_to_xml: Wire a DataSet (from Create DataTable or similar) into DataSet input, provide file path string to Path, toggle Write to True; outputs XML data
contexts.xml_pipeline: Pairs with Create DataTable or Create JSON neighbors to serialize structured data; XML output can feed Convert XML to JSON for format conversion

537d4d9a-a8a8-4aa1-87fa-2aedbd07e6bd.errors: <~30 tokens: Write=False silently skips writing; invalid/missing path causes failure; DataSet must be properly structured Generic Data, not raw lists>

537e7b52-4f3e-4bb6-b5f5-98233a66b79d.name: EqualLength

contexts.mesh_relaxation: Connect multiple Line inputs (list) with a Strength number; E output feeds into Kangaroo solver's Goals list to equalize edge lengths across a mesh or network
contexts.form_finding: Pair with Direction or LengthSnap goals in same solver; Strength controls how aggressively lengths equalize relative to other competing goals

537e7b52-4f3e-4bb6-b5f5-98233a66b79d.errors: Fails if non-line curves passed to Line input; E output must connect to Kangaroo solver Goals — connecting elsewhere produces no effect. Zero Strength disables goal.

54443347-13e2-4ad6-b68f-53c878d32c84.name: Conicalize

54443347-13e2-4ad6-b68f-53c878d32c84.description: Adjust a quad mesh to make vertices conical - so the mesh has a face-face offset (See the paper 'The focal geometry of circular and conical meshes' for details). Use together with Planarize

contexts.architectural_paneling: Feed quad mesh (M) and Strength number into Kangaroo2 solver alongside Planarize goal; output C connects to solver Goals list to iteratively adjust mesh toward conical vertex condition
contexts.fabrication_offset: Conical meshes support parallel face-face offsets useful for panel fabrication; wire C into Kangaroo solver with other mesh goals to balance conical and planar constraints simultaneously

54443347-13e2-4ad6-b68f-53c878d32c84.errors: Fails or produces no effect if mesh is triangular (requires quads); missing Planarize goal causes non-planar faces; Strength=0 produces no correction; output C must feed Kangaroo solver, not used standalone

5474b0d2-3c33-4d37-b60a-498b95c6e227.name: Triangle Panels B

5474b0d2-3c33-4d37-b60a-498b95c6e227.description: Creates triangular panels on a surface.

contexts.comparison_with_variant_A: Triangle Panels B produces a different triangulation pattern than Triangular Panels A — try both on same surface to compare diagonal orientation or subdivision style
contexts.downstream_processing: Feed Panels output into Subdivide Triangle or Explode/Deconstruct components to extract edges, centroids, or further subdivide individual triangles

5474b0d2-3c33-4d37-b60a-498b95c6e227.errors: <~30 tokens: Non-NURBS or untrimmed surfaces may fail; U/V of 0 or 1 likely produces no panels; very high U/V values may cause performance issues

559ec10e-2671-4bba-b5a7-11816e8fb17b.name: RigidBody
559ec10e-2671-4bba-b5a7-11816e8fb17b.quick: Treats a mesh as a rigid body in Kangaroo2 simulation; Points define interaction anchors, Strength controls rigidity.

contexts.physics_simulation: Connect a closed Mesh to Part, supply anchor/contact Points (must lie on or near mesh), set Strength (higher = stiffer rigid constraint); output RB feeds into Kangaroo2 Solver goals list.
contexts.multi-body_assembly: Use multiple RigidBody goals, each with its own mesh and shared Points between bodies to link them; Strength governs how firmly shape is maintained under loads.

559ec10e-2671-4bba-b5a7-11816e8fb17b.errors: Null output if Part mesh is invalid or open; Points not associated with mesh geometry may cause solver instability; very low Strength allows unwanted deformation defeating rigidity purpose.

55bd2794-8fb8-4752-9014-8ecea132a611.name: Mesh Edges (with Tolerance)

contexts.naked_edge_detection: Connect Mesh → get NakedEdges output as line/curve data; useful for finding boundary edges of open meshes before extrusion or further processing
contexts.crease_edge_extraction: Set Angle (degrees) to threshold; IntEdges returns interior edges where adjacent face normals diverge beyond that angle — useful for detecting sharp folds or ridges
contexts.mesh_analysis_pipeline: Pair with Weaverbird's Mesh Edges for comparison; use after Mesh Reduce to verify topology changes introduced new naked or crease edges

55bd2794-8fb8-4752-9014-8ecea132a611.errors: Outputs are Generic Data — may need casting to lines/curves for downstream use. Zero or missing Angle input may return no IntEdges or all edges. Closed meshes yield empty NakedEdges.

56dba203-8834-40e4-8e98-cf64f2b791a6.name: Hexagon Cells
56dba203-8834-40e4-8e98-cf64f2b791a6.quick: Creates hexagonal cells on a surface | U/V control grid density; t likely controls offset or thickness

contexts.facade_paneling: Connect a NURBS surface to Srf, set U and V integers for hex grid resolution; Cells output yields hex panel geometry, Centers gives center points for further operations
contexts.parametric_tiling: Pair with Diamond Panels or Staggered Quad Panels to compare panel types on same surface; adjust U/V to match desired cell count across surface domain
contexts.post_processing: Use Centers output to place structural nodes or labels; Cells output can be fed into Boundary Surfaces or Brep components for solid panel creation

56dba203-8834-40e4-8e98-cf64f2b791a6.errors: Surface must be valid NURBS; non-manifold or untrimmed surfaces may produce incomplete cells. U/V must be positive integers — zero or negative values likely cause no output. t near 0 may collapse cell geometry.

56e9e40d-6d2f-4daf-9316-034f30cf24a0.name: TangentIncircles
56e9e40d-6d2f-4daf-9316-034f30cf24a0.quick: Kangaroo2 goal: makes incircles of adjacent mesh face pairs tangent along shared edges | outputs goal object for Kangaroo solver

contexts.mesh_circle_packing: Wire EdgeStart/EdgeEnd (shared edge endpoints) and Tip1/Tip2 (opposite vertices of two adjacent triangles) from mesh topology; feed TI output into Kangaroo solver's Goals list with Strength controlling constraint weight
contexts.paneling_optimization: Use with triangle mesh faces to enforce tangent incircle conditions across all interior edges; iterate over mesh edges extracting shared edge and tip points per edge pair

56e9e40d-6d2f-4daf-9316-034f30cf24a0.errors: Fails if points are coplanar in degenerate configurations or edge/tip points are mismatched (wrong vertex order); TI output must connect to Kangaroo solver — not usable standalone. Strength=0 disables constraint.

57e11a7e-413c-4101-03d8-591545411c43.name: Weaverbird's Stellate/Cumulation
57e11a7e-413c-4101-03d8-591545411c43.quick: Adds a pyramid (kis) on each mesh face | D controls pyramid height; M must be a mesh geometry
57e11a7e-413c-4101-03d8-591545411c43.description:
Adds a pyramid on each face. Sometimes called kis. (This component is experimental and allows to try in advance future functionality)

Provided by Weaverbird 0.9.0.1.

contexts.stellating_a_mesh: Connect a mesh to M and a Number to D for pyramid height. Works on any polygon mesh; outputs modified mesh O with pyramids extruded from each face centroid.
contexts.subdivision_workflow: Typically used after Weaverbird subdivision or alongside Mesh Window/Picture Frame to add spiky detail. Chain output O into further Weaverbird transforms.
contexts.controlling_height: D is a Number (not integer); positive values extrude outward, negative likely inward. Experiment carefully as component is marked experimental.

57e11a7e-413c-4101-03d8-591545411c43.errors: Fails if M is not a valid mesh (surfaces or BReps rejected). Experimental status means unstable results on non-manifold or open meshes. Null D may default to zero (flat, no pyramid).

580a1a0c-314d-4033-a54c-c129400b4b58.name: Load

contexts.directional_force: Wire specific points to P and a custom force vector to FV to push geometry in any direction during simulation

580a1a0c-314d-4033-a54c-c129400b4b58.errors: Output U is Generic Data — must be collected into a goals list for Kangaroo Solver; passing non-vector to FV or incompatible point type to P will cause solver failure

59117080-164b-74a4-41a1-1b7891396cf6.name: Weaverbird's Split Polygons Subdivision

Places a new face departing from the middle of each original face edge. Caps the whole with Sierpinski triangles.

Provided by Weaverbird 0.9.0.1.

contexts.fractal_subdivision: Connect mesh to M, integer level to L, NakedEdgeEnum to S for boundary handling; outputs subdivided mesh with Sierpinski triangle caps at each face — use low L values to avoid mesh explosion

59117080-164b-74a4-41a1-1b7891396cf6.errors: High L values cause exponential face count growth and likely crash; S (NakedEdgeEnum) must be set correctly or naked/boundary edges may subdivide incorrectly; non-mesh geometry in M will fail

5a4ba654-7203-474d-83d6-7f1cdfc0a41f.name: ByParent

5a4ba654-7203-474d-83d6-7f1cdfc0a41f.description: Refine a Mesh, separating outputs by parent face

5b882297-9063-439e-82b9-70961f743c5d.description: Removes similar lines from a list.

5d81faae-befc-4c12-b558-beaf2ebee8f1.name: CyclicQuad
